title: 托福雅思进阶词汇
subtitle: 按 ECDICT 考试标签(toefl/ielts/gre)与词频精选，适合四六级以上进阶

defsEn: n. the smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number
n. a single person or thing
s. used of a single unit or thing
not two or more
s. having the indivisible character of a unit
zh: n. 一(个)
pron. 一, 任何人
num. 一, 一个
a. 一致的, 完整的
examples: Which do you prefer: this one or that one?
I have to do it one more time.
exampleZh: 你更喜欢哪个，这个还是那个？
我要再做一次。

defsEn: n. a learner who is enrolled in an educational institution
zh: n. 学生, 研究者, 学者
examples: Do you have your student identification card?
Any student can answer that question.
exampleZh: 你有学生证吗？
任何学生都可以回答这个问题。

defsEn: n. the (prehensile) extremity of the superior limb
n. ability
n. a position given by its location to the side of an object
n. the cards held in a card game by a given player at any given time
zh: n. 手, 爪, 指针, 掌握, 协助, 人手, 手艺, 手迹, 支配, 插手
vt. 交给, 支持, 搀扶
examples: Who told you to write with your left hand?
Tell me what you have in your hand.
exampleZh: 谁跟你说用左手写字的？
告诉我你手里有什么。

defsEn: n. physical strength
zh: n. 力量, 权力
aux. 可能, 也许
examples: I might be able to fix that.
We might be able to help them.
exampleZh: 我或许可以修好它。
我们或许能帮上他们。

defsEn: n. a native or inhabitant of the United States
n. a native or inhabitant of a North American or Central American or South American country
a. of or relating to the United States of America or its people or language or culture
zh: n. 美国人
a. 美国的, 美洲的
examples: He wrote a book about the American Civil War.
Two American students live in this dorm.
exampleZh: 他写了本关于美国南北战争的书。
这间宿舍住着两个美国留学生。

defsEn: n. the number that is represented as a one followed by 6 zeros
n. a very large indefinite number (usually hyperbole)
s. (in Roman numerals, M written with a macron over it) denoting a quantity consisting of 1,000,000 items or units
zh: n. 百万, 无数
num. 百万
examples: Millions of people starve to death every year.
Millions of people die of hunger each year.
exampleZh: 每年有几百万人死于饥饿。
每年有几百万人死于饥饿。

defsEn: n. a person who owes allegiance to that nation
a. of or relating to or belonging to a nation or country
a. limited to or in the interests of a particular nation
a. concerned with or applicable to or belonging to an entire nation or country
zh: a. 国家的, 国立的, 全国性的, 民族的
examples: He's a professor at the National University.
The China National Table Tennis Team had a month's closed training in winter.
exampleZh: 他是国立大学的一名教授。
中国乒乓球队进行了一个月的封闭式冬训。

defsEn: n. a parcel of land having fixed boundaries
n. (Old Testament) nephew of Abraham
God destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah but chose to spare Lot and his family who were told to flee without looking back at the destruction
v. divide into lots, as of land, for example
zh: n. 运气, 签, 抽签, 份额, 许多, 一堆
vt. 划分
vi. 抽签, 抓阄
examples: I have a lot of work to do tomorrow.
We still have a lot of work to do.
exampleZh: 明天有许多要干的事情。
我们还有很多工作要做。

defsEn: n. the organ of sight
n. good discernment (either visually or as if visually)
n. attention to what is seen
n. a small hole or loop (as in a needle)
zh: n. 眼睛, 视力, 看
vt. 看, 注视
examples: Please keep an eye on my suitcase.
Keep an eye on the child for me for a moment.
exampleZh: 请留神看着我的手提箱。
帮我看会儿孩子。

defsEn: a. involving or characteristic of politics or parties or politicians
a. of or relating to your views about social relationships involving authority or power
a. of or relating to the profession of governing
zh: a. 政治的, 政治上的, 政党的, 从事政治的
examples: Political power grows out of the barrel of a gun.
We do not belong to a political organisation.
exampleZh: 枪杆子里面出政权。
我们不是一个政治性的组织。

defsEn: n. something that is of no importance
a. the superlative of `little' that can be used with mass nouns and is usually preceded by `the'
a quantifier meaning smallest in amount or extent or degree
r. used to form the superlative
zh: n. 最少, 最小, 最小限度
a. 最少的, 最小的
adv. 最小, 最少
examples: I go to the library at least once a week.
You might at least say "thank you."
exampleZh: 我每周至少去图书馆一次。
你至少该说声”谢谢“吧。

defsEn: n. an informal term for a youth or man
n. an effigy of Guy Fawkes that is burned on a bonfire on Guy Fawkes Day
n. a cable, wire, or rope that is used to brace something (especially a tent)
v. steady or support with a guy wire or cable
zh: n. 家伙, 支索
vt. 用支索撑住, 取笑, 嘲弄
vi. 逃跑
examples: I want you guys to do me a favor.
Do you guys go to the same school?
exampleZh: 我想要大家伙帮我个忙。
你们俩在同一所学校？

defsEn: n. a particular point in time
n. an indefinitely short time
n. a turning force produced by an object acting at a distance (or a measure of that force)
n. the n-th moment of a distribution is the expected value of the n-th power of the deviations from a fixed value
zh: n. 片刻, 瞬间, 重要, 阶段, 力矩
examples: I asked her to wait a moment.
I live every moment for you.
exampleZh: 我请她等一会儿。
我每时每刻都在为你而活。

defsEn: n. a person whose occupation is teaching
n. a personified abstraction that teaches
zh: n. 教师, 老师, 导师
examples: I want to become a teacher of Japanese.
We asked our teacher: "Can we come to your wedding?"
exampleZh: 我想成为日语老师。
我们问老师：“我们可以参加你的婚礼吗？”

defsEn: r. in actual fact
r. used to imply that one would expect the fact to be the opposite of that stated
surprisingly
r. at the present moment
r. as a sentence modifier to add slight emphasis
zh: adv. 事实上, 竟然, 如今, 现在
examples: The "man" that you saw is actually a woman.
That actually makes a lot of sense.
exampleZh: 实际上你看到那个男人是女的。
那个相当能说得通。

defsEn: n. education imparted in a series of lessons or meetings
n. a connected series of events or actions or developments
n. general line of orientation
n. a mode of action
zh: n. 课程, 路线, 过程, 一道菜, 道路
v. 追, (使)跑
examples: This course will help you master correct pronunciation.
Of course I should read this book.
exampleZh: 这个课程能帮助你掌握正确发音。
我本来应该读一下这本书。

defsEn: n. act of improving by expanding or enlarging or refining
n. a process in which something passes by degrees to a different stage (especially a more advanced or mature stage)
n. a recent event that has some relevance for the present situation
n. a district that has been developed to serve some purpose
zh: n. 发展
examples: He contributed much to the development of the economy.
The development of the computer industry has been very rapid.
exampleZh: 他为经济发展作了很多贡献。
电脑产业的发展一日千里。

defsEn: a. of or relating to an economy, the system of production and management of material wealth
a. of or relating to the science of economics
s. using the minimum of time or resources necessary for effectiveness
s. concerned with worldly necessities of life (especially money)
zh: a. 经济上的, 实用的, 节省的
examples: Which is more important, economic development or environmental protection?
The economic situation of the country worsened.
exampleZh: 发展经济和保护环境哪一个更重要?
这个国家的经济环境变得更糟糕了。

defsEn: n. the locus of feelings and intuitions
n. the hollow muscular organ located behind the sternum and between the lungs
its rhythmic contractions move the blood through the body
n. the courage to carry on
n. an inclination or tendency of a certain kind
zh: n. 心, 心脏, 中心, 内心, 感情, 精神, 心情, 宝贝儿
vt. 鼓励
examples: Keep a good heart and go on writing.
I thank you with all my heart.
exampleZh: 别气馁，继续写作吧。
我衷心感谢您。

defsEn: n. the act of making up your mind about something
n. a position or opinion or judgment reached after consideration
n. (boxing) a victory won on points when no knockout has occurred
n. the outcome of a game or contest
zh: n. 决定, 决心, 决断
examples: They needed to make a decision - an immediate decision.
You make a decision for yourself on this matter.
exampleZh: 他们需要做决定——即刻作出决定。
这件事你自己决定就是了。

defsEn: n. the visual percept of a region
n. the act of looking or seeing or observing
n. the range of the eye
n. purpose
the phrase `with a view to' means `with the intention of' or `for the purpose of'
zh: n. 视野, 风景, 见解, 视力, 观看, 视图, 指望, 意图, 印象
vt. 看, 考虑, 视察, 查看, 估量
examples: We have a good view of the sea from the window.
How do you view this matter?
exampleZh: 透过窗，我们可以看到很美的海景。
您怎么看这个问题？

defsEn: n. a relation between people

(`relationship' is often used where `relation' would serve, as in `the relationship between inflation and unemployment', but the preferred usage of `relationship' is for human relations or states of relatedness)
n. a state of connectedness between people (especially an emotional connection)
n. a state involving mutual dealings between people or parties or countries
zh: n. 关系, 关联
examples: I consider relationships to be the most important thing in life.
He is in a relationship with a foreign student.
exampleZh: 我以感情为生活里最重要的事。
他正在和一个外国学生交往。

defsEn: n. the quality of being unlike or dissimilar
n. a significant change
zh: n. 不同, 差异
examples: Do you know the difference between good and bad?
Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?
exampleZh: 你知道分辨好坏吗？
你知道显微镜和望远镜的差别吗？

defsEn: n. something done (usually as opposed to something said)
n. the state of being active
n. the series of events that form a plot
n. the trait of being active and energetic and forceful
zh: n. 行动, 活动, 动作, 作用, 战斗, 行为, 诉讼
vt. 对...起诉
examples: I believe that his action was in the right.
His action is against the law.
exampleZh: 我相信他采取的行动是对的。
他的行为是犯法的。

defsEn: n. someone who controls resources and expenditures
n. member of a board of directors
n. someone who supervises the actors and directs the action in the production of a show
zh: n. 主管, 导演, 董事
examples: This is Professor Oak, the director of this experiment.
He is a talented young director.
exampleZh: 这位是奥克教授，他是这项实验的负责人。
他是个富有才能的年轻导演。

defsEn: n. a person who participates in or is skilled at some game
n. a person who pursues a number of different social and sexual partners simultaneously
n. an important participant (as in a business deal)
zh: n. 竞赛者, 上场队员, 游戏者, 演员
examples: We regard him as the best player on the team.
Will you lend me your CD player for an hour?
exampleZh: 我们认为他是队里最厉害的选手。
你能借我你的CD播放机一小时吗？

defsEn: n. a small thin device (of metal or plastic or ivory) used to pluck a stringed instrument
n. a thin sharp implement used for removing unwanted material
n. a heavy iron tool with a wooden handle and a curved head that is pointed on both ends
n. a basketball maneuver
obstructing an opponent with one's body
zh: n. 精选, 选择, 掘, 精华, 牙签, 鹤嘴锄
v. 摘, 掘, 凿, 挖, 挑选
examples: Can I pick my ticket up at the airport?
I want to pick out a present for my friend.
exampleZh: 我能在机场领取机票吗？
我想给我朋友选个礼物。

defsEn: n. any specific behavior
n. (chemistry) the capacity of a substance to take part in a chemical reaction
zh: n. 活动, 行动, 活跃, 活力
examples: The town was full of activity.
With this, today's activities come to a close.
exampleZh: 小镇充满了活力。
今天的活动到此结束。

defsEn: n. a set of data arranged in rows and columns
n. a piece of furniture having a smooth flat top that is usually supported by one or more vertical legs
n. a piece of furniture with tableware for a meal laid out on it
n. a company of people assembled at a table for a meal or game
zh: n. 桌子, 餐桌, 工作台, 铭文, 表格, 表, 高原, 平地层
vt. 搁置, 嵌合, 制表, 把...列入议事日程
examples: Please find us a table for two people.
He put the book on the table.
exampleZh: 请给我们找一张两个人的桌子。
他把书放在了桌上。

defsEn: n. a diagram or picture illustrating textual material
n. a model of a bodily form (especially of a person)
n. a combination of points and lines and planes that form a visible palpable shape
n. an amount of money expressed numerically
zh: n. 数字, 价格, 图形, 形状
vt. 描绘, 表示, 演算, 认为
vi. 计算, 出现, 估计
examples: Figure out a way to let her come.
I can't figure out what he means.
exampleZh: 想个办法让她来。
我不懂他的意思。

defsEn: n. (phonetics) an individual sound unit of speech without concern as to whether or not it is a phoneme of some language
zh: n. 电话, 受话器, 耳机
vt. 打电话给
vi. 打电话
examples: He asked me if I know her phone number.
Can you give me your phone number?
exampleZh: 他问我，是不是知道她的电话号码。
你能给我你的电话号码吗？

defsEn: n. a customary way of operation or behavior
n. translating an idea into action
n. the exercise of a profession
n. knowledge of how something is usually done
zh: n. 实践, 练习, 实行, 惯例, 习惯, 开业
v. 实践, 实行, 练习, 实习, 业务
examples: How can we put it into practice?
Yes, you need to practice every day.
exampleZh: 我们怎样才能将其付出实践？
是的，你需要每天练习。

defsEn: n. an artifact that has been created by someone or some process
n. a quantity obtained by multiplication
n. a chemical substance formed as a result of a chemical reaction
n. a consequence of someone's efforts or of a particular set of circumstances
zh: n. 产品, 结果, 乘积
examples: He's a product of his time.
We advertise our products on TV.
exampleZh: 他毕竟是那个时代的人。
我们在电视上宣传我们的产品。

defsEn: n. a person who works at a specific occupation
n. sterile member of a colony of social insects that forages for food and cares for the larvae
zh: n. 工人, 劳动者
examples: She is a child-care worker in a kindergarten.
My father is an office worker.
exampleZh: 她是幼儿园里的保育员。
我父亲是一名办公室职员。

defsEn: n. a short newspaper article about a particular person or group
a. concerning or affecting a particular person or his or her private life and personality
s. particular to a given individual
a. of or arising from personality
zh: a. 私人的, 涉及隐私的, 有人性的, 人称的, 亲自的, 身体的
examples: Will you take a personal check?
She got her daughter a personal computer.
exampleZh: 你收私人支票吗?
她给她的女儿买了一台个人电脑。

defsEn: n. a subdivision of a particular kind of thing
n. (biology) the taxonomic group whose characteristics are used to define the next higher taxon
n. printed characters
n. all of the tokens of the same symbol
zh: n. 类型, 样式, 典型, 榜样, 标志, 符号, 型, 式
vi. 打字
vt. 作为代表, 测定类型, 用打字机打
examples: I believe this type of medicine will help your illness.
What type of work do you do?
exampleZh: 我相信这种药对你的病情有帮助。
你做什么类型的工作？

defsEn: n. a gully that is shallower than a ravine
n. the finish of a contest in which the score is tied and the winner is undecided
n. anything (straws or pebbles etc.) taken or chosen at random
n. a playing card or cards dealt or taken from the pack
zh: vi. 拉, 拖, 拔剑
vt. 拖拉, 挨近, 领取, 打成平局, 引导, 抽签决定, 画, 描写, 制订, 草拟, 吸引
n. 拉, 拖, 拔出, 抽签, 平局
examples: Thank you for drawing a bird for me.
Draw a line on your paper.
exampleZh: 谢谢你为我画鸟。
在你的纸上划一条线。

defsEn: n. a group of people who work together
n. the act of organizing a business or an activity related to a business
n. an ordered manner
orderliness by virtue of being methodical and well organized
n. the activity or result of distributing or disposing persons or things properly or methodically
zh: n. 组织, 结构, 团体, 体制
examples: He would rather betray his organization than lose his life.
This organization cannot exist without you.
exampleZh: 他与其牺牲生命，不如出卖组织。
没有你们，就没有这个组织。

defsEn: r (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished
all but
r in a close manner
zh: adv. 几乎, 密切地
examples: Nearly all Japanese have dark hair.
I nearly left my brolly on the train.
exampleZh: 几乎所有的日本人头发都是黑色的。
我几乎把我的雨伞忘在火车上。

defsEn: n. the number that is represented as a one followed by 12 zeros
in the United Kingdom the usage followed in the United States is frequently seen
n. the number that is represented as a one followed by 9 zeros
s. denoting a quantity consisting of one thousand million items or units in the United States
s. denoting a quantity consisting of one million million items or units in Great Britain
zh: num. 十亿, 十亿个
examples: More than a billion people live in China.
There are billions of stars in the sky.
exampleZh: 中国有超过十亿人口。
天空中有数十亿的星星。

defsEn: v. make real or concrete
give reality or substance to
v. convert into cash
of goods and property
v. expand or complete (a part in a piece of baroque music) by supplying the harmonies indicated in the figured bass
zh: vt. 了解, 实现, 使显得逼真, 变卖
vi. 变卖
examples: Do you realize what this means?
She may realize later what I meant.
exampleZh: 你明白这是什么意思了吗？
她可能以后会明白我的意思。

defsEn: n. a possibility due to a favorable combination of circumstances
zh: n. 机会, 时机
examples: I must take the opportunity to improve my language ability.
I decided to take the opportunity to go and visit him.
exampleZh: 我要借机提升我的语言能力。
我决定顺便去看望看望他。

defsEn: n. the person or thing chosen or selected
n. the act of choosing or selecting
s. of superior grade
s. appealing to refined taste
zh: n. 选择, 精选品, 选择权
a. 精选的, 挑三拣四的, 上等的
该命令用于提示用户作出选择, 决定批处理文件的流程
examples: You have a choice of black tea, coffee, or milk.
You have a difficult choice to make.
exampleZh: 你可以选择红茶，咖啡或牛奶。
你必须做出困难的选择。

defsEn: n. one of the groups of Christians who have their own beliefs and forms of worship
n. a place for public (especially Christian) worship
n. the body of people who attend or belong to a particular local church
v. perform a special church rite or service for
zh: n. 教堂, 礼拜, 教会
vt. 使人接受宗教仪式
a. 教堂的
examples: Do you go to church on Christmas Day?
I go by that church every day.
exampleZh: 你在圣诞节去教堂吗？
我每天都从那座教堂前经过。

defsEn: n. the cardinal number that is the product of 10 and 100
s. denoting a quantity consisting of 1,000 items or units
zh: num. 千
a. 成千的, 许多的
n. 许许多多
examples: As many as a thousand people were there.
A journey of a thousand miles starts with a single step.
exampleZh: 当时有多达千人在那里。
千里之行，始于足下。

defsEn: n. (military) military action or resources protecting a country against potential enemies
n. protection from harm
n. (sports) the team that is trying to prevent the other team from scoring
zh: n. 防卫, 防卫物
examples: The defense of the master thesis is just happening next month.
Tom took a class in self-defense.
exampleZh: 下个月就要进行硕士论文答辩了。
汤姆上了一堂自卫课。

defsEn: n. a committee having supervisory powers
n. a stout length of sawn timber
made in a wide variety of sizes and used for many purposes
n. a flat piece of material designed for a special purpose
n. food or meals in general
zh: n. 木板, 甲板, 膳食, 会议桌
vt. 乘船, 供膳食, 用板覆盖
vi. 搭伙
examples: Before you can board the plane, you'll have to go through airport security checks.
May I see your boarding pass, please?
exampleZh: 你要通过了机场的安全检查才能登机。
请让我看看您的登机证好吗?

defsEn: prep. Through
by means of
through the agency of
by
for
each
as, per annum
per capita, by heads, or according to individuals
per curiam, by the court
per se, by itself, of itself. Per is also
sometimes used with English words.
zh: prep. 每一, 通过, 经, 按照
examples: How much is the rent per month?
You must study five pages per day.
exampleZh: 一个月的租金多少？
你每天必须学习五页。

defsEn: n. a dramatic or musical entertainment
n. the act of presenting a play or a piece of music or other entertainment
n. the act of performing
of doing something successfully
using knowledge as distinguished from merely possessing it
n. any recognized accomplishment
zh: n. 施行, 工作情况, 成绩, 行为, 表现, 演出
examples: Did you enjoy the performance last night?
What time is the next performance?
exampleZh: 你喜欢昨晚的演出吧？
下一场表演在几点钟？

defsEn: r. in the recent past
zh: adv. 最近
examples: He recently found a good job.
Have you been in contact with him recently?
exampleZh: 他最近找到一个好工作。
你最近有没有和他联络？

defsEn: n. a result
n. a phrase recited or sung by the congregation following a versicle by the priest or minister
n. the manner in which an electrical or mechanical device responds to an input signal or a range of input signals
zh: n. 反应, 回答, 响应
examples: She made no response to my question.
I'm sorry for the late response.
exampleZh: 她没有回答我的问题。
我很抱歉回复晚了。

defsEn: n broadcasting visual images of stationary or moving objects
n an electronic device that receives television signals and displays them on a screen
zh: 电视
examples: I saw the news on TV this morning.
Would you please turn the TV off?
exampleZh: 我今天早上在电视上看到新闻了。
请把电视机关掉好吗？

defsEn: n. nonfictional prose forming an independent part of a publication
n. one of a class of artifacts
n. a separate section of a legal document (as a statute or contract or will)
n. (grammar) a determiner that may indicate the specificity of reference of a noun phrase
zh: n. 文章, 冠词, 物品, 物件, 条款, 契约
examples: Yesterday I read an article about acid rain.
I want to write an article.
exampleZh: 昨天我读了关于酸雨的文章。
我想写篇文章。

defsEn: n. the place where some action occurs
n. an incident (real or imaginary)
n. a consecutive series of pictures that constitutes a unit of action in a film
n. a subdivision of an act of a play
zh: n. 场, 情景, 镜头, 发生地点, 道具, 布景, 景色
examples: I like this scene in particular.
The police got to the scene of the accident.
exampleZh: 我特别喜欢这一幕。
警察到达了事故现场。

defsEn: n. the capital raised by a corporation through the issue of shares entitling holders to an ownership interest (equity)
n. the merchandise that a shop has on hand
n. the handle of a handgun or the butt end of a rifle or shotgun or part of the support of a machine gun or artillery gun
n. the reputation and popularity a person has
zh: n. 树干, 祖先, 血统, 原料, 备料, 库存, 牲畜, 股票, 股份, 保留剧目
a. 存货的, 常备的, 平凡的, 普通的, 股票的, 保留剧目的, 繁殖用的
vt. 装把手于, 进货, 备有, 放牧
vi. 出新芽, 备货, 囤积
examples: We have a stock of toilet paper.
He lost a fortune in the stock market.
exampleZh: 我们还有卫生纸。
他玩股票赔了。

defsEn: n. a workplace that serves as a telecommunications facility where lines from telephones can be connected together to permit communication
a. in or near a center or constituting a center
the inner area
zh: a. 中央的, 重要的
examples: What is the central aim of this plan?
Is there central heating in this building?
exampleZh: 这个计划的主要目的是什么？
这栋楼里面有中央暖气系统吗？

defsEn: n. the organized beliefs of a period or group or individual
zh: n. 想法, 思想, 思维, 关心, 挂念
think的过去式和过去分词
examples: If you have a thought, please raise your hand.
I never thought it would come to this.
exampleZh: 如果你有意见请举手。
我从没想过它会变成这样。

defsEn: n. a formally arranged gathering
n. a small informal social gathering
n. a casual or unexpected convergence
n. the social act of assembling for some common purpose
zh: n. 会议, 会面
examples: The meetings of the parliament are public.
All of these meetings are in English.
exampleZh: 国会的会议是公开的。
所有这些会议都是以英语进行的。

defsEn: v. establish after a calculation, investigation, experiment, survey, or study
v. shape or influence
give direction to
v. fix conclusively or authoritatively
v. fix in scope
fix the boundaries of
zh: v. 决定, 决心
examples: I am determined to carry out this plan.
He is determined to succeed at any price.
exampleZh: 我决心要推行这个计划。
他执意不惜一切代价获得成功。

defsEn: v. to prepare verbally, either for written or spoken delivery
v. educate for a future role or function
v. lead up to and soften by sounding the dissonant note in it as a consonant note in the preceding chord
zh: vt. 准备, 筹备, 使在思想上有准备, 制造, 调制
vi. 预备
examples: You should prepare for the worst.
There's no need for you to prepare a formal speech.
exampleZh: 你应该作最坏的准备。
您没必要准备一个正式的演讲。

defsEn: s one or some or every or all without specification
zh: pron. 无论什么
examples: Whatever I do, she says I can do better.
You can do whatever you want to.
exampleZh: 不管我做什么，她都说我能做得更好。
你可以做任何你想做的事。

defsEn: n. a small open container usually used for drinking
usually has a handle
n. the quantity a cup will hold
n. any cup-shaped concavity
n. a United States liquid unit equal to 8 fluid ounces
zh: n. 杯子, 茶杯, 优胜杯
vt. 使成杯状, 为...拔火罐
examples: I would like to have a cup of coffee.
Would you like to have a cup of tea?
exampleZh: 我想要一杯咖啡。
你想要一杯茶吗？

defsEn: n. the quality of being able to perform
a quality that permits or facilitates achievement or accomplishment
n. possession of the qualities (especially mental qualities) required to do something or get something done
zh: n. 能力, 才干
examples: You have a strong ability to learn.
I think he's a man of ability.
exampleZh: 你的学习能力很强。
我觉得他是一个有能力的人。

defsEn: n. personnel who assist their superior in carrying out an assigned task
n. a strong rod or stick with a specialized utilitarian purpose
n. the body of teachers and administrators at a school
n. building material consisting of plaster and hair
used to cover external surfaces of temporary structure (as at an exposition) or for decoration
zh: n. 全体人员, 工作班子, 棍棒, 杆, 拐杖, 支柱, 权杖
a. 职员的, 雇员的, 参谋的
vt. 为...配备人员
examples: The staff in that restaurant gave us a very good impression.
The entire sales staff has worked around the clock for a week.
exampleZh: 那家饭馆儿的服务员给我们留下很好的印象。
全体销售人员通宵达旦地工作了一周。

defsEn: n. the inherent complex of attributes that determines a persons moral and ethical actions and reactions
n. an actor's portrayal of someone in a play
n. a person of a specified kind (usually with many eccentricities)
n. good repute
zh: n. 个性, 字符, 人物, 性质, 品格, 资格
examples: How do you read this character?
How do you write this character?
exampleZh: 这个字怎么念？
这个字怎么写？

defsEn: n. (biology) the process of an individual organism growing organically
a purely biological unfolding of events involved in an organism changing gradually from a simple to a more complex level
n. a progression from simpler to more complex forms
n. vegetation that has grown
n. (pathology) an abnormal proliferation of tissue (as in a tumor)
zh: n. 生长, 栽培, 增长
examples: The rapid growth in imports amazes us.
Plant growth and productivity react sharply to a complex combination of temperature and moisture.
exampleZh: 进口数量的急速增长让我们感到惊讶。

defsEn: n. something that is lost
n. gradual decline in amount or activity
n. the act of losing someone or something
n. the disadvantage that results from losing something
zh: n. 损失, 遗失, 失败, 输, 错过, 伤亡
examples: I was at a loss as to what to say.
His death was a great loss to our firm.
exampleZh: 我无话可说。
他的死对我们公司是一个巨大的损失。

defsEn: n. activity leading to skilled behavior
zh: n. 训练, 培养
examples: Do you know how long this training will take?
I think you should stick to your training schedule.

defsEn: n. a vote to select the winner of a position or political office
n. the act of selecting someone or something
the exercise of deliberate choice
n. the status or fact of being elected
n. the predestination of some individuals as objects of divine mercy (especially as conceived by Calvinists)
zh: n. 选举, 当选, 选择权
examples: When do the elections take place?
By tomorrow, we'll know who won the elections.
exampleZh: 选举何时举行？
等到明天，我们就会知道谁赢得了选举。

defsEn: v. put in a horizontal position
v. prepare or position for action or operation
v. lay eggs
v. impose as a duty, burden, or punishment
zh: vt. 放置, 产, 铺设, 布置, 提出, 平息
vi. 下蛋, 打赌
n. 位置, 层, 隐藏处
a. 世俗的, 外行的
lie的过去式
examples: A beautiful lake lay just beyond the forest.
She lay down on the bed.
exampleZh: 森林外有一个美丽的湖泊。
她在床上躺了下来。

defsEn: n. a basis for comparison
a reference point against which other things can be evaluated
n. a board measure = 1980 board feet
n. the value behind the money in a monetary system
n. an upright pole or beam (especially one used as a support)
zh: n. 标准, 规格, 旗, 军旗, 本位
a. 标准的, 合规格的
examples: We tried to come up to the standard.
I would like to learn standard English.
exampleZh: 我们尝试达到标准。
我想学标准的英语。

defsEn: n. an investigation of the component parts of a whole and their relations in making up the whole
n. the abstract separation of a whole into its constituent parts in order to study the parts and their relations
n. a form of literary criticism in which the structure of a piece of writing is analyzed
n. the use of closed-class words instead of inflections: e.g., `the father of the bride' instead of `the bride's father'
zh: n. 分析
examples: Survival analysis showed a significant reduction.
She maintains that her analysis is correct.
exampleZh: 存活分析显示，机率显著减少。
她坚持自己的分析是正确的。

defsEn: n. a professional person authorized to practice law
conducts lawsuits or gives legal advice
zh: n. 律师
examples: I know a good lawyer who can help you.
Could you introduce me to a lawyer?
exampleZh: 我认识一个不错的律师，他可以帮你。
你能帮我介绍一名律师吗？

defsEn: a. of or relating to the external conditions or surroundings
a. concerned with the ecological effects of altering the environment
zh: a. 周围的, 环境的
examples: We had a lecture on environmental pollution.
I live near an environmental disaster area.
exampleZh: 我们有一节关于环境污染的讲座。

defsEn: n. a large platform on which people can stand and can be seen by an audience
n. the theater as a profession (usually `the stage')
n. a section or portion of a journey or course
n. any scene regarded as a setting for exhibiting or doing something
zh: n. 阶段, 舞台, 场所, 戏剧, 站, 驿站, 级, 层, 脚手架
vt. 上演, 表演, 筹划
vi. 适于上演, 乘驿车旅行
examples: He made me sing on the stage.
My goal is to help him navigate this stage of life.
exampleZh: 他让我在舞台上唱歌。
我的目的是帮助他审视这段人生。

defsEn: n. a fact that has been verified
n. conformity to reality or actuality
n. a true statement
n. United States abolitionist and feminist who was freed from slavery and became a leading advocate of the abolition of slavery and for the rights of women (1797-1883)
zh: n. 事实, 实情
examples: We have to get at the truth of the matter.
I want you to tell me the truth.
exampleZh: 我们必须知道事情的真相。
我想你把真相告诉我。

defsEn: n. a written order directing a bank to pay money
n. the bill in a restaurant
n. the act of inspecting or verifying
n. a mark left after a small piece has been chopped or broken off of something
zh: n. 检查, 支票, 阻止物, 寄物牌, 象棋中将军
vt. 检查, 阻止, 核对, 寄存, 托运
vi. 逐项相符, 开支票
examples: I want to pay with a check.
Please give it a check, then hand in the examination paper.
exampleZh: 我想用支票付款。
请大家认真检查一次，再把考卷交上来。

defsEn: s of many different kinds purposefully arranged but lacking any uniformity
s considered individually
s distinctly dissimilar or unlike
s having great diversity or variety
zh: a. 不同的, 各种的, 多方面的, 许多的, 个别的, 杂色的
examples: Speakers of various dialects are in the majority in this region.
Air is a mixture of various gases.
exampleZh: 这一带的方言使用者数量居多。
空气是由许多种气体组成的混合物。

defsEn: n. a person responsible for the administration of a business
n. persons who administer the law
a. having the function of carrying out plans or orders etc.
zh: n. 执行部门, 执行委员会, 执行者, 经理主管人员
a. 执行的, 善于执行的, 善于经营的
examples: One must be an executive in some company.
It reveals local executives' ambitions of bringing the region back to the top.
exampleZh: 我们在任何公司都应该是执行者。
这表明了地方领导恢复地区卓越水平的雄心。

defsEn: n someone who controls resources and expenditures
n (sports) someone in charge of training an athlete or a team
zh: n. 经理, 管理员, 管理器
examples: He's the manager of the marketing department.
I have to introduce Mary to the manager.
exampleZh: 他是营销部的负责人。
我要向经理介绍一下Mary。

defsEn: n. a member of a religious order who is bound by vows of poverty and chastity and obedience
s. concerned with sacred matters or religion or the church
a. having or showing belief in and reverence for a deity
a. of or relating to clergy bound by monastic vows
zh: a. 宗教性的, 虔诚的, 宗教上的, 严谨的
n. 修道士, 出家人
examples: I'm a deeply religious man and believe in life after death.
You can't really be Algerian and not religious.
exampleZh: 我是一个虔诚的教徒，我相信死后的生命。
只要是阿尔及利亚人，不信教是不可能的。

defsEn: n. one of a set of small pieces of stiff paper marked in various ways and used for playing games or for telling fortunes
n. a card certifying the identity of the bearer
n. a rectangular piece of stiff paper used to send messages (may have printed greetings or pictures)
n. thin cardboard, usually rectangular
zh: n. 卡片, 纸牌, 节目单, 明信片, 梳棉机
vt. 备置卡片, 记于卡片上, 梳理
examples: I use flash cards to study my German vocabulary.
Which credit cards can I use?
exampleZh: 我用字卡来学德文生字。
我可以用哪些信用卡？

defsEn: n. a member of the Democratic Party
n. an advocate of democratic principles
zh: n. 民主人士, 民主主义者, 民主党党员
examples: A democrat is a free citizen who yields to the will of the majority.
Mary quickly noticed that Putin was not a democrat.
exampleZh: 民主主义者是屈服于大部分人的自由公民。
玛丽很快就注意到普丁并不是民主人士。

defsEn: n. the act of managing something
n. those in charge of running a business
zh: n. 经营, 支配, 管理
examples: Japanese management must learn how to deal with American workers, he said.
Management of a company is different from ownership of a company.
exampleZh: 他说：“日本管理层必须学会如何处理美国员工。”
管理一家公司和拥有一家公司是捷然不同的。

defsEn: n. a message that is stated or declared
a communication (oral or written) setting forth particulars or facts etc
n. (music) the presentation of a musical theme
n. a nonverbal message
n. a document showing credits and debits
zh: n. 陈述, 指令, 声明
examples: I would like to retract my previous statement.
This statement is actually kind of suspicious.
exampleZh: 我想撤回我之前的陈述。
这种说法其实有点可疑。

defsEn: a. consisting of or derived from tradition
s. pertaining to time-honored orthodox doctrines
zh: a. 传统的, 惯例的
examples: It was a very traditional ceremony.
I cannot write traditional characters, but I am fine reading them.
exampleZh: 那是一个十分传统的仪式。
我不会写繁体字，但我可以读。

defsEn: n. a worker who is hired to perform a job
zh: n. 职员, 员工, 受雇人员
examples: She's not a full-time employee of this company.
The employees work at the office.
exampleZh: 她不是这间公司正式的职员。
员工在办公室工作。

defsEn: a. of or relating to the arts and manners that a group favors
s. denoting or deriving from or distinctive of the ways of living built up by a group of people
a. of or relating to the shared knowledge and values of a society
a. relating to the raising of plants or animals
zh: a. 文化的, 教养的, 修养的
examples: The dragon is one of the cultural emblems of China.
Cultural exchange programs can strengthen friendly relations between neighboring countries.
exampleZh: 龙是中国的文化图腾。
文化交流计划可以加强邻国之间的友好关系。

defsEn: v. be pertinent or relevant or applicable
v. ask (for something)
v. refer (a word or name) to a person or thing
v. apply oneself to
zh: vt. 涂, 应用
vi. 申请, 适用
examples: In order to apply, you have to go in person.
Mother applied the medicine to the sore on my knee.
exampleZh: 要申请的话，你得亲自去。
母亲把药膏涂在了我膝盖的伤口上。

defsEn: n. the questioning of a person (or a conversation in which information is elicited)
often conducted by journalists
v. conduct an interview in television, newspaper, and radio reporting
v. discuss formally with (somebody) for the purpose of an evaluation
v. go for an interview in the hope of being hired
zh: n. 面谈, 访问, 接见, 面试
vt. 接见, 对...进行面谈(试)
examples: I reminded him of his interview with the president.
You'll have to play it by ear at the interview.
exampleZh: 我提醒他要去会见总裁。
在面试的时候你必须见机行事。

defsEn: n. a seat for one person, with a support for the back
n. a particular seat in an orchestra
v. act or preside as chair, as of an academic department in a university
zh: n. 椅子, 显要的席位, 主席
vt. 使入座, 使就任要职
examples: Put the chair in front of the desk.
Which chair will you sit in?
exampleZh: 把椅子放在桌子前面。
你要坐哪张椅子？

defsEn: n. a fact about some part (as opposed to general)
n. (logic) a proposition that asserts something about some (but not all) members of a class
s. unique or specific to a person or thing or category
s. separate and distinct from others of the same group or category
zh: n. 一项(或条、点), 个别项目, 详细说明
a. 特别的, 独有的, 挑剔的, 详尽的
examples: I would like to place particular emphasis on this point.
I have no particular reason to do so.
exampleZh: 我想特别强调这一点。
我没有特别的理由去做。

defsEn: n. a small fragment of something broken off from the whole
n. piece of metal held in horse's mouth by reins and used to control the horse while riding
n. a unit of measurement of information (from binary + digit)
the amount of information in a system having two equiprobable states
n. the part of a key that enters a lock and lifts the tumblers
zh: n. 少量, 马嚼子, 辅币
vt. 给马上嚼子, 控制
bite的过去式和过去分词
examples: Can you tell us a bit more about that?
Can you give me a bit more coffee?
exampleZh: 能再告诉我一点吗？
你能再给我一点咖啡吗？

defsEn: n. the vertical force exerted by a mass as a result of gravity
n. sports equipment used in calisthenic exercises and weightlifting
it is not attached to anything and is raised and lowered by use of the hands and arms
n. the relative importance granted to something
n. an artifact that is heavy
zh: n. 重, 重量, 体重, 砝码, 重大, 影响, 力量
vt. 加重量于, 压迫, 使加权, 称重量
examples: You worry about your weight too much.
If you want to lose weight, then you need to control your appetite.
exampleZh: 你太担心你的体重了。
想要减肥就必须控制食欲。

defsEn: n. the act or process of producing something
n. a presentation for the stage or screen or radio or television
n. (law) the act of exhibiting in a court of law
n. a display that is exaggerated or unduly complicated
zh: n. 制造, 生产, 产物
examples: Mass production reduced the price of many goods.
Although the production of electric fans was reduced in February, it still beats January.
exampleZh: 大量生产降低许多商品的价格。
虽然二月电风扇的产量减少了，但还是超过了一月。

defsEn: n. the latter part of the day (the period of decreasing daylight from late afternoon until nightfall)
n. a later concluding time period
n. the early part of night (from dinner until bedtime) spent in a special way
zh: n. 傍晚, 晚间, 末期
examples: They never go out in the evenings with their children.
In the evenings, we would wander around the city centre.

defsEn: n. a remark that calls attention to something or someone
n. an official recognition of merit
v. make reference to
v. commend
zh: n. 提到, 言及, 陈述
vt. 提到, 提及
examples: He made no mention of her request.
That writer I mentioned a lot in the past passed away yesterday.
exampleZh: 他没有提到她的请求。
我以前多次向你谈起的那个作家昨天去世了。

defsEn: n. writes (books or stories or articles or the like) professionally (for pay)
n. a person who is able to write and has written something
zh: n. 作家, 撰稿者, 抄写员
examples: I consider him a great writer.
I doubt that I'm a good writer.
exampleZh: 我觉得他是一个优秀的作家。
我怀疑我是不是一个好作家。

defsEn: r. from first to last
zh: adv. 到处, 贯穿全部地, 自始至终
prep. 遍及, 在各处
examples: Throughout Heaven and Earth, I alone am the honored one.
He spread the news throughout the entire village.
exampleZh: 天上天下，唯我独尊。

defsEn: n. the part of the body between the neck and the upper arm
n. a cut of meat including the upper joint of the foreleg
n. a ball-and-socket joint between the head of the humerus and a cavity of the scapula
n. the part of a garment that covers or fits over the shoulder
zh: n. 肩, 肩膀, 衣肩
vt. 肩负, 负担, 担任
vi. 用肩推挤
examples: Lend me your shoulder for me to lean on.
He fell asleep on my shoulder.
exampleZh: 把你的肩膀借给我让我依靠。
他倚着我的肩膀睡着了。

defsEn: n. an organization founded and united for a specific purpose
n. an establishment consisting of a building or complex of buildings where an organization for the promotion of some cause is situated
n. a custom that for a long time has been an important feature of some group or society
zh: n. 机构, 惯例, 制度
examples: In the heart of the city, there is an institution with a golden history.
The most important institution of society besides the family is the school.

defsEn: a. delighting the senses or exciting intellectual or emotional admiration
s. (of weather) highly enjoyable
zh: a. 美丽的
examples: You get more and more beautiful every day.
Tell a beautiful story to my young friend.
exampleZh: 你一天比一天漂亮。
给我年轻的朋友讲个美丽的故事。

defsEn: n. miscellaneous unspecified objects
n. informal terms for personal possessions
n. senseless talk
n. unspecified qualities required to do or be something
zh: n. 原料, 要素, 东西, 材料, 素质, 织品, 废物, 废话
vt. 装填
vi. 狼吞虎咽
examples: Can't you move your stuff to the other room?
This stuff is worth its weight in gold!
exampleZh: 你不能把你的东西搬去另一个房间吗？
这个东西很有价值。

defsEn: v. manifest or bring back
v. to throw or bend back (from a surface)
v. be bright by reflecting or casting light
v. show an image of
zh: vt. 反射, 反映, 招致, 深思
vi. 被反射, 映出, 深思, 考虑, 指责
examples: The relationships of socialisers are often reflected in the distance between them.
I reflect on what it means to be alive.
exampleZh: 交际者的关系往往会反映在他们之间的距离上。

defsEn: a. not given to gentleness or sentimentality
a. physically toughened
a. resistant to cutting or chewing
zh: n. 恶棍
a. 强硬的, 艰苦的, 坚固的, 坚韧的, 粗暴的, 咬不动的
examples: I think that, in tough times, you can cry as much as you want.
Since then, he lives a tough life.
exampleZh: 我想, 在艰难的时候, 你想哭就使劲哭吧。
自此之后，他过着艰难的生活。

defsEn: n. a model considered worthy of imitation
v. form a pattern
zh: n. 模范, 典型, 式样, 样品, 图案, 格调, 模式
vt. 模仿, 仿造, 以图案装饰
vi. 形成图案
examples: These eating patterns are a learned behavior.
He thought that he saw a pattern.
exampleZh: 这些进食模式是习得性行为。

defsEn: n. an active and efficient cause
capable of producing a certain effect
n. a representative who acts on behalf of other persons or organizations
n. a substance that exerts some force or effect
n. a businessman who buys or sells for another in exchange for a commission
zh: n. 代理商, 政府代表, 动原, 媒介
examples: Get in touch with your agent right away.
A travel agent will arrange an excursion to Andalusia for you.
exampleZh: 立刻联络你的经纪人。
旅行社会为你安排去安达卢西亚的旅行。

defsEn: n. a commercially sponsored ad on radio or television
a. connected with or engaged in or sponsored by or used in commerce or commercial enterprises
a. of or relating to commercialism
s. of the kind or quality used in commerce
average or inferior
zh: a. 商业的, 商用的, 商品化的
n. 商业广告节目
examples: After the commercial break, we'll see the second part of the fight.
I'm sick of hearing this commercial over and over again.

defsEn: n. (computer science) the code that identifies where a piece of information is stored
n. the place where a person or organization can be found or communicated with
n. the act of delivering a formal spoken communication to an audience
n. the manner of speaking to another individual
zh: n. 住址, 演说, 举止, 灵巧, 求爱
vt. 发表(演说或讲话), 对付, 写地址
examples: Write your name and address on this envelope.
I asked her for her address.
exampleZh: 把你的姓名和地址写在这个信封上。
我向她问了她的地址。

defsEn: n. (sports) someone in charge of training an athlete or a team
n. a person who gives private instruction (as in singing, acting, etc.)
n. a carriage pulled by four horses with one driver
v. teach and supervise (someone)
act as a trainer or coach (to), as in sports
zh: n. 四轮大马车, 教练
vt. 训练, 指导
vi. 坐马车旅行, 作指导
examples: My coach said, "Failure teaches success."
She liked tennis and became a tennis coach.
exampleZh: 我的教练说：「失败乃成功之母。」
她喜欢网球并成为了一个网球教练。

defsEn: n. a unit of length equal to 3 feet
defined as 91.44 centimeters
originally taken to be the average length of a stride
n. the enclosed land around a house or other building
n. a tract of land enclosed for particular activities (sometimes paved and usually associated with buildings)
n. a tract of land where logs are accumulated
zh: n. 码, 庭院, 工场
examples: Tom cut down a tree in his yard.
My house has a small yard.
exampleZh: 汤姆在后院砍伐了一棵树。
我的房子有一个小院子。

defsEn: v. have a tendency or disposition to do or be something
be inclined
v. have care of or look after
v. manage or run
zh: vi. 走向, 有某种的倾向, 易于, 照顾, 注意
vt. 照料, 护理
examples: Young people tend to take things too far.
People tend to look at others with prejudice.
exampleZh: 青年人总爱挑战极端。
人们趋向于带着偏见看待他人。

defsEn: n. money that is invested with an expectation of profit
n. the commitment of something other than money (time, energy, or effort) to a project with the expectation of some worthwhile result
n. outer layer or covering of an organ or part or organism
n. the act of putting on robes or vestments
zh: n. 投资
examples: Tom doubled his investment in a year.
The return on the investment will be high.
exampleZh: 汤姆一年内增加了一倍的投资。

defsEn: n. an extended communication (often interactive) dealing with some particular topic
n. an exchange of views on some topic
zh: n. 讨论
examples: You'd better avoid discussion of religion and politics.
I would like to have a discussion with Mr. Zhang and Mr. Li.
exampleZh: 你最好别提到宗教和政治这些话题。
我要和张先生、李先生谈谈。

defsEn: n. a plot of ground where plants are cultivated
n. the flowers or vegetables or fruits or herbs that are cultivated in a garden
n. a yard or lawn adjoining a house
v. work in the garden
zh: n. 花园, 果园, 菜园
vi. 栽培花木
vt. 造园
a. 花园的, 普通的
examples: I found him working in the garden.
He found a ball in the garden.
exampleZh: 我发现他在花园里干活。
他在花园里找到了一颗球。

defsEn: n. an announcement containing information about an event
n. the act of noticing or paying attention
n. advance notification (usually written) of the intention to withdraw from an arrangement of contract
n. polite or favorable attention
zh: n. 注意, 布告, 通知, 预告, 短评
vt. 注意, 通知, 评论, 提及, 关注
vi. 注意
examples: The notice in the park said "Keep off the grass".
She took no notice of what her father said.
exampleZh: 公园的告示牌上写着「请勿践踏草地」。
她把她父亲的话都当成了耳边风。

defsEn: n. several things grouped together or considered as a whole
n. a publication containing a variety of works
n. the act of gathering something together
zh: n. 收集, 采集, (一批)收藏品, 募捐
examples: I have a large collection of stamps.
I need this to round out my collection.
exampleZh: 我收集很多邮票。

defsEn: n. a room equipped for preparing meals
zh: n. 厨房, 全套炊具
examples: Can you change the kitchen light bulb before you leave?
We have breakfast in the kitchen.
exampleZh: 您离开前能帮忙换一下厨房的灯泡吗？
我们在厨房里吃早餐。

defsEn: n. a person who uses goods or services
zh: n. 消费者
examples: In general, consumers prefer quantity to quality.
Europeans are the largest consumers of alcohol in the world.
exampleZh: 一般来说，消费者喜欢数量胜于质量。
欧洲人是世界上最大的酒精消费者。

defsEn: n. a solid missile discharged from a firearm
n. a chance to do something
n. a person who shoots (usually with respect to their ability to shoot)
n. an aggressive remark directed at a person like a missile and intended to have a telling effect
zh: n. 发射, 炮弹, 射击, 射手, 投篮, 射门, 子弹, 射程, 拍摄, 注射
vt. 装弹, 使成颗粒状
a. 杂色的, 交织着的, 渗透的, 点焊的, 破旧的
shoot的过去式和过去分词
examples: One morning I shot an elephant in my pyjamas.
This shot will help numb the pain.
exampleZh: 一天早晨我穿着睡衣射了一头大象
打了这针，你就不会那么痛了。

defsEn: n. graphic art consisting of an artistic composition made by applying paints to a surface
n. creating a picture with paints
n. the act of applying paint to a surface
n. the occupation of a house painter
zh: n. 画, 绘画, 油漆
examples: His paintings seem strange to me.
Picasso's paintings seem strange to me.
exampleZh: 我觉得他的画有点奇怪。
毕加索的画对我来说似乎很奇怪。

defsEn: n. the statement (oral or written) of an exchange of promises
n. compatibility of observations
n. harmony of people's opinions or actions or characters
n. the thing arranged or agreed to
zh: n. 同意, 合约, 协议
examples: There is not one person who is in agreement with the plan.
I'm not in agreement with your methods at all.
exampleZh: 赞成计划的人一个也没有。
我完全不认可你的方法。

defsEn: n. the opening through which food is taken in and vocalizations emerge
n. the externally visible part of the oral cavity on the face and the system of organs surrounding the opening
n. an opening that resembles a mouth (as of a cave or a gorge)
n. the point where a stream issues into a larger body of water
zh: n. 嘴, 口, 口腔, 口状物
vi. 装腔作势说话, 做鬼脸
vt. 说出, 做作地说
examples: You must not speak with your mouth full.
You must not talk with your mouth full.
exampleZh: 嘴里有东西的时候不准说话。
嘴里有东西的时候不准说话。

defsEn: n. a daily or weekly publication on folded sheets
contains news and articles and advertisements
n. a business firm that publishes newspapers
n. the physical object that is the product of a newspaper publisher
n. cheap paper made from wood pulp and used for printing newspapers
zh: n. 报纸
examples: I read about him in the newspaper.
I saw it in the newspaper.
exampleZh: 我在报纸上读到有关他的消息。
我在报纸上看到了它。

defsEn: n. a warning that something unpleasant is imminent
n. declaration of an intention or a determination to inflict harm on another
zh: n. 恐吓, 恶兆, 威胁
examples: We thought his threat was only a joke.
I am not in the least afraid of his threats.
exampleZh: 我们觉得他的威胁只是一个玩笑。
我一点也不怕他威胁。

defsEn: n. a form of trustworthiness
the trait of being answerable to someone for something or being responsible for one's conduct
zh: n. 责任, 职责, 负担, 可靠性
examples: I take full responsibility for the action.
You must take responsibility for your own careless actions.
exampleZh: 我会为这次行动负起全责。
您必须为您自己不小心的行为负责。

defsEn: n a professional person authorized to practice law
conducts lawsuits or gives legal advice
zh: n. 代理人, 律师
examples: We need an attorney with experience in unconventional means.
I want to speak with my attorney, now.

defsEn: n. a written form of a musical composition
parts for different instruments appear on separate staves on large pages
n. a number that expresses the accomplishment of a team or an individual in a game or contest
n. a set of twenty members
n. grounds
zh: n. 得分, 抓痕, 二十个, 刻痕, 帐目, 乐谱, 起跑线, 终点线, 大量
vt. 刻划, 划线, 获得, 评价, 把...记下
vi. 刻痕, 记分, 得分
examples: I got a low score on the test.
He got a better score than us.
exampleZh: 测试我考了低分。
他得到了比我们还高的分数。

defsEn: n. a formal contractual relationship established to provide for regular banking or brokerage or business services
n. importance or value
n. a statement of recent transactions and the resulting balance
n. the quality of taking advantage
zh: n. 报告, 解释, 估价, 理由, 利润, 算账, 帐目
vi. 报帐, 解释, 导致, 报偿, 占, 杀死
vt. 认为
examples: How do you account for your being late?
How do you account for your absence?
exampleZh: 你怎么解释你的迟到？
你怎么解释你缺席的原因？

defsEn: n. a gathering of spectators or listeners at a (usually public) performance
n. the part of the general public interested in a source of information or entertainment
zh: n. 听众, 观众, 读者
examples: The whole audience erupted in laughter.
The whole audience got up and started to applaud.
exampleZh: 哄堂大笑。
所有的观众都站起来鼓掌。

defsEn: n. a film about life in the western United States during the period of exploration and development
n. a sandwich made from a western omelet
a. relating to or characteristic of the western parts of the world or the West as opposed to the eastern or oriental parts
a. of or characteristic of regions of the United States west of the Mississippi River
zh: n. 西方人, 西部片, 西部小说
a. 向西方的, 来自西方的, 西方的, 西洋的, 西部的
examples: Japan needed contact with the Western countries.
I live in a Western-style house.
exampleZh: 日本有必要和西方各国接触。

defsEn: v. give an account of
v. be in a relationship with
v. have or establish a relationship to
zh: vt. 讲, 叙述, 使互相关联
vi. 有关, 符合, 相处得好
examples: I hate the English language and everything related to it.
Almost everyone in our village is related to one another.
exampleZh: 我讨厌英语和一切和英语有关的东西。
我们村里所有的村民几乎彼此都是亲戚。

defsEn: n. an undergraduate student during the year preceding graduation
a. older
higher in rank
longer in length of tenure or service
s. used of the fourth and final year in United States high school or college
zh: n. 年长者, 资深者, 毕业班学生
a. 年长的, 高级的, 资深的
examples: She gave her seat to a senior citizen.
Are you a senior high school student?
exampleZh: 她把她的座位让给了一个老人。
你是个高中生吗?

defsEn: n. metal device shaped in such a way that when it is inserted into the appropriate lock the lock's mechanism can be rotated
n. something crucial for explaining
n. pitch of the voice
n. any of 24 major or minor diatonic scales that provide the tonal framework for a piece of music
zh: n. 钥匙, 键, 解答, 关键, 要害, 基调, 线索, 答案, 暗礁
vt. 调音, 锁上, 提供线索
vi. 使用钥匙
examples: He put the key on the table as usual.
Do you have the key to this door?
exampleZh: 他习惯性地将钥匙放在了桌子上。
你有这扇门的钥匙吗？

defsEn: n. an organization of missionaries in a foreign land sent to carry on religious work
n. an operation that is assigned by a higher headquarters
n. a special assignment that is given to a person or group
n. the organized work of a religious missionary
zh: n. 任务, 代表团, 使命, 传教团
vt. 派遣, 向...传教
examples: Who picked you for this mission?
I am charged with an important mission.
exampleZh: 谁选你来做这个任务？
我身负一个重要的任务。

defsEn: n. someone who pays for goods or services
zh: n. 消费者
examples: We need to improve our customer service.
If you would like to speak to a customer service representative, please press three.
exampleZh: 我们需要改进我们的客服业务。
如果想与客服代表通话，请按三。

defsEn: a. having succeeded or being marked by a favorable outcome
zh: a. 成功的, 一帆风顺的, 顺利的
examples: The party was, on the whole, successful.
On the whole, the event was successful.
exampleZh: 这个派对真成功。
整体而言，这个事件是成功的。

defsEn: n. someone who takes part in an activity
zh: n. 参加者, 参与者
a. 有份的, 参加的, 参与的
examples: The participants were for the most part women.
There are thousands of participants at today's event.
exampleZh: 参与者大部分是女性。
有成千的人来参加今天的集会。

defsEn: r after an unspecified period of time or an especially long delay
zh: adv. 最后, 终于
examples: Eventually I'd like to settle down and have a family, but not yet.
I eventually got used to it.
exampleZh: 我会找个地方安顿下来，然后结婚生子的，但这是以后的事。
最后我还是习惯了。

defsEn: s. involving the entire earth
not limited or provincial in scope
zh: a. 通用的, 全球的, 球形的, 综合的, 普遍的
examples: Due to global warming, cities could be completely submerged.
With global warming, the amount of ice melting in Antarctica is increasing.
exampleZh: 由于全球气候变暖，城市可能被完全地淹没。
随着全球气温变暖，南极大陆的融冰量也日益增加。

defsEn: a. marked by a tendency to find and call attention to errors and flaws
a. at or of a point at which a property or phenomenon suffers an abrupt change especially having enough mass to sustain a chain reaction
a. characterized by careful evaluation and judgment
s. urgently needed
absolutely necessary
zh: a. 批评的, 决定性的, 危险的, 临界的
examples: Your mother is in critical condition.
I can't understand why you are so critical of him.
exampleZh: 你母亲现在情况危殆。
我不明白为什么你这么批评他。

defsEn: a. feeling or showing worry or solicitude
s. involved in or affected by or having a claim to or share in
zh: a. 关心的, 有关的, 参与的, 担心的
examples: Thank you for being concerned about my mental health.
For the first time I saw your father very concerned.

defsEn: n. a request by the manufacturer of a defective product to return the product (as for replacement or repair)
n. a call to return
n. a bugle call that signals troops to return
n. the process of remembering (especially the process of recovering information by mental effort)
zh: n. 回忆, 召回, 撤消
vt. 回想, 回忆, 召回, 撤消, 使恢复
examples: I recall less and less of my childhood.
I can't recall her name at the moment.
exampleZh: 我对童年的记忆越来越模糊了.
我突然想不起她的名字。

defsEn: n. a fixed look with eyes open wide
v. fixate one's eyes
zh: vi. 注视, 凝视, 瞪视, 显眼
vt. 盯
n. 凝视
examples: It's rude to stare at someone.
It's impolite to stare at people.
exampleZh: 盯着别人看是不礼貌的。
盯着人看是不礼貌的。

defsEn: n. the state of being certain that adverse effects will not be caused by some agent under defined conditions
n. a safe place
n. a score in American football
a player is tackled behind his own goal line
zh: n. 安全, 保险, 平安, 保安设备
vt. 保护, 防护
examples: We are anxious about her safety.
Safety is the most important thing.
exampleZh: 我们为她的安全担忧。
安全是最重要的事情。

defsEn: a. producing or capable of producing an intended result or having a striking effect
s. able to accomplish a purpose
functioning effectively
s. works well as a means or remedy
s. exerting force or influence
zh: a. 有效的, 有力的, 实际的
n. 有生力量
examples: This is a fast and effective way of communication.
This poison is very effective in getting rid of roaches.
exampleZh: 这是快速且有效的交流方式。
这毒药用来治蟑螂很有效。

defsEn: n. something that serves as a model or a basis for making copies
s. preceding all others in time or being as first made or performed
s. (of e.g. information) not secondhand or by way of something intermediary
a. being or productive of something fresh and unusual
or being as first made or thought of
zh: a. 最初的, 原始的, 有创意的
n. 原物, 原作
examples: The original sentence means the opposite.
Her hair grew back to its original length.
exampleZh: 意义的原句是相反。
她的头发长回原来的长度了。

defsEn: n. a group of soldiers
n. a cavalry unit corresponding to an infantry company
n. a unit of Girl or Boy Scouts
n. an orderly crowd
zh: n. 军队, 一群, 一队
vi. 群集, 结队, 成群而行
examples: The Soviet troops have started the withdrawal from Afghanistan.
Our troops were constantly attacked by the guerrillas.
exampleZh: 苏联军队开始从阿富汗撤军了。
我们军队总是被游击队骚扰。

defsEn: n. (biology) taxonomic group whose members can interbreed
n. a specific kind of something
zh: n. 种, 类, 外形
examples: This species of butterfly has already gone extinct.
Butterflies of this species are now extinct.
exampleZh: 这种种类的蝴蝶已经绝种了。
这品种的蝴蝶现在已经绝种了。

defsEn: r. without delay or hesitation
with no time intervening
r. near or close by
r. bearing an immediate relation
zh: adv. 直接地, 立刻, 立即
examples: I have to speak with you immediately.
We need to do it immediately.
exampleZh: 我必须马上和你说话。
我们需要马上行动。

defsEn: n. a pair of parallel rails providing a runway for wheels
n. an endless metal belt on which tracked vehicles move over the ground
n. (computer science) one of the circular magnetic paths on a magnetic disk that serve as a guide for writing and reading data
n. a groove on a phonograph recording
zh: n. 轨迹, 足迹, 径迹, 小道, 轨道, 磁轨, 途径
vt. 循路而行, 追踪, 通过, 用纤拉
vi. 追踪, 留下足迹, 沿轨道运行
examples: They found the track of a bear in the snow.
The tracks run parallel to the road.
exampleZh: 他们在雪地里找到了熊的脚印。
铁路与公路平行。

defsEn: n. a popular programming language that is relatively easy to learn
an acronym for beginner's all-purpose symbolic instruction code
no longer in general use
n. (usually plural) a necessary commodity for which demand is constant
a. pertaining to or constituting a base or basis
s. reduced to the simplest and most significant form possible without loss of generality
zh: n. 基本原理, 要素, 基本规律
a. 基本的, 碱性的
(计算机)BASIC语言
examples: Do you not understand basic logic?
I think your basic theory is wrong.
exampleZh: 你不懂基本逻辑吗？
我认为你的基本理论是错的。

defsEn: r. completely and without qualification
used informally as intensifiers
r. totally and definitely
without question
zh: adv. 完全地, 绝对地, 确确实实地
examples: We have absolutely nothing in common.
It's absolutely impossible for me to go on like this.
exampleZh: 我们完全没有共同点。
让我像这样继续下去是绝对不可能的。

defsEn: n. (mathematics) an unbounded two-dimensional shape
n. a level of existence or development
n. a power tool for smoothing or shaping wood
n. a carpenter's hand tool with an adjustable blade for smoothing or shaping wood
zh: n. 平面, 扁平物, 机翼, 飞机, 水准, 地位
a. 平的, 平面的
vt. 将...刨平, 刨平, 掠过水面
vi. 翱翔, 乘飞机旅行, 刨掉
examples: The plane will take off in one hour.
Can I eat on the plane?
exampleZh: 飞机将在一小时后起飞。
飞机上可以吃东西吗？

defsEn: v. be relevant to
v. think of, regard, or classify under a subsuming principle or with a general group or in relation to another
v. send or direct for treatment, information, or a decision
v. use a name to designate
zh: vt. 提交, 归诸于, 把...提交, 使求助于
vi. 提到, 涉及, 查阅, 查询, 咨询
examples: Refer to the dictionary as often as possible.
While in England, I often referred to the guidebook for details of my journey.
exampleZh: 尽可能多点查字典。
我在英国的时候，经常翻阅旅游指南，查询旅途中的相关细节。

defsEn: n. a person who seeks the advice of a lawyer
zh: n. 客户, 顾客, 委托人
examples: The investor stole the capital of his client.
The lawyer warned his client against testifying, but he did it anyway.
exampleZh: 投资者把他客户的资金窃取了.
律师警告过他的当事人反对作证, 但是他还是这么做了。

defsEn: r. (used to introduce a logical conclusion) from that fact or reason or as a result
zh: adv. 因此, 所以
examples: Therefore, other people's ways of thinking might not be suited to you.
I need to forget, therefore I drink.
exampleZh: 所以别人的思想方法用在你身上不一定有效。

defsEn: n. the use of speech for informal exchange of views or ideas or information etc.
zh: n. 会话, 说话, 交谈
examples: In conversation among the small grasses, do not offend the big tree.
As their conversation was in French, I could not understand a word.
exampleZh: 小草间的对话不要得罪大树。
因为他们是用法语谈话的，所以我一句也听不懂。

defsEn: n. (biology) a taxonomic category consisting of members of a species that differ from others of the same species in minor but heritable characteristics
n. a difference that is usually pleasant
zh: n. 多样, 种类, 变种, 杂耍
examples: There was a great variety of dishes on the menu.
We talked about a variety of topics.
exampleZh: 菜单上有各种各样的菜色。
我们谈了各种话题。

defsEn: a. connected by participation or association or use
s. entangled or hindered as if e.g. in mire
s. emotionally involved
s. enveloped
zh: a. 难懂的, 复杂的, 不易懂的, 卷入...之中的, 累及..., 与...有关, 被纠缠的
examples: He told me not to get involved in this.
I want to get involved with business strategy.

defsEn: n. the work of inquiring into something thoroughly and systematically
zh: n. 调查, 审查
examples: No investigation, no right to speak.
Mary knew she was under investigation.
exampleZh: 没有调查就没有发言权。
玛丽知道她被侦查。

defsEn: v. substitute a person or thing for (another that is broken or inefficient or lost or no longer working or yielding what is expected)
v. put something back where it belongs
zh: vt. 代替, 替换, 放回, 归还
examples: Please replace the empty ink cartridge in the printer.
He left to replace his father.
exampleZh: 请把打印机里面的空的墨粉鼓换掉。
他代替他的父亲去。

defsEn: n. the people of Great Britain
a. of or relating to or characteristic of Great Britain or its people or culture
zh: a. 英国的
n. 英国人, 英国英语
examples: The British have a lot of respect for law and order.
Please use British English in your text.
exampleZh: 英国人很尊重法序和秩序。
请你这篇文章用英式英语。

defsEn: v. inspire with confidence
give hope or courage to
v. spur on
zh: vt. 鼓励, 支持, 激励
examples: My father encouraged me to study the piano.
Me? Encourage you to work? Blasphemy!
exampleZh: 我的父亲鼓励我去学钢琴。
我？鼓励你去工作？不可能！

defsEn: n. a fact or assertion offered as evidence that something is true
n. a discussion in which reasons are advanced for and against some proposition or proposal
n. a summary of the subject or plot of a literary work or play or movie
n. (computer science) a reference or value that is passed to a function, procedure, subroutine, command, or program
zh: n. 争论, 论证, 论据, 自变量
examples: An argument may be logically sound without being true.
It was an argument of little substance.
exampleZh: 不正确的命题听起来可能符合逻辑。
这是一场没有实质内容的争论。

defsEn: n. a time period usually extending from Friday night through Sunday
more loosely defined as any period of successive days including one and only one Sunday
v. spend the weekend
zh: n. 周末, 周末休假
examples: I wish I could see you at the weekend.
This weekend we can make telephone calls for free.
exampleZh: 真希望能在周末见到你。
这个周末我们可以免费打电话。

defsEn: n. promise of reimbursement in the case of loss
paid to people or companies so concerned about hazards that they have made prepayments to an insurance company
zh: n. 保险, 保险业, 保险费
examples: What's the name of your insurance company?
Why did you buy travel insurance?
exampleZh: 你的保险公司叫什么名字？
为什么你买了旅行保险？

defsEn: n. a specialized division of a large organization
n. the territorial and administrative division of some countries (such as France)
n. a specialized sphere of knowledge
zh: n. 部门, 系, 机关
examples: Go to the history department or education department.
I bought a coat and a jacket at the department store.
exampleZh: 去历史系或者教育系。
我在百货公司买了大衣和夹克

defsEn: n. the event consisting of the start of something
n. the time at which something is supposed to begin
n. the first part or section of something
n. the place where something begins, where it springs into being
zh: n. 开始
examples: Buddhism had its beginnings in India.
Resist the beginnings: the remedy usually comes too late.
exampleZh: 佛教起源于印度。

defsEn: r. without distinction of one from others
zh: adv. 通常, 逐渐地, 普遍地
examples: We generally drink tea after a meal.
The Alps are generally lower on the Italian side.
exampleZh: 我们通常饭后喝茶。
阿尔卑斯山脉义大利一侧的海拔通常较低。

defsEn: n. a native or inhabitant of Africa
a. of or relating to the nations of Africa or their peoples
zh: n. 非洲人
a. 非洲的, 非洲人的
examples: The African ground squirrels collaborate and are not aggressive to other mammals.
The North African human smugglers use the Italian navy as a travel agency.
exampleZh: 非洲地松鼠互帮互助，对其他哺乳动物没有攻击性。

defsEn: n. any of the Sino-Tibetan languages spoken in China
regarded as dialects of a single language (even though they are mutually unintelligible) because they share an ideographic writing system
n. a native or inhabitant of Communist China or of Nationalist China
a. of or pertaining to China or its peoples or cultures
zh: n. 中文, 中国话, 中国人
a. 中国的, 中国话的
examples: When I speak Chinese, I start to feel at ease.
I want to learn Chinese next year.
exampleZh: 我说中文的时候，开始感到自在了。
我明年想学汉语.

defsEn: n. a homogeneous mixture of two or more substances
frequently (but not necessarily) a liquid solution
n. a statement that solves a problem or explains how to solve the problem
n. a method for solving a problem
n. the set of values that give a true statement when substituted into an equation
zh: n. 解决, 解答, 溶液
examples: Please find a solution to the problem.
He thought of a good solution.
exampleZh: 请找到问题的解决方法。
他想到了一个解决的好办法。

defsEn: n. an ordered reference standard
n. relative magnitude
n. the ratio between the size of something and a representation of it
n. a specialized leaf or bract that protects a bud or catkin
zh: n. 刻度, 衡量, 比例, 比例尺, 数值范围, 等级, 规模, 天平, 秤, 鳞, 积垢
vt. 依比例决定, 攀登, 测量, 绘制, 刮鳞, 使生垢, 过秤
vi. 剥落, 生水垢, 重量为, 攀登, 衡量
examples: I weighed myself on the bathroom scales.
Can you stand on the scale, please?
exampleZh: 我用浴室的体重计量了体重。

defsEn: n. the operator of a motor vehicle
n. someone who drives animals that pull a vehicle
n. a golfer who hits the golf ball with a driver
n. (computer science) a program that determines how a computer will communicate with a peripheral device
zh: n. 驾驶员, 驱动器, 驱动程序
examples: You must have a driver's license before you can drive a car.
The driver does not have responsibility for the traffic accident.
exampleZh: 没有驾驶执照不能开车。
司机不需要为这次的交通意外负责。

defsEn: n. a short section or illustration (as between radio or tv programs or in a magazine) that is often used for advertising
n. a small contrasting part of something
n. a section of an entertainment that is assigned to a specific performer or performance
n. a business establishment for entertainment
zh: n. 污点, 地点, 斑点, 点, 娱乐场所, 处境, 少量
a. 当场的, 现场的, 现货买卖的, 现金交易的, 抽样的
vt. 点缀, 玷污, 认出, 准确定...的位, 用灯光照射
vi. 玷污, (从空中)侦察敌方目标
examples: A cold beer would hit the spot!
He is good at spotting young talent.
exampleZh: 来杯冰啤酒就太棒了！
他善于在青年中识拔人才。

defsEn: n. the appendage to an object that is designed to be held in order to use or move it
v. touch, lift, or hold with the hands
v. show and train
zh: n. 柄, 把手, 把柄, 柄状物, 手感
vt. 触摸, 运用, 买卖, 处理, 操作
vi. 搬运, 易于操纵
n. 句柄
examples: You need to let me handle this.
I think I can handle that.
exampleZh: 你要让我来解决。
我觉得我能行。

defsEn: n income (at invoice values) received for goods and services over some given period of time
n a particular instance of selling
n the general activity of selling
n an occasion (usually brief) for buying at specially reduced prices
n the state of being purchasable
offered or exhibited for selling
n an agreement (or contract) in which property is transferred from the seller (vendor) to the buyer (vendee) for a fixed price in money (paid or agreed to be paid by the buyer)
zh: a. 销售的
examples: I have to set up a budget for sales promotion.
In proportion as the sales increase, the profit will rise.

defsEn: n. the activity of communicating
the activity of conveying information
n. something that is communicated by or to or between people or groups
n. a connection allowing access between persons or places
zh: n. 交流, 交通, 通讯
examples: The communication of news by TV and radio is very common now.
English is a means of communication.
exampleZh: 这个年代用电视和收音机报道新闻已是十分平常的事了。
英语是一种沟通的手段。

defsEn: n. a white or silvered surface where pictures can be projected for viewing
n. the display that is electronically created on the surface of the large end of a cathode-ray tube
n. a covering that serves to conceal or shelter something
n. a protective covering consisting of netting
can be mounted in a frame
zh: n. 幕, 银幕, 屏风, 掩蔽物, 屏蔽, 筛子
vt. 掩蔽, 放映, 拍摄, 掩护, 筛, 甄别
vi. 拍电影
examples: This computer has a sharp screen.
It's just a blip on a screen.
exampleZh: 这台电脑的屏幕很清晰。
只是在屏幕上闪了一下。

defsEn: n. someone who lives at a particular place for a prolonged period or who was born there
a. living in a particular place
zh: n. 居民, 常驻程序, 居住者, 留鸟
a. 居留的, 定居的
examples: How many residents live within this city?
After the residents leave, the house is empty.
exampleZh: 这个城市里有多少居民？
居民走后，房子就空了。

defsEn: n. a formal association of people with similar interests
n. stout stick that is larger at one end
n. a playing card in the minor suit that has one or more black trefoils on it
v. unite with a common purpose
zh: n. 俱乐部, 木棍, 球棒
vt. 用棍棒打, 缴纳
vi. 联合起来
a. 俱乐部的
examples: Which club do you belong to?
I belong to a tennis club.
exampleZh: 你属于哪个社团？
我是网球具乐部的会员。

defsEn: n. a native or inhabitant of Europe
a. of or relating to or characteristic of Europe or the people of Europe
zh: n. 欧洲人
a. 欧洲的, 欧洲人的
examples: Esperanto, an official language of the European Union, now!
I live in the European side of Istanbul.
exampleZh: 请立即将世界语订为欧洲联盟的官方语言
我住在伊斯坦布尔的欧洲一侧。

defsEn: n. the state of being present
current existence
n. the immediate proximity of someone or something
n. an invisible spiritual being felt to be nearby
n. the impression that something is present
zh: n. 出席, 面前, 存在, 仪态, 风度
examples: I told you not to mention that in her presence.
John felt the presence of a ghost in the dark room.
exampleZh: 我跟你说过她在的时候不要说这件事。
约翰感觉到那黑漆漆的房间里有鬼。

defsEn: n. a region marked off for administrative or other purposes
zh: n. 区域, 地方
examples: What is the size of this district's greenery area?
I was born in Baoshan District.
exampleZh: 这片小区的绿地面积有多少？
我生于宝山区。

defsEn: n. a religious person who believes Jesus is the Christ and who is a member of a Christian denomination
a. relating to or characteristic of Christianity
a. following the teachings or manifesting the qualities or spirit of Jesus Christ
zh: n. 基督徒, 正派人
a. 基督的, 基督教的
examples: Can a person be Christian without going to church?
Tom is a Christian in name only. He never goes to church.
exampleZh: 一个人不去教堂也能算是基督徒吗？
汤姆名义上是基督徒。他从来不去做礼拜。

defsEn: n. a suite of rooms usually on one floor of an apartment house
zh: n. 房间, 公寓
examples: I live in an apartment in the city.
She lives with him in a small apartment.
exampleZh: 我住在城市中的一间公寓里。
她和他共住在一间很小的公寓里。

defsEn: n. the property of being physically or mentally strong
n. the condition of financial success
zh: n. 力量, 实力, 强度, 浓度, 人数, 抵抗力
examples: He pulled with all his strength, but the rock would not move.
It is not just to prefer strength to good wisdom.
exampleZh: 他用尽全力地拉，但那块大石还是纹丝不动。
相比于智慧更偏爱力量是不公平的。

defsEn: n. instrumentalists not including string players
n. a stripe or stripes of contrasting color
n. an adornment consisting of a strip of a contrasting color or material
n. a range of frequencies between two limits
zh: n. 带子, 队, 乐队
v. 联合, 结合
examples: Listen to the bands near you.
The workers banded together to go on strike and fight the company.

defsEn: n status with respect to the relations between people or groups
n the amount of money needed to purchase something
n a word or expression used for some particular thing
n a limited period of time
n (usually plural) a statement of what is required as part of an agreement
n any distinct quantity contained in a polynomial
n one of the substantive phrases in a logical proposition
n the end of gestation or point at which birth is imminent
n (architecture) a statue or a human bust or an animal carved out of the top of a square pillar
originally used as a boundary marker in ancient Rome
v name formally or designate with a term
zh: n. 条件, 条款, 费用, 价钱, 关系, 地位, 交谊
examples: It would be better to agree to the terms.
You just have to come to terms with it.

defsEn: v. deliver (a speech, oration, or idea)
v. bring to a destination, make a delivery
v. utter (an exclamation, noise, etc.)
v. save from sins
zh: vt. 递送, 陈述, 释放, 发表, 引渡, 投递, 交付
examples: We will deliver up to the airport of the island.
Please deliver it to this address.
exampleZh: 我们将移交至岛上的机场。
你能把它送到这个地址吗？

defsEn: n. a formation of aircraft in flight
n. an instance of traveling by air
n. a stairway (set of steps) between one floor or landing and the next
n. an air force unit smaller than a squadron
zh: n. 飞行, 射程, 逃走, 飞跃, 飞机航程, 班机, 迁徙, 飞逝
vi. 迁徙
vt. 射击(飞禽), 为(箭)装上羽毛, 使惊飞
examples: Please show your flight ticket and passport.
How many flights to New York do you offer a day?
exampleZh: 请你出示你的机票和护照。
你们一天提供几班飞往纽约的航班？

defsEn: n. a building or place that provides a particular service or is used for a particular industry
n. a natural effortlessness
n. something designed and created to serve a particular function and to afford a particular convenience or service
n. a service that an organization or a piece of equipment offers you
zh: n. 容易, 灵巧, 设备
examples: He wrote a letter with great facility.
This building is not a research facility.

defsEn: n. the cognitive condition of someone who understands
s. characterized by understanding based on comprehension and discernment and empathy
zh: n. 理解, 谅解
examples: We can create a more harmonious and understanding world.
I have a hard time understanding what they say.

defsEn: n. the activity of leading
n. the body of people who lead a group
n. the status of a leader
n. the ability to lead
zh: n. 领导能力, 领导阶层
examples: The students admire her leadership skills.
Tom was born with leadership ability.
exampleZh: 学生们佩服她的领导能力。
汤姆天生具有领导能力。

defsEn: n. 16 ounces avoirdupois
n. a unit of apothecary weight equal to 12 ounces troy
n. a nontechnical unit of force equal to the mass of 1 pound with an acceleration of free fall equal to 32 feet/sec/sec
n. United States writer who lived in Europe
strongly influenced the development of modern literature (1885-1972)
zh: n. 磅, 英镑, 重击, 鱼塘, 拘留所, 兽栏
vt. 强烈打击, 捣烂, 监禁, 关入栏内
vi. 连续重击, 苦干
examples: We bought a pound of tea.
The manager reprimanded the man by pounding on the table.
exampleZh: 我们买了一磅的茶。
经理以重击桌子来斥责那名男子。

defsEn: n. the fundamental assumptions from which something is begun or developed or calculated or explained
n. the most important or necessary part of something
zh: n. 基础, 主要成分
examples: Your theory has no scientific basis.
There is no scientific basis for these claims.
exampleZh: 你的理论并没有科学根据。
这些主张没有科学的根据。

defsEn: n. a visitor to whom hospitality is extended
n. United States journalist (born in England) noted for his syndicated homey verse (1881-1959)
n. a customer of a hotel or restaurant etc.
zh: n. 客人, 来宾, 旅客
examples: A guest should not try to make himself superior to the host.
Please serve the guests some coffee, dear.
exampleZh: 强宾不压主。
亲爱的，给客人端点咖啡吧。

defsEn: n. a small part of something intended as representative of the whole
n. all or part of a natural object that is collected and preserved as an example of its class
v. take a sample of
zh: n. 样品, 范例, 样本
vt. 抽样, 尝试
examples: Would you show us some samples of your work?
Would you like a sample free of charge?
exampleZh: 可以给我们看看你的一些作品样本吗？

defsEn: s very small
zh: a. 很少的, 微小的
examples: He came from a tiny mountain town.
It's a tiny country that most people have never heard of.
exampleZh: 他来自一个小山城。
那是一个许多人连听也没有听过的小国。

defsEn: n. the activity of protecting someone or something
n. the condition of being protected
n. the imposition of duties or quotas on imports in order to protect domestic industry against foreign competition
n. payment extorted by gangsters on threat of violence
zh: n. 保护, 防卫, 贸易保护制度
examples: We are responsible for your protection from now on.
He did not think he needed their protection.
exampleZh: 从此起我们为您的安全负责。
他认为他不需要他们的保护。

defsEn: s further or added
zh: a. 附加的, 另外的, 额外的
examples: We decided to stay an additional day.
If we take this additional evidence into consideration, the second law must be modified.
exampleZh: 我们决定多待一天。

defsEn: n. the distinct personality of an individual regarded as a persisting entity
n. the individual characteristics by which a thing or person is recognized or known
n. an operator that leaves unchanged the element on which it operates
n. exact sameness
zh: n. 身份, 相同, 一致, 特性, 恒等式
examples: Is a common European identity possible?
We know the identity of Tom's killer.
exampleZh: 欧洲人统一有可能吗？
我们知道汤姆的杀手是谁。

defsEn: n. a heading that names a statute or legislative bill
may give a brief summary of the matters it deals with
n. the name of a work of art or literary composition etc.
n. a general or descriptive heading for a section of a written work
n. an identifying appellation signifying status or function: e.g. `Mr.' or `General'
zh: n. 头衔, 名称, 标题, 书名, 扉页, 权利, 资格, 冠军, 字幕
vt. 授予头衔, 加标题于
examples: The novel takes its title from the Bible.
What is the title of your new book?
exampleZh: 这本小说的名字出自《圣经》。
你新书的书名是什么？

defsEn: r in large part
mainly or chiefly
r usually
as a rule
zh: adv. 大概, 大部分, 主要
examples: I mostly have fruit for breakfast.
I mostly agree with what he said.
exampleZh: 我早饭主要吃水果。

defsEn: n. complete confidence in a person or plan etc
n. loyalty or allegiance to a cause or a person
zh: n. 信心, 信任, 忠实, 保证
examples: I have complete faith in my doctor.
He had lost all faith in his ability to succeed.
exampleZh: 我绝对信任我的医生。
他完全丧失了能成功的信心。

defsEn: n. a mercantile establishment for the retail sale of goods or services
v. do one's shopping
v. shop around
not necessarily buying
zh: n. 商店, 工厂, 车间
vi. 购物, 到处寻找
vt. 选购
examples: Would you like to go shopping with me?
There used to be a shop here.
exampleZh: 你想和我一起去逛街吗？
这儿往前有所商店。

defsEn: n. people in general (often used in the plural)
zh: n. 人们, 家人, 亲属, 民族
a. 民间的
examples: Ordinary folk like us understand nothing about it anyway.
I used to like folk music.

defsEn: n. a business relation in which two parties compete to gain customers
n. the act of competing as for profit or a prize
zh: n. 竞争, 竞赛
examples: She won second place in the competition.
During this competition, he won first place.
exampleZh: 她在比赛中获得了第二名。
他在这次比赛中获得了冠军。

defsEn: n. a person who joins with others in some activity or endeavor
n. a person with subordinate membership in a society, institution, or commercial enterprise
n. any event that usually accompanies or is closely connected with another
v. make a logical or causal connection
zh: n. 同伴, 伙伴, 关联的事物
vt. 使联合, 使发生联系
vi. 交往
examples: We often associate black with death.
We associate the name of Einstein with the theory of relativity.
exampleZh: 我们常把黑色跟死亡联系起来。
一提到爱因斯坦，我们就会想起相对论。

defsEn: n. a person who is professionally engaged in the analysis and interpretation of works of art
n. anyone who expresses a reasoned judgment of something
n. someone who frequently finds fault or makes harsh and unfair judgments
zh: n. 批评家, 鉴定家
examples: This famous mountain climber is a critic of mass tourism.
What the critic says is always concise and to the point.
exampleZh: 这位著名的登山家批评大众旅游。

defsEn: v. be emphatic or resolute and refuse to budge
v. assert to be true
zh: v. 坚持, 坚决主张, 强调
examples: They insist that he should go.
My father insisted that I should go to see the place.
exampleZh: 他们坚持让他走。
我爸爸坚持要我去那地方看看。

defsEn: n. an act that fails
n. an event that does not accomplish its intended purpose
n. lack of success
n. a person with a record of failing
someone who loses consistently
zh: n. 失败, 失败者, 不足, 缺乏, 破产
examples: The failure in business left me penniless.
He is to blame for the failure.
exampleZh: 生意上的失败让我身无分文。
失败的责任在他。

defsEn: n. the Romance language spoken in France and in countries colonized by France
n. the people of France
n. United States sculptor who created the seated marble figure of Abraham Lincoln in the Lincoln Memorial in Washington D.C. (1850-1931)
zh: n. 法国人, 法文, 法式
a. 法国的, 法国人的, 法语的
examples: You never told me you could speak French.
I wish that I could speak French better.
exampleZh: 你从没告诉过我你会说法语。
我希望我能说法语说得更好。

defsEn: n. a usually secretive or illicit sexual relationship
n. a vaguely specified social event
zh: n. 事件, 事务, 恋爱事件
examples: We must study the affair as a whole.
I am not concerned with this affair.
exampleZh: 我们必须总体地研究这事件。
这件事与我无关。

defsEn: n. a particular course of action intended to achieve a result
n. a mode of conducting legal and parliamentary proceedings
zh: n. 程序, 过程, 手续
examples: Could you walk me through the procedure?
How long will the procedure take?

defsEn: n. a regular patron
n. a soldier in the regular army
n. a dependable follower (especially in party politics)
n. a garment size for persons of average height and weight
zh: a. 规则的, 常例的, 有秩序的, 整齐的, 等边的, 定期的, 经常的, 合格的, 常备军的
n. 正规军, 正式队员
adv. 经常地
n. 正常体
examples: She's not a regular employee of this company.
I'm just a regular office worker.
exampleZh: 她不是这间公司正式的职员。
我只是一个普通的上班族。

defsEn: n. a ball game played with a bat and ball between two teams of nine players
teams take turns at bat trying to score runs
n. a ball used in playing baseball
zh: n. 棒球
examples: I want to be a baseball player.
What do you play baseball for?
exampleZh: 我想成为一名棒球运动员。
你打棒球为的是什么？

defsEn: n. any cognitive content held as true
zh: n. 信念, 相信, 信仰
examples: I have a firm belief in his innocence.
It's my belief that knowledge is power.
exampleZh: 我坚信他是无辜的。
我相信，知识就是力量。

defsEn: n. an essay or article that gives a critical evaluation (as of a book or play)
n. (accounting) a service (less exhaustive than an audit) that provides some assurance to interested parties as to the reliability of financial data
n. a periodical that publishes critical essays on current affairs or literature or art
n. (law) a judicial reexamination of the proceedings of a court (especially by an appellate court)
zh: n. 检讨, 复习, 回顾, 检阅, 评论
vt. 温习, 检讨, 评论, 再检察, 复审
vi. 复习功课, 写评论
examples: Many of the user reviews on Amazon are fake.
