I will write a review of that book.
exampleZh: 亚马逊网站上的许多用户评论都是虚假的。

defsEn: n. a person responsible for the editorial aspects of publication
the person who determines the final content of a text (especially of a newspaper or magazine)
zh: n. 编者, 编辑, 主笔, 编辑器, 编辑装置
examples: You don't want to be an editor?
I need to speak to my editor.
exampleZh: 你不想做编辑？

defsEn: v. ask to represent
of legal counsel
v. get caught
v. carry on (wars, battles, or campaigns)
v. hire for work or assistance
zh: vi. 答应, 从事, 交战
vt. 使忙碌, 雇佣, 预定, 使从事于, 使参加
examples: My son is engaged to his secretary.
She is engaged to a rich man.
exampleZh: 我的儿子和他的秘书订婚了。
她和一个有钱人订了婚。

defsEn: n. the time of life between childhood and maturity
n. early maturity
the state of being young or immature or inexperienced
n. an early period of development
n. the freshness and vitality characteristic of a young person
zh: n. 年轻, 青年时代, 青年们, 青春
examples: When I hear that song I remember my youth.
In her youth, my mother was very beautiful.
exampleZh: 每次听到这首歌，都会让我回忆起自己年轻的时候。
我妈年轻的时候非常漂亮。

defsEn: n. a district of a city having some distinguishing character
n. (football, professional basketball) one of four divisions into which some games are divided
n. a unit of time equal to 15 minutes or a quarter of an hour
n. one of four periods into which the school year is divided
zh: n. 四分之一, 一刻钟, 季度, 地区
vt. 四等分, 肢解
vi. 驻扎, 住宿
examples: I have my supper at a quarter past seven.
It's now a quarter to three.
exampleZh: 我在七时十五分吃晚饭。
现在是两点四十五分。

defsEn: n. a person's social heritage: previous experience or training
n. the part of a scene (or picture) that lies behind objects in the foreground
n. information that is essential to understanding a situation or problem
n. extraneous signals that can be confused with the phenomenon to be observed or measured
zh: n. 背景, 背景资料
examples: There is a castle in the background of the picture.
In the background of the picture is a castle.
exampleZh: 图片的背景是一座城堡。
图片的背景是一座城堡。

defsEn: r. to a small degree or extent
zh: adv. 些微地, 苗条地
examples: How about we go to a slightly fancier restaurant?
He drunk wine, so he is slightly drunk.
exampleZh: 我们去一家档次再高点儿的餐厅怎么样？
他喝了酒，略有醉意。

defsEn: n. a set of garments (usually including a jacket and trousers or skirt) for outerwear all of the same fabric and color
n. (slang) a businessman dressed in a business suit
n. a petition or appeal made to a person of superior status or rank
n. playing card in any of four sets of 13 cards in a pack
each set has its own symbol and color
zh: n. 套装, 诉讼, 请求, 起诉, 套, 组
vt. 适合, 使适应
vi. 合适, 相称
examples: When will it suit you to start?
I'll make you a new suit.
exampleZh: 你什么时候出发最方便？
我会给你做一套新衣服。

defsEn: n. the act of constructing something
n. a group of words that form a constituent of a sentence and are considered as a single unit
n. the creation of a construct
the process of combining ideas into a congruous object of thought
n. drawing a figure satisfying certain conditions as part of solving a problem or proving a theorem
zh: n. 建筑, 构造, 建筑物
examples: There is a shortage of good construction timber right now.
I need to go to the China Construction Bank.
exampleZh: 现在正缺良好的建筑木材。
我需要去一趟中国建设银行。

defsEn: n. a relation between things or events (as in the case of one causing the other or sharing features with it)
n. the state of being connected
n. an instrumentality that connects
n. (usually plural) a person who is influential and to whom you are connected in some way (as by family or friendship)
zh: n. 连接, 关系, 前后关系
examples: Why is my Internet connection so slow?
There is no connection between them.
exampleZh: 我的网怎么会这么慢？
两者没有关联。

defsEn: n. a point or extent in space
n. a workplace away from a studio at which some or all of a movie may be made
zh: n. 位置, 场所, 特定区域
examples: I suggest we move to a safer location.
A GPS device can pinpoint your location anywhere in the world.
exampleZh: 我建议我们去个更安全的地方。
无论你在世界的哪一个角落，你都可以使用全球定位仪来找出你的所在。

defsEn: n. a member of the race of people living in America when Europeans arrived
n. a native or inhabitant of India
a. of or relating to or characteristic of India or the East Indies or their peoples or languages or cultures
zh: n. 印度人, 印第安人, 印第安语
a. 印度的, 印度群岛的, 印第安语的
examples: Taiwanese food is milder than Indian food.
Kill the Indian, and save the man.
exampleZh: 台湾菜比印度菜口味淡。

defsEn: n. a one-piece garment for a woman
has skirt and bodice
v. put on clothes
v. provide with clothes or put clothes on
v. put a finish on
zh: n. 服装, 覆盖物
vi. 穿着
vt. 给...穿衣, 整理
examples: Could you save this dress for me?
She put on a pretty dress.
exampleZh: 你能帮我保留这件洋装吗？
她穿上了一套漂亮的洋装。

defsEn: n. a person who is a participating member of an organization
a. tending to become more severe or wider in scope
s. engaged in or ready for military or naval operations
a. disposed to take action or effectuate change
zh: a. 活跃的, 起作用的, 积极的, 有效的, 主动的, 活性的, 现行的, 现役的
n. 主动语态, 积极分子
examples: According to my grandmother, being active is the key to her good health.
The volcano has become active again.
exampleZh: 我奶奶说，良好健康的关键是保持积极。
这座火山又开始活动了。

defsEn: n. a citizen who has a legal right to vote
zh: n. 选民, 投票人
examples: What do you reckon the voter turnout will be today?
What do you think the voter turnout will be today?

defsEn: n. any place of pain and turmoil
n. a cause of difficulty and suffering
n. (Christianity) the abode of Satan and the forces of evil
where sinners suffer eternal punishment
n. (religion) the world of the dead
zh: n. 地狱, 邪恶势力, 苦境, 阴间, 毁坏, 训斥
vi. 狂饮, 飞驰
examples: Get the hell out of here!
What the hell are you going to do with it?
exampleZh: 滚！
你到底要对它怎么样？

defsEn: a. involving or causing danger or risk
liable to hurt or harm
s. causing fear or anxiety by threatening great harm
zh: a. 危险的
examples: We thought it dangerous for her to go alone.
It must be dangerous to swim in this rapid stream.
exampleZh: 我们觉得她一个人去很危险。
在这么急的急流里游泳，一定会很危险的。

defsEn: v. put in the mind of someone
zh: vt. 提醒, 使想起
examples: You remind me of a boy I used to know.
Please remind me to post the letter.
exampleZh: 你让我想起我过去认识的一个男孩。
请提醒我寄信。

defsEn: a. characterized by unity
being or joined into a single entity
zh: a. 联合的, 团结的, 一致的, 和睦的
examples: Let us be united in the cause of justice.
I want to go to the United Kingdom.

defsEn: a. associated with academia or an academy
s. hypothetical or theoretical and not expected to produce an immediate or practical result
s. marked by a narrow focus on or display of learning especially its trivial aspects
zh: a. 学院的, 学术的, 不切实际的
n. 大学生, 大学教师, 学者, 学会会员
examples: Schoolwork, cultural work and academic work should all be promoted together.
In academic writing, you need to use formal language.
exampleZh: 学生工作、文化工作和学术工作应该同时推进。

defsEn: n. a reply of denial
n. a piece of photographic film showing an image with light and shade or colors reversed
a. characterized by or displaying negation or denial or opposition or resistance
having no positive features
a. expressing or consisting of a negation or refusal or denial
zh: n. 否定, 否定语, 负数, 底片
a. 否定的, 消极的, 负的, 阴性的
n. 负数, 负值
examples: Let go of your negative outlook on life.
Why do you hold a negative feeling towards me?
exampleZh: 请抛开你那些负面的人生观。

defsEn: a. of or relating to the study of history
s. having once lived or existed or taken place in the real world as distinct from being legendary
zh: a. 历史的, 史实的, 历史上的
examples: This is a city of real historical value.
I like to carry out historical research.
exampleZh: 这是一个具有历史价值的城市。

defsEn: n. a journey or route all the way around a particular place or area
v. make a tour of a certain place
zh: n. 旅游, 观光旅行, 任期
vi. 旅行, 周游, 巡回
vt. 周游, 观光, 游历, 使巡回演出
examples: How much is the tour per person?
I'm a tour guide in Tokyo.
exampleZh: 一个人的旅费多少钱?
我在东京做导游。

defsEn: n. the decision of a court on issues of fact or law
n. something that is found
zh: n. 发现, 发现物, 决定, 裁决
examples: My findings suggest that that is not the case.
My findings suggest that is not the case.

defsEn: n. a mechanical device for gripping an object
v. make a grasping or snatching motion with the hand
v. obtain illegally or unscrupulously
v. take or grasp suddenly
zh: n. 抓握, 掠夺, 强占, 东方沿岸帆船
vi. 抓取, 抢去
vt. 攫取, 捕获, 霸占
examples: Grab a hold of the rope.
He grabbed a handful of rice.
exampleZh: 抓住绳子。
他抓了一把米。

defsEn: n. a room in a school where lessons take place
zh: n. 教室
examples: Do you eat it in the classroom?
Why did you leave the classroom yesterday?
exampleZh: 您在教室里吃它吗？
您昨天为什么离开教室？

defsEn: n. a representation of a person or scene in the form of a print or transparent slide
recorded by a camera on light-sensitive material
v. record on photographic film
v. undergo being photographed in a certain way
zh: n. 相片, 照片, 逼真的描绘
v. 照相, 摄影
examples: He took a photograph of the family.
Here is a photograph of my family.
exampleZh: 他拍了张全家福的照片。
这里有一张我全家的照片。

defsEn: n. a newspaper that is published every day
s. of or belonging to or occurring every day
r. every day
without missing a day
zh: a. 每日的, 日常的
adv. 每日地, 日常地
n. 日报
examples: Write up the daily report today!
They insist that daily exercise is an action that must be done.
exampleZh: 今天就去把每日报告写好。
他们坚持认为日常锻练是必得表出的行为。

defsEn: n. a set of two similar things considered as a unit
n. two people considered as a unit
n. a poker hand with 2 cards of the same value
v. form a pair or pairs
zh: n. 一双, 一对, 一副
v. (使)成对
examples: I want to buy a pair of pants.
You need two to make a pair.
exampleZh: 我想买条裤子。
你需要两个才能凑成一对。

defsEn: n. a person attached to the household of a high official (as a pope or bishop) who renders service in return for support
n. a spirit (usually in animal form) that acts as an assistant to a witch or wizard
a. well known or easily recognized
a. within normal everyday experience
common and ordinary
not strange
zh: a. 熟悉的, 常见的, 亲密的
n. 熟友, 常客
examples: All of you are familiar with the truth of the story.
We are familiar with the name of the place.
exampleZh: 你们所有的人都熟悉这个故事的真相。
我们觉得这地方很耳熟。

defsEn: n. the time when something begins (especially life)
n. the event of being born
n. a baby born
an offspring
zh: n. 出生, 起源
examples: She will give birth to a child next month.
The woman gave birth to a baby girl.
exampleZh: 她下个月生孩子。
这个女人生了一个女婴。

defsEn: s. lying toward or situated in the east
a. of or characteristic of eastern regions of the United States
a. relating to or characteristic of regions of eastern parts of the world
zh: n. 东方人, 东正教徒
a. 东方的, 向东的, 自东的
examples: Alcohol consumption is higher in Eastern Europe than in Western Europe.
In the eastern part, the situation is a bit different.
exampleZh: 东欧的酒精消耗量比西欧高。

defsEn: n. workplace for the teaching or practice of an art
n. workplace consisting of a room or building where movies or television shows or radio programs are produced and recorded
zh: n. 工作室, 画室, 演播室, 电影制片厂
examples: They have to practice in a studio.
The studio is very small, with no place to hide.

defsEn: n. the act of bringing something to bear
using it for a particular purpose
n. a verbal or written request for assistance or employment or admission to a school
n. the work of applying something
n. a program that gives a computer instructions that provide the user with tools to accomplish a task
zh: n. 应用, 申请, 志愿书, 应用程序
examples: Please fill in this application form.
We've decided to extend the application deadline.
exampleZh: 请填好这张申请表。
我们决定延长申请截止日期。

defsEn: v. to incline or bend from a vertical position
v. cause to lean or incline
v. rely on for support
a. lacking in mineral content or combustible material
zh: n. 瘦肉, 倾斜, 倾斜度
a. 瘦的, 贫乏的, 歉收的
vi. 倚靠, 倾斜, 依赖
vt. 使倾斜
examples: The tower leaned slightly to the west.
He was leaning against the wall.
exampleZh: 塔有点向西边倾斜。
他靠着墙。

defsEn: n. the part of an organism (human or animal) that connects the head to the rest of the body
n. a narrow elongated projecting strip of land
n. a cut of meat from the neck of an animal
n. a narrow part of an artifact that resembles a neck in position or form
zh: n. 脖子, 衣领, 颈
vi. 拥抱, 拥吻, 收缩
vt. 割颈
examples: I got up today with a pain in my neck.
The horse broke its neck when it fell.
exampleZh: 我今天起床的时候脖子很痛。
马倒下时脖子断了。

defsEn: n. a sheet of metal or wood or glass or plastic
n. a full-page illustration (usually on slick paper)
n. dish on which food is served or from which food is eaten
n. the quantity contained in a plate
zh: n. 碟, 盘子, 盆中物, 金属板, 图版, 金银餐具, 印版, 金属牌(照)
vt. 镀金, 电镀, 用金属板固定, 给...装钢板, 为...制印版
examples: Bring me a clean plate and take the dirty one away.
I would kill for a plate of polo right now.
exampleZh: 请拿一个新的盘子给我并把这个脏的拿走.
我现在很想吃一盘抓饭。

defsEn: s. other than as supposed or expected
r. in other respects or ways
zh: adv. 否则, 不同地, 别的方式
examples: Go at once, otherwise you will be late.
Good that you told me, otherwise I would never have remembered it.
exampleZh: 立刻走，否则你会迟到。
幸好你提醒我，不然我永远记不起来了。

defsEn: n. the act of creating written works
n. the work of a writer
anything expressed in letters of the alphabet (especially when considered from the point of view of style and effect)
n. (usually plural) the collected work of an author
n. letters or symbols that are written or imprinted on a surface to represent the sounds or words of a language
zh: n. 书写, 著作, 笔迹, 作品
examples: I must say that your writing is at a pretty good level!
That person writing the letter in the classroom is my friend.
exampleZh: 我必须说, 你的写作达到了非常好的水准。
那个在教室写信的人是我的朋友。

defsEn: a. not open
zh: n. 关闭
vt. 关上, 闭起, 幽禁, 合拢, 轧住
vi. 关上, 停止营业
examples: May I trouble you to shut the window?
Be kind enough to shut the door.
exampleZh: 可以麻烦你把窗关了吗？
请关门。

defsEn: n. a meeting for execution of a group's functions
n. a meeting devoted to a particular activity
zh: n. 期间, 开庭期, 会议, 学期
examples: Are you taking tests on the next session?
This will be our last session for the year.
exampleZh: 下学期你要参加考试吗？

defsEn: n. an amount determined as payable
n. the market value set on assets
zh: n. 评估, 估定, 评定的款额
examples: I think that's an accurate assessment.
I think that the assessment is unfair.

defsEn: n. any physical damage to the body caused by violence or accident or fracture etc.
n. an accident that results in physical damage or hurt
n. an act that causes someone or something to receive physical damage
n. wrongdoing that violates another's rights and is unjustly inflicted
zh: n. 伤害, 侮辱
examples: How did you get this injury on your foot?
Where did that injury on your foot come from?
exampleZh: 脚上的伤是怎么回事？
脚上的伤是怎么回事？

defsEn: n. a sign of assent or salutation or command
n. the act of nodding the head
v. express or signify by nodding
v. lower and raise the head, as to indicate assent or agreement or confirmation
zh: n. 点头, 打盹, 晃动
vi. 点头, 打盹
vt. 点头表示, 点(头)
examples: My grandfather often nods over his newspaper.
Mary gave me a friendly nod.
exampleZh: 祖父常常边看报纸边点头。
玛丽友好地向我点了点头。

defsEn: n. (computer science) a line of code written as part of a computer program
zh: n. 指令, 教导, 命令
examples: He gave me precise instructions to do the job.
Follow my instructions and proceed carefully.
exampleZh: 他给我的工作作出了明确指示。
按照我的指示小心谨慎地前进。

defsEn: n. a commercial document showing that the holder is entitled to something (as to ride on public transportation or to enter a public entertainment)
n. a summons issued to an offender (especially to someone who violates a traffic regulation)
n. the appropriate or desirable thing
v. issue a ticket or a fine to as a penalty
zh: n. 票, 券, 车票, 标签, 入场券, 证明书
vt. 加标签于, 为...购票
examples: Let me get you a ticket to the concert.
Where can you buy a ticket to get in?
exampleZh: 我来帮你弄张演唱会门票吧。
在哪能买到入场券？

defsEn: n. the cognitive process of understanding a written linguistic message
n. a particular interpretation or performance
n. a datum about some physical state that is presented to a user by a meter or similar instrument
n. written material intended to be read
zh: n. 阅读, 知识, 读物
a. 阅读的
examples: We take several readings of the barometer per day.
Initial readings indicate an influx of toxic chemicals.

defsEn: n. either of two fleshy folds of tissue that surround the mouth and play a role in speaking
n. (botany) either of the two parts of a bilabiate corolla or calyx
n. either the outer margin or the inner margin of the aperture of a gastropod's shell
zh: n. 唇, 口缘, 唇状构造
vt. 以嘴唇碰, 轻轻说出
a. 口头上的
examples: Your lips are soft like the surface of a cactus.
He raised the glass to his lips and drained it at one gulp.
exampleZh: 你的嘴唇软绵绵的，就像仙人掌的表皮一样。
他把杯子举到嘴边，一饮而尽。

defsEn: a. relating to or concerned with a city or densely populated area
a. located in or characteristic of a city or city life
zh: a. 都市的, 住在都市的, 习惯于都市的
examples: Traffic is a major urban problem.
More and more people are moving to urban areas.
exampleZh: 交通是都市的一个主要问题。
越来越多的人迁往市区。

defsEn: n. a midday meal
v. take the midday meal
v. provide a midday meal for
zh: n. 午餐
examples: Would you like to eat lunch with me?
You can eat lunch here in this room.
exampleZh: 你想和我一起吃午餐吗？
你可以在这房间吃午饭。

defsEn: a. relating to the process of education
s. providing knowledge
zh: a. 教育的, 教育性的
examples: He proposed a reform in the educational system.
I know an educational psychologist and I hate her.
exampleZh: 他提议对教育系统进行改革。

defsEn: n. a person trained to compete in sports
zh: n. 运动员, 运动选手
examples: That athlete won three times in a row in this tournament.
An athlete must keep in good condition.
exampleZh: 那位选手在这次比赛中取得了三连胜。

defsEn: n. the immaterial part of a person
the actuating cause of an individual life
n. deep feeling or emotion
n. the human embodiment of something
n. a secular form of gospel that was a major Black musical genre in the 1960s and 1970s
zh: n. 灵魂, 心灵, 精神, 精髓, 人, 化身, 典型, 鬼魂
a. 黑人的
examples: May your soul rest in peace.
Since then he has put his soul into his work.
exampleZh: 愿你的在天之灵安息。
从那时起，他就全心全意地投入到他的工作。

defsEn: a. of or relating to the practice of science
a. conforming with the principles or methods used in science
zh: a. 科学的, 系统的, 符合科学规律的
examples: From a strictly scientific point of view, history cannot be called a science.
Most scientific breakthroughs are nothing else than the discovery of the obvious.
exampleZh: 从严格的科学观点来看，历史不能算是一门科学。
多数科学突破只不过是发现了显而易见的事。

defsEn: n. something that cannot be done
a. not capable of occurring or being accomplished or dealt with
s. totally unlikely
s. used of persons or their behavior
zh: a. 不可能的, 难以置信的, 令人无法忍受的
examples: You ask me to do the impossible.
Life would be impossible without the sun.
exampleZh: 你让我做不可能做到的事情。
没有太阳就没有生命。

defsEn: n. the act of binding yourself (intellectually or emotionally) to a course of action
n. an engagement by contract involving financial obligation
n. a message that makes a pledge
n. the official act of consigning a person to confinement (as in a prison or mental hospital)
zh: n. 委托, 交押, 承担义务, 赞助
examples: After this great commitment success will be sure.
I have a commitment that I should fulfill.

defsEn: a. determined or actuated by emotion rather than reason
a. of more than usual emotion
a. of or pertaining to emotion
zh: a. 情绪的, 情感的
examples: I agree on an emotional level, but on the pragmatic level I disagree.
I didn't mean to get emotional.
exampleZh: 我感情上支持，但是理性上反对。
我没想要情绪化。

defsEn: s. final or last in your life or progress
s. highest in excellence or achievement
s. greatest or maximal in degree
extreme
zh: n. 至高, 霸权
a. 至高的, 终极的, 极端的, 最大的
examples: I give you my supreme word of honor.
He believed in the supreme power of the law.

defsEn: n. massive plantigrade carnivorous or omnivorous mammals with long shaggy coats and strong claws
n. an investor with a pessimistic market outlook
an investor who expects prices to fall and so sells now in order to buy later at a lower price
v. have
v. move while holding up or supporting
zh: n. 熊
vt. 忍受, 支承, 产生, 怀有, 通过卖空使跌价
vi. 忍受, 结果实, 压挤, 行进, 转向
examples: Please bear with me until I finish the story.
Bear in mind what he said.
exampleZh: 请容许我把故事讲完。
你要好好记住他的话。

defsEn: n. a small pouch inside a garment for carrying small articles
n. a supply of money
n. (bowling) the space between the headpin and the pins behind it on the right or left
n. a small isolated group of people
zh: n. 口袋, 钱袋, 钱, 容器
vt. 装...在口袋里, 隐藏, 抑制, 私吞, 搁置, 击...入袋
a. 袖珍的, 小型的, 压缩的, 金钱上的
examples: She put the key in her pocket.
Put the money in my pocket.
exampleZh: 她把钥匙放在她的口袋里。
他把钱塞到我的口袋里。

defsEn: n. an inquiry into public opinion conducted by interviewing a random sample of people
n. the part of the head between the ears
n. a tame parrot
n. the counting of votes (as in an election)
zh: n. 投票, 民意测验, 选举投票, 投票数, 一组人中的一个, 头颈和后脑部, 鹦鹉
vt. 对...进行民意测验, 获得...票, 剪树枝, 轮询
vi. 投票
a. 剪过毛的, 修过枝的
examples: The result of the poll will be known soon.
People go to the polls to vote.

defsEn: n. something proposed (such as a plan or assumption)
n. the act of making a proposal
zh: n. 提议, 计划, 求婚
examples: He would not agree to our proposal.
This proposal is too good to turn down.
exampleZh: 他不同意我们的建议。
此提议好得令人难以拒绝。

defsEn: n. a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon
n. the outcome of an event especially as relative to an individual
n. having important effects or influence
zh: n. 结果, 重要性
examples: As a consequence, additional tests must be carried out to ensure complete security.
You need to consider the consequences before making any modifications to existing code.
exampleZh: 因此，必须进行额外的测试以确保完整的安全性。
对现有代码做出任何修改前，你需要考虑后果。

defsEn: n. the process of taking in and expelling air during breathing
n. the air that is inhaled and exhaled in respiration
n. a short respite
n. a slight movement of the air
zh: n. 呼吸, 气息, 瞬间
examples: He said to her under his breath, "I love you."
Take a deep breath and then relax.
exampleZh: 他压低嗓门对她说：「我爱你。」
深呼吸，然后放松。

defsEn: n. an instance of visual perception
n. anything that is seen
n. the ability to see
the visual faculty
n. a range of mental vision
zh: n. 景观, 视力, 眼界, 阅读, 见解, 意见
vt. 看见, 瞄准
vi. 瞄准, 观看
a. 即席的, 见票即付的
examples: I know him by sight, but not by name.
I know him by name, but not by sight.
exampleZh: 我知道他的样子，但不知道他的名字。
我知道他的名字，但不知道他长什么样。

defsEn: v. choose and follow
as of theories, ideas, policies, strategies or plans
v. take up and practice as one's own
v. take into one's family
zh: vt. 采用, 正式通过, 收养, 接受
examples: My wife wants to adopt a child.
The government will adopt enforcement measures to solve this problem.
exampleZh: 我妻子想收养一个孩子。
政府将采取强制措施来解决这一问题。

defsEn: n. the profession of a teacher
n. a doctrine that is taught
zh: n. 教学, 学说, 教导
examples: Their teachings emphasize love and respect.
He began to doubt the teachings of the Nation of Islam.

defsEn: n. a proposal for an appropriate course of action
zh: n. 忠告, 劝告, 意见, 报道, 通知
examples: I need your advice on what I should do next.
He would not listen to my advice.
exampleZh: 我需要你指导我接下来该做什么。
他不肯听我的劝告。

defsEn: a. characteristic of a region
s. related or limited to a particular region
zh: a. 地方的, 地域性的
examples: Drents is a group of variants of the Low Saxon regional language.
Algeria should be a regional military power.
exampleZh: 德伦特方言是低地撒克逊地区的一个方言群。

defsEn: n. a track or mark left by something that has passed
n. a path or track roughly blazed through wild or hilly country
v. move, proceed, or walk draggingly or slowly
v. hang down so as to drag along the ground
zh: n. 踪迹, 痕迹, 一串, 尾部, 小径, 持枪姿势
vt. 拖, 尾随, 追踪, 落后于, 开出路
vi. 拖曳, 垂下, 落后, 飘出, 蔓生
examples: The trail will take you up the mountain.
You have a tendency to trail off.

defsEn: n. an extended fictional work in prose
usually in the form of a story
n. a printed and bound book that is an extended work of fiction
s. pleasantly new or different
zh: n. 小说, 长篇故事
a. 新奇的, 异常的
examples: His new novel will come out next month.
I remember reading this novel before.
exampleZh: 他的新小说将会在下个月出版。
我记得以前读过这本小说。

defsEn: r. in some unspecified way or manner
or by some unspecified means
r. for some unspecified reason
zh: adv. 不知何故
examples: We have to have fun somehow.
I feel like somehow I've stopped thinking of translation as something enjoyable.
exampleZh: 我们总得找点乐子。
不知怎么的，我觉得翻译好像已经不再是一件乐事了。

defsEn: n. an organization of employees formed to bargain with the employer
n. the United States (especially the northern states during the American Civil War)
n. the state of being joined or united or linked
n. healing process involving the growing together of the edges of a wound or the growing together of broken bones
zh: n. 联盟, 联合, 结合, 工会
examples: The union and the company have agreed upon a new contract.
Iceland has not joined the European Union.
exampleZh: 工会和企业一致同意了一份新的合同。
冰岛没有加入欧盟。

defsEn: n. a piece of furniture with a writing surface and usually drawers or other compartments
zh: n. 书桌, 办公桌, 工作台
examples: He put the key on the desk as usual.
I see a book on the desk.
exampleZh: 他跟平时一样把钥匙放在书桌上。
我看到桌上有本书。

defsEn: a. high in price or charging high prices
zh: a. 贵的, 奢华的, 费用浩大的, 乱化钱的
examples: I would like a less expensive double room.
It must be a very expensive restaurant!
exampleZh: 我想要更便宜点的双人间。
它一定是一家很贵的餐厅。

defsEn: n. an intuitive assumption
n. the proposition arrived at by logical reasoning (such as the proposition that must follow from the major and minor premises of a syllogism)
n. a final settlement
n. the last section of a communication
zh: n. 结论, 结尾, 推论
examples: How do you come to that conclusion?
We have come to the conclusion that this plan is not feasible currently.
exampleZh: 你们怎么得出这个结论的？
我们得出结论，这个计划目前是不可行的。

defsEn: n. an authoritative rule
n. the state of being controlled or governed
n. (embryology) the ability of an early embryo to continue normal development after its structure has been somehow damaged or altered
n. the act of bringing to uniformity
making regular
zh: n. 规则, 管理, 调整
examples: From today on this regulation is history.
This regulation will take effect from next year.
exampleZh: 从今天开始，这项规定成为了历史。

defsEn: n. a characteristic sound
n. a toroidal shape
n. the sound of a bell ringing
n. a platform usually marked off by ropes in which contestants box or wrestle
zh: n. 环, 环形物, 拳击场, 戒指, 角逐, 小集团, 铃声, 钟声, 声调
vt. 包围, 套住, 按铃, 敲钟
vi. 成环形, 响, 鸣, 按铃, 敲钟, 回响
examples: I'll ring you as soon as I get home.
I can't ring anyone at the moment.
exampleZh: 我一回到家就打电话给你。
我现在没办法打电话给任何人。

defsEn: r. in large part
mainly or chiefly
r. on a large scale
zh: adv. 大量地, 很多地, 大半地
examples: The taste of wine is largely dependent upon the weather.
The audience was largely made up of very young children.
exampleZh: 葡萄酒的味道很受天气影响。
大部分观众是年幼的儿童。

defsEn: n. outward or visible aspect of a person or thing
n. the event of coming into sight
n. formal attendance (in court or at a hearing) of a party in an action
n. a mental representation
zh: n. 出现, 露面, 外观, 外表, 出版
examples: In terms of appearance, she's not any worse than her sister.
Judging from his appearance, he must be a rich man.
exampleZh: 要说容貌，她不比她姐姐难看。
从他的外表来看，他应该是个有钱人。

defsEn: n. a collection of things wrapped or boxed together
n. a wrapped container
zh: n. 包裹, 套装软件, 包, 包装用物, 程序包
vt. 包装, 打包
a. 一揽子的
examples: We have a few packages in here.
I'd like to send this package to Japan.
exampleZh: 我们这里有几包。
我想把这个包裹寄到日本。

defsEn: n. a factor causing trouble in achieving a positive result or tending to produce a negative result
n. a condition or state of affairs almost beyond one's ability to deal with and requiring great effort to bear or overcome
n. the quality of being difficult
zh: n. 困难, 难点
examples: I have no difficulty finding people who disagree with you.
I found your house with difficulty.
exampleZh: 我找跟您意见相左的人毫无困难。
我好不容易找到了你们的房子。

defsEn: v. push for something
v. make attractive or acceptable
zh: vt. 推荐, 介绍, 劝告, 使受欢迎, 托付
examples: Could you recommend a nice restaurant near here?
Which one would you recommend that I buy?
exampleZh: 你可以介绍一间附近的好餐厅吗？
你推荐我买哪个？

defsEn: n. the process of using your mind to consider something carefully
zh: n. 思考, 思想
a. 思考的, 有理性的
examples: Do you believe in the power of positive thinking?
I never spend a day without thinking of you.

defsEn: r at this time or period
now
zh: adv. 现在, 当前, 一般, 普通
examples: I'm currently a teacher at this school.
We are currently lacking good quality building lumber.
exampleZh: 我现在在这所学校任教。
现在正缺良好的建筑木材。

defsEn: a. providing or experiencing physical well-being or relief (`comfy' is informal)
a. free from stress or conducive to mental ease
having or affording peace of mind
s. more than adequate
s. sufficient to provide comfort
zh: a. 舒服的, 轻松的
n. 盖被
examples: I feel comfortable in his company.
Lie down and make yourself comfortable.
exampleZh: 我在他的公司里觉得很舒服。
躺下来让自己舒服一点。

defsEn: a. feeling or showing anger
s. (of the elements) as if showing violent anger
s. severely inflamed and painful
zh: a. 生气的, 愤怒的
examples: He must be very angry to say such a thing.
She must be angry with me.
exampleZh: 他一定是十分生气了，不然他不会说出这样的话来的。
她一定在生我的气。

defsEn: n. (law) a proceeding (usually by a court) where evidence is taken for the purpose of determining an issue of fact and reaching a decision based on that evidence
n. an opportunity to state your case and be heard
n. a session (of a committee or grand jury) in which witnesses are called and testimony is taken
n. the ability to hear
the auditory faculty
zh: n. 听, 听觉, 听讯
examples: The confirmation hearings turned into a free-for-all.
All the hearings are behind closed doors.

defsEn: n. one of the contractile organs of the body
n. animal tissue consisting predominantly of contractile cells
n. authority or power or force (especially when used in a coercive way)
v. make one's way by force
zh: n. 肌肉, 臂力
examples: You have to stretch your muscles after swimming in the pool.
The cat didn't move a muscle.
exampleZh: 在泳池游完泳后要拉伸肌肉。
小猫一动也不动。

defsEn: n. box with a lid
used for storage
usually large and sturdy
zh: n. 胸, 胸部, 衣柜, 箱子
examples: This chest has old clothes in it.
Tom had a pain in his chest, so he went to the hospital.
exampleZh: 这个柜子里有些旧衣物。
汤姆胸痛，所以去了医院。

defsEn: n. a native or inhabitant of Japan
n. the language (usually considered to be Altaic) spoken by the Japanese
a. of or relating to or characteristic of Japan or its people or their culture or language
zh: n. 日本人, 日语
a. 日本的, 日语的
examples: A Japanese person would never do such a thing.
Japanese young people like rock and jazz music.
exampleZh: 日本人是不会做这种事的。
日本的年轻人喜爱摇滚乐和爵士乐。

defsEn: n. money in the form of bills or coins
n. prompt payment for goods or services in currency or by check
n. United States country music singer and songwriter (1932-2003)
v. exchange for cash
zh: n. 现金
vt. 兑现
examples: I have a lot of cash now.
I would like to pay with cash.
exampleZh: 现在我有很多现金。
我想付现金。

defsEn: n. a depository for collecting and displaying objects having scientific or historical or artistic value
zh: n. 博物馆
examples: My brother took me to the museum.
Where is the entrance to the museum?
exampleZh: 我哥哥带我去博物馆。
博物馆的入口在哪？

defsEn: n. everything that is included in a collection and that is held or included in something
n. the proportion of a substance that is contained in a mixture or alloy etc.
n. the sum or range of what has been perceived, discovered, or learned
v. satisfy in a limited way
zh: n. 内容, 满足, 意义, 要旨
a. 满足的, 满意的
vt. 使...满足, 使...安心
examples: She says that she is content with her life.
He is not content with his present salary.
exampleZh: 她说很满意她的生活。
他不满意他现在的工资。

defsEn: a. presently existing in fact and not merely potential or possible
s. taking place in reality
not pretended or imitated
s. being or reflecting the essential or genuine character of something
s. existing in act or fact
zh: a. 真实的, 实际的, 现行的
examples: The actual content provided may vary depending on the region and device compatibility.
To date nobody knows the actual size of the cosmos.
exampleZh: 实际提供内容可能因地区与装置相容性而异。
宇宙的实际大小至今无人知道。

defsEn: r. almost not
zh: adv. 刚刚, 几乎不, 勉强是
examples: I can hardly understand what he says.
We hardly have time to eat breakfast.
exampleZh: 我几乎无法了解他说的话。
我们几乎没空吃早饭。

defsEn: n. the context and environment in which something is set
n. the state of the environment in which a situation exists
n. the physical position of something
zh: n. 环境, 背景, 布景, 镶嵌, 调整, 沉落, 一副餐具
examples: The current session settings will be used.
The privacy settings on your smartphone allow this application to track your whereabouts.

defsEn: n. any broad thin expanse or surface
n. paper used for writing or printing
n. bed linen consisting of a large rectangular piece of cotton or linen cloth
used in pairs
n. a flat artifact that is thin relative to its length and width
zh: n. 床单, 张, 纸张, 印刷品, 裹尸布, 薄片
vt. 盖上被单, 遍布
vi. 大片落下
a. 片状的, 成薄片的
examples: Please give me a sheet of paper.
Bring me a sheet of paper, please.
exampleZh: 请给我一张纸。
请带一张纸给我。

defsEn: n. a member of a Catholic church
a. of or relating to or supporting Catholicism
s. free from provincial prejudices or attachments
zh: n. 天主教徒
a. 天主教的, 普遍的, 广泛的, 宽宏大量的
examples: The Catholic Church is opposed to divorce.
The Catholic Church doesn't condone the use of condoms.
exampleZh: 天主教教会反对离婚。
天主教廷不同意避孕套的使用。

defsEn: n. the point or degree to which something extends
n. the distance or area or volume over which something extends
zh: n. 范围, 程度, 区域
examples: To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
I agree with you to some extent.
exampleZh: 要你在多大程度上同意或不同意这种说法？
我在一定程度上同意你的意见。

defsEn: n. a locally circumscribed place characterized by some distinctive features
n. any of the regions of the surface of the Earth loosely divided according to latitude or longitude
n. an area or region distinguished from adjacent parts by a distinctive feature or characteristic
n. (anatomy) any encircling or beltlike structure
zh: n. 地带, 带, 地区
vt. 环绕, 使分成地带
vi. 分成区
examples: It's like a war zone there.
Get out of your comfort zone.
exampleZh: 那里就像战场一样。

defsEn: r. as the end result of a succession or process
zh: adv. 最后, 最终
examples: Ultimately, space flight will be beneficial to all mankind.
Ultimately, the purpose of living may vary for each individual.

defsEn: n. the part played by a person in bringing about a result
n. a voluntary gift (as of money or service or ideas) made to some worthwhile cause
n. act of giving in common with others for a common purpose especially to a charity
n. an amount of money contributed
zh: n. 捐助, 捐助之物, 贡献
examples: I would like to make a contribution.
The summit conference made a contribution to the peace of the world.

defsEn: n. a minor inadvertent mistake usually observed in speech or writing or in small accidents or memory lapses etc.
n. potter's clay that is thinned and used for coating or decorating ceramics
n. a young and slender person
n. an accidental misstep threatening (or causing) a fall
zh: n. 滑, 滑行, 事故, 溜, 差错, 滑台, 下降, 插条, 后裔, 板条, 瘦长的年轻人
vi. 滑动, 滑倒, 失足, 溜走, 滑落, 犯错, 变坏
vt. 使滑动, 滑过, 摆脱, 闪开, 塞入, 从...取接枝
a. 滑动的, 滑移的, 活络的, 有活结的
examples: It's a slip of the pen.
He slipped over on the ice.
exampleZh: 那是一个笔误。
他在冰上滑了一交。

defsEn: n. a proportion in relation to a whole (which is usually the amount per hundred)
zh: n. 百分比, 比率, 部分, 可能性
examples: What percentage of all taxi drivers make unscrupulous detours, do you think?
What percentage of the American population lives near the coast?
exampleZh: 你觉得绕路的司机占所有的出租车司机的百分之多少？

defsEn: n. a serious (often fatal) disease of the immune system transmitted through blood products especially by sexual contact or contaminated needles
zh: n. 爱滋病(获得性免疫缺陷综合征)
美国决策学学会, 信息自动显示系统, 自动综合调试系统
examples: This juice can cure AIDS. Just drink it.
This in turn aids the generation of electricity.

defsEn: n. the branch of medical science that treats disease or injury by operative procedures
n. a room where a doctor or dentist can be consulted
zh: n. 外科, 手术, 手术室, 换球术
examples: Cosmetic surgery is not covered by most insurance plans.
Not even plastic surgery will make you less ugly.
exampleZh: 大部份的保险计划不包含整容手术。

defsEn: n. that which is deserved or owed
n. a payment that is due (e.g., as the price of membership)
a. owed and payable immediately or on demand
s. scheduled to arrive
zh: n. 应得的东西, 应付款
a. 到期的, 应得的, 应付的, 约定的
examples: His success is due more to his persistent hard work than to his talent.
The firm went under due to lack of capital.
exampleZh: 他的成功来自他不断的努力多于来自他的才能。
公司由于缺乏资本倒闭了。

defsEn: n. a game played on a large open course with 9 or 18 holes
the object is use as few strokes as possible in playing all the holes
v. play golf
zh: n. 高尔夫球
vi. 打高尔夫球
examples: I would like to play golf.
I'm a huge fan of golf.
exampleZh: 我想打高尔夫。
我超级迷高尔夫。

defsEn: n. someone deranged and possibly dangerous
s. foolish
totally unsound
s. possessed by inordinate excitement
s. bizarre or fantastic
zh: a. 发狂的, 狂热的
examples: It would be crazy to do that again.
He must have been crazy to climb the mountain in winter.
exampleZh: 再来一次就是疯了。
他一定是疯了才会在冬天爬山。

defsEn: n. a division of some larger or more complex organization
n. a division of a stem, or secondary stem arising from the main stem of a plant
n. a part of a forked or branching shape
n. a stream or river connected to a larger one
zh: n. 树枝, 支店, 支流, 分部
vi. 分支, 出枝
vt. 分割, 用枝状叶脉刺绣花纹装饰
examples: I cut a branch from the tree.
He cut some branches off the tree.
exampleZh: 我从树上砍下了一根树枝。
他割掉了树上的几根树枝。

defsEn: n. a collection of things that have been combined
an assemblage of separate parts or qualities
n. a coordinated sequence of chess moves
n. a sequence of numbers or letters that opens a combination lock
n. a group of people (often temporary) having a common purpose
zh: n. 组合, 合并, 联合
examples: Jazz fusion is a combination of rock and jazz.
I want to buy a combination lock.
exampleZh: 融合爵士是摇滚乐与爵士乐的融合。

defsEn: n. the head of a state government
n. a control that maintains a steady speed in a machine (as by controlling the supply of fuel)
zh: n. (美)州长, (英)总督, 统治者, 管理者, 理事
examples: The governor's recent scandal was a blight on her otherwise pristine track record.
Everybody wished he had been elected governor.
exampleZh: 州长最近的丑闻玷污了她原本完美无瑕的政绩。
每个人都希望他当选州长。

defsEn: n. the feeling that comes when something burdensome is removed or reduced
n. the condition of being comfortable or relieved (especially after being relieved of distress)
n. (law) redress awarded by a court
n. assistance in time of difficulty
zh: n. 减轻, 解除, 救济, 安慰, 调剂, 浮雕, 换班, (地势的)起伏
examples: She gave out a sigh of relief.
Who is to say this isn't a relief?
exampleZh: 她松了一口气。
这何尝不是一种解脱？

defsEn: n. a person of German nationality
n. the standard German language
developed historically from West Germanic
a. of or pertaining to or characteristic of Germany or its people or language
zh: n. 德国人, 德语
a. 德国的, 德国人的, 德国语的, 同父母的
examples: I feel that the German language can be very difficult.
I know that German with a long beard.
exampleZh: 我觉得德语很难。
我认识那位长胡子德国人。

defsEn: n. an expanse of scenery that can be seen in a single view
n. painting depicting an expanse of natural scenery
n. a genre of art dealing with the depiction of natural scenery
n. an extensive mental viewpoint
zh: n. 风景, 山水, 风景画
vi. 从事景观美化
vt. 美化...景观
examples: Sun lights the landscape, pain illuminates the soul.
The landscape is unfamiliar to me.
exampleZh: 阳光照亮田野，痛苦点亮心灵。
风景对我来说很陌生。

defsEn: n. a round vessel that is open at the top
used chiefly for holding food or liquids
n. a concave shape with an open top
n. a dish that is round and open at the top for serving foods
n. the quantity contained in a bowl
zh: n. 碗, 木球, 大酒杯
v. 滚木球, 快而稳地行驶
examples: At night, we usually go bowling.
How many bowls do we have?
exampleZh: 我们经常在夜晚打保龄球。
我们有几个碗？

defsEn: n. the framework for a pair of eyeglasses
n. a single one of a series of still transparent pictures forming a cinema, television or video film
n. a single drawing in a comic_strip
n. an application that divides the user's display into two or more windows that can be scrolled independently
zh: n. 框, 结构, 体格
vt. 构成, 设计, 制定, 使适合, 陷害
examples: This picture frame can make the picture rise in value.
The frame is worth more than the painting.
exampleZh: 这个画框能让画升值。
画框比画还值钱。

defsEn: n. a river in southern Scotland that flows eastward to the Firth of Forth
r. forward in time or order or degree
r. out into view
zh: adv. 往前, 以后, 向外
examples: He walked back and forth in front of the door, hesitating to enter.
He walked back and forth on the platform while waiting for the train.
exampleZh: 他在门前走来走去，不知道该不该进去。
他一边等火车，一边在月台上走来走去。

defsEn: a. exhibiting the qualities or characteristics that identify a group or kind or category
s. conforming to a type
zh: a. 典型的, 象征性的
examples: I find that it's typical for him to come too late.
He doesn't have the indifference typical of people from big cities.
exampleZh: 我发现他就是会很晚才来这样的人。
在他身上没有大城市人的那种冷漠。

defsEn: n. a large room for gatherings or entertainment
n. English writer whose novel about a lesbian relationship was banned in Britain for many years (1883-1943)
n. United States child psychologist whose theories of child psychology strongly influenced educational psychology (1844-1924)
n. United States chemist who developed an economical method of producing aluminum from bauxite (1863-1914)
zh: n. 门厅, 走廊, 会堂
examples: Can we speak in the hall?
I passed the city hall on my way to the station.
exampleZh: 我们能在走廊里说话吗？
我去车站的路上路过了市政厅。

defsEn: n. a person who invites guests to a social event (such as a party in his or her own home) and who is responsible for them while they are there
n. an animal or plant that nourishes and supports a parasite
it does not benefit and is often harmed by the association
n. archaic terms for army
n. any organization that provides resources and facilities for a function or event
zh: n. 主人, 旅馆老板, 节目主持人
vt. 当主人招待, 作...节目主持人
examples: The party host had a Portuguese accent.
We have to cope with hosts of difficulties.
exampleZh: 派对主席说话时有葡萄牙腔
我们要面对许多的困难。

defsEn: n. an arrangement of objects or people side by side in a line
n. a long continuous strip (usually running horizontally)
n. a linear array of numbers, letters, or symbols side by side
n. a continuous chronological succession without an interruption
zh: n. 排, 行, 街道, 划船, 吵闹
vt. 使成排, 划, 划船, 参加(赛船), 痛骂
vi. 划船, 划动, 争吵
examples: She put her CDs in a row on the shelf.
We rowed up the river against the current.
exampleZh: 她把她的CD在书架上排成一排。
我们在河里划着船逆流而上。

defsEn: v. be able to spare or give up
v. have the financial means to do something or buy something
v. afford access to
zh: vt. 买得起, 足以, 给予
examples: How can you afford a place like this?
He cannot afford to buy a car, much less a house.
exampleZh: 我们怎么付得起这种地方的钱？
他买不起一辆汽车，更不要说一套房子了。

defsEn: n. an army unit large enough to sustain combat
n. the act or process of dividing
n. an administrative unit in government or business
n. discord that splits a group
zh: n. 分, 分开, 除法, 部门(如部、处、系等), 师
examples: The children haven't studied division yet.
What division of the company do you work in?
exampleZh: 孩子们还没上过除法。

defsEn: n. the linear extent in space from one end to the other
the longest dimension of something that is fixed in place
n. the property of being the extent of something from beginning to end
n. a section of something that is long and narrow
zh: n. 长度, 长, 期间, 一段
examples: I don't know the exact length of this bridge.
Measure the length of the stick with a ruler.
exampleZh: 我不确定那座桥到底有多长。

defsEn: n. a kind of pain such as that caused by a wound or a burn or a sore
a. showing mental alertness and calculation and resourcefulness
s. painfully severe
s. quick and brisk
zh: a. 聪明的, 漂亮的, 刺痛的, 剧烈的, 敏捷的, 巧妙的, 伶俐的, 潇洒的
n. 刺痛, 痛苦
vi. 刺痛
examples: He is as smart as any other boy in the class.
You are smart. You must understand that.
exampleZh: 他和班上其他男生一样聪明。
你很聪明，你应该明白这个。

defsEn: n. a formal organization of people or groups of people
n. the act of consorting with or joining with others
n. the state of being connected together as in memory or imagination
n. the process of bringing ideas or events together in memory or imagination
zh: n. 协会
examples: She set up an association to help blind people.
I am not a member of an association.

defsEn: v. express complaints, discontent, displeasure, or unhappiness
v. make a formal accusation
bring a formal charge
zh: v. 抱怨, 抗议, 控诉
examples: I have nothing to complain about.
She complained to me of my small salary.
exampleZh: 我没有什么可抱怨的。
她向我抱怨我微薄的薪水。

defsEn: n. something that is likely to vary
something that is subject to variation
n. a quantity that can assume any of a set of values
n. a symbol (like x or y) that is used in mathematical or logical expressions to represent a variable quantity
a. liable to or capable of change
zh: n. 易变的事物, 变数, 可变物, 变量
a. 可变的, 不定的, 易变的, 变量的
examples: Variable names in C are case sensitive.
The wind will be variable today.
exampleZh: C语言的变量名是区分大小写的。

defsEn: n. a way of conceiving something
n. the process of perceiving
n. knowledge gained by perceiving
zh: n. 知觉, 感觉, 领悟力, 获取
examples: Perception can be more important than reality.
Tell us about your perception about Islam.

defsEn: v. direct toward itself or oneself by means of some psychological power or physical attributes
v. be attractive to
v. exert a force on (a body) causing it to approach or prevent it from moving away
zh: vt. 吸引, 诱惑
vi. 有吸引力
examples: She attracted me at first sight.
The first subject that attracted my attention was philosophy.
exampleZh: 我对她一见钟情。
第一个吸引我注意的科目是哲学。

defsEn: n. a room used primarily for sleeping
zh: n. 卧室
examples: I share a bedroom with my sister.
I said that this was a meeting room, not a bedroom!
exampleZh: 我跟我姐姐共用同一间卧房。
我说过了，这是一个会议室，不是卧室。

defsEn: n. a feeling of trust (in someone or something)
n. a state of confident hopefulness that events will be favorable
n. a trustful relationship
n. a secret that is confided or entrusted to another
zh: n. 信心
examples: Self-confidence is the principal element of any great endeavor.
Where did all that self-confidence come from?
exampleZh: 自信是伟大事业的第一要素。
哪来那么大的自信啊？

defsEn: n. one skilled in caring for young children or the sick (usually under the supervision of a physician)
v. try to cure by special care of treatment, of an illness or injury
v. serve as a nurse
care for sick or handicapped people
v. treat carefully
zh: n. 护士, 保姆, 奶妈
vt. 看护, 照顾, 培养
vi. 喂奶, 看护病人
examples: The nurse will tell you how to do it.
Why do you want to be a nurse?
exampleZh: 护士会告诉你怎么做。
你为什么想成为护士呢？

defsEn: n. the relation between opposed entities
n. a contestant that you are matched against
n. a body of people united in opposing something
n. a direction opposite to another
zh: n. 反对, 敌对, 相反, 在野党
examples: In the teeth of their strong opposition, we carried out our plan.
Our feckless opposition party didn't do enough to stop him.
exampleZh: 虽然受到他们的强烈反对，但我们还是实行了我们的计划。
我们软弱的反对派不足以阻止他。

defsEn: n. the total amount and type of insurance carried
n. the extent to which something is covered
n. the news as presented by reporters for newspapers or radio or television
zh: n. 覆盖的范围, 保险总额, 新闻报导
examples: Cell coverage is pretty spotty where I live.
There's no cellphone coverage in this area.

defsEn: n. a fundamental feeling that is hard to define but that people desire to experience
n. a formal expression
n. an activity that affords enjoyment
n. sexual gratification
zh: n. 快乐, 愉快, 令人高兴的事, 娱乐, 希望
v. (使)高兴
examples: We take great pleasure in meeting all of you this evening.
Pleasure is always in the past or in the future, never in the present.
exampleZh: 我们很高兴今晚能见到大家。
快乐存在于过去和未来，唯独不存在于现在。

defsEn: n. directs the work of others
n. an original creation (i.e., an audio recording) from which copies can be made
n. an officer who is licensed to command a merchant ship
n. someone who holds a master's degree from academic institution
zh: n. 主人, 硕士, 大师, 母机
a. 主人的, 主要的
vt. 征服, 控制, 精通
examples: Everyone ought to be the master of his own destiny.
Everyone ought to be a master of his own destiny.
exampleZh: 每个人都应该做自己命运的主人。
每个人都应该是自己命运的主宰。

defsEn: n. a period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event
n. a major division of geological time
an era is usually divided into two or more periods
zh: n. 时代, 纪元, 时期
examples: We are in the era of atomic energy.
The revolution ushered in a new era.
exampleZh: 我们身处核能时代。
革命迎来了新时代。

defsEn: n. required activity
zh: n. 需求, 必要条件, 要求
examples: Other requirements come from your relationships with other people and your daily activities.
So friendship is also a requirement for happiness.
exampleZh: 其它的要素来自你跟别人的关系和你平日的活动。
所以，友情也是幸福的一个要素。

defsEn: n. a movable organ for flying (one of a pair)
n. one of the horizontal airfoils on either side of the fuselage of an airplane
n. a stage area out of sight of the audience
n. a unit of military aircraft
zh: n. 翅膀, 翼, 机翼, 派别
vt. 给...装上翼, 飞过, 使飞, 空运, 增加...速度
vi. 飞行
examples: The plane lost part of its wing.
If I had wings, I would want to fly to your side right away.
exampleZh: 飞机失去了一部分机翼。
如果我有翅膀的话，真想马上飞到你的身边。

defsEn: n. a prominent or sensational but short-lived news event
n. emotional agitation and excitement
v. move an implement through
v. move very slightly
zh: n. 骚动, 轰动, 搅动, 监狱
vt. 移动, 摇动, 激起, 惹起, 搅拌
vi. 走动, 传播, 搅拌
examples: She stirred her coffee with a teaspoon.
I don't want to stir up old memories.
exampleZh: 她用茶匙搅她的咖啡。
我不愿意勾起久远的回忆。

defsEn: n. the most direct or specific meaning of a word or expression
the class of objects that an expression refers to
n. the act of referring or consulting
n. a publication (or a passage from a publication) that is referred to
n. the relation between a word or phrase and the object or idea it refers to
zh: n. 参考, 索引, 参照
vt. 给...加上参考资料
vt. 引用
vi. 引用
examples: Anonymity or detailed reference are both fine.
With reference to your request, I will support.
exampleZh: 不留名或详细的参考什么都可以。

defsEn: n. the state of being unsure of something
n. uncertainty about the truth or factuality or existence of something
v. consider unlikely or have doubts about
v. lack confidence in or have doubts about
zh: n. 怀疑, 疑惑
v. 怀疑, 不信
examples: I do not doubt it in the least.
I have no doubt about it.
exampleZh: 我对此毫不怀疑。
我没有疑问。

defsEn: r. in a serious manner
zh: adv. 严肃地, 认真地, 严重地
examples: You should seriously consider working here.
I'm seriously too busy, so I can't come tonight.
exampleZh: 你应该认真考虑在这里工作的事。
我实在很忙，所以今晚来不了。

defsEn: a. of or relating to or resulting from industry
a. having highly developed industries
s. employed in industry
s. suitable to stand up to hard wear
zh: a. 工业的, 供工业用的, 工业高度发展的, 产业的
n. 工业工人, 工业股票
examples: It occurred to me that he might be an industrial spy.
Industrial production rose sharply in July.
exampleZh: 我突然想到他可能是个商业间谍。
7月份工业生产大幅增长。

defsEn: n. characteristic or habitual practice
n. the latest and most admired style in clothes and cosmetics and behavior
n. consumer goods (especially clothing) in the current mode
v. make out of components (often in an improvising manner)
zh: n. 流行, 风尚, 时样
vt. 形成, 造, 作
examples: The short skirt is out of fashion.
Long hair is out of fashion now.
exampleZh: 短裙不时髦了。
长发现在过时了。

defsEn: n. the act of intervening (as to mediate a dispute, etc.)
n. a policy of intervening in the affairs of other countries
n. (law) a proceeding that permits a person to enter into a lawsuit already in progress
admission of person not an original party to the suit so that person can protect some right or interest that is allegedly affected by the proceedings
zh: n. 插入, 介入, 调停
examples: My intervention on your behalf is the only reason you still have a job.
His last-minute intervention saved the deal.

defsEn: n. the extreme end of something
especially something pointed
n. an indication of potential opportunity
v. cause to tilt
v. mark with a tip
zh: n. 顶, 尖端, 梢, 末端, 倾斜, 垃圾场, 小费, 轻击, 指点, 秘密消息
vt. 装顶端, 使倾斜, 使翻倒, 泄露, 告诫, 暗示, 给...小费, 轻击
vi. 倾斜, 翻倒, 倾覆, 踮脚走, 给小费
examples: My room is a tip. I need to tidy it.
I'll give you a little tip.
exampleZh: 我的房间很乱。我必须把它弄整齐。
我会给你些提示。

defsEn: n. a change for the better
progress in development
n. the act of improving something
n. a condition superior to an earlier condition
zh: n. 进步, 改善, 利用
examples: We've made a lot of improvements today.
Many improvements have been made since this century began.
exampleZh: 今天我们取得了很多进步。
本世纪初以来，产生了很多进步。

defsEn: n. an area of sand sloping down to the water of a sea or lake
v. land on a beach
zh: n. 海滩
examples: How do I get to the beach from here?
He likes to go to the beach now and then.
exampleZh: 从这里到海滩该怎么走？
他喜欢偶尔去海边。

defsEn: n. an open or empty space in or between things
n. a ceremony accompanying the start of some enterprise
n. becoming open or being made open
n. the first performance (as of a theatrical production)
zh: n. 开始, 口子, 穴, 揭幕
a. 开始的
examples: What job openings do you have right now?
What kind of job openings do you have?

defsEn: n. the product of a quantity by an integer
a. having or involving or consisting of more than one part or entity or individual
zh: n. 倍数, 并联
a. 多样的, 许多的, 多功能的
examples: Don't include multiple alternative words inside the same sentence.
He is charged with multiple property crimes.
exampleZh: 在同一句中不要包含多个可选单词。
他被指控犯有好几起侵犯财产罪。

defsEn: s. absolutely necessary
vitally necessary
a. basic and fundamental
a. being or relating to or containing the essence of a plant etc
zh: n. 要素, 要点, 本质
a. 必要的, 重要的, 本质的
examples: Memory is an essential function of our brain.
Patience is essential for a teacher.
exampleZh: 记忆是我们大脑的一种主要功能。
耐心对一个教师来说是必需的。

defsEn: n. an association of sports teams that organizes matches for its members
n. an association of states or organizations or individuals for common action
n. an obsolete unit of distance of variable length (usually 3 miles)
v. unite to form a league
zh: n. 同盟, 联盟, 盟约
v. 组联盟, (使)加盟
examples: Tom is out of your league.
Our team is the worst team in the league.
exampleZh: 汤姆不在你的联盟里。

defsEn: n. a sudden forceful flow
n. grasslike plants growing in wet places and having cylindrical often hollow stems
n. physician and American Revolutionary leader
signer of the Declaration of Independence (1745-1813)
n. a sudden burst of activity
zh: n. 匆促, 冲进, 急流, 灯心草
vi. 冲, 奔, 闯, 赶紧, 匆促行事, 涌现
vt. 使冲, 匆忙地做, 突袭, 飞跃, 用灯心草做
a. 紧急的
examples: He rushed into the room with his coat on.
There is no need for you to rush.
exampleZh: 他穿着衣服冲进房间。
您没有必要这么匆忙。

defsEn: s unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope
zh: a. 巨大的, 广大的, 非常的, 大量的
examples: However vast the darkness, we must supply our own light.
The Sahara is a vast desert.
exampleZh: 不论黑暗多么辽阔，我们都必须提供自身的光明。
撒哈拉沙漠广袤无垠。

defsEn: n a social unit living together
zh: n. 一家人, 家庭, 家族, 王室
a. 家庭的, 家常的, 王室的
examples: She was busy with household work.
I have a few household chores that I must do.
exampleZh: 她忙于家务。

defsEn: n. termination of pregnancy
zh: n. 流产, 堕胎, 失败, 夭折, 中止
examples: Are you for or against abortion?
Are you for or against abortions?
exampleZh: 你支持还是反对堕胎？
你支持还是反对堕胎？

defsEn: n. lighter consisting of a thin piece of wood or cardboard tipped with combustible chemical
ignites with friction
n. a formal contest in which two or more persons or teams compete
n. a burning piece of wood or cardboard
n. an exact duplicate
zh: n. 比赛, 火柴, 对手
vt. 使相配, 使比赛, 与...竞争
vi. 结婚, 相配
examples: There should be a box of matches in the top drawer.
This soccer match is full of energetic and splendid competition.
exampleZh: 最上面的抽屉里应该有一盒火柴。
这场足球赛充满着激情和精彩的竞争。

defsEn: r. only a very short time before
zh: adv. 几乎不
examples: I could barely get out of bed yesterday.
We have barely enough bread for breakfast.
exampleZh: 我昨天几乎下不了床。
我们早饭的面包刚够吃。

defsEn: v to stress, single out as important
v give extra weight to (a communication)
zh: vt. 强调, 加强语气, 着重
examples: I want to emphasize this point in particular.
Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.
exampleZh: 我想特别强调这一点。
线条艺术强调形式和轮廓，而不是颜色、阴影和纹理。

defsEn: n. a person who represents others
s. serving to represent or typify
a. standing for something else
s. being or characteristic of government by representation in which citizens exercise power through elected officers and representatives
zh: n. 代表, 众议员, 典型
a. 描写的, 表现的, 代理的, 代表的, 代议制的, 典型的
examples: Who is the current representative from France?
The Representative said he will put a brake on spending.
exampleZh: 这个年级的法方代表是谁？

defsEn: r in or to a place that is lower
zh: prep. 在...下方
adv. 在...下方
examples: The money was hidden beneath the floorboards.
The ground lay beneath a blanket of snow.
exampleZh: 那些钱藏了在地板下面。

defsEn: a. small in range or scope
s. including only a part
s. mediocre
s. not excessive
zh: a. 有限制的, 有限的, 有限责任的
n. 特别快车
examples: You should make the best of your limited time.
I feel limited in what I can do.

defsEn: n. one of the inherent cognitive or perceptual powers of the mind
zh: n. 才能, 能力, 全体教员, (大学的)系
examples: Many university faculty dislike the university president.
He was at a loss as to which faculty to choose.

defsEn: r without question and beyond doubt
zh: adv. 明确无疑地, 清楚地
examples: I will definitely attend your funeral.
There will definitely be a good-hearted person to take you away.
exampleZh: 我一定会去参加你的葬礼的。
一定会有好心人来带你走的。

defsEn: s. imposing in size or bulk or solidity
s. being the same substance throughout
s. imposing in scale or scope or degree or power
s. consisting of great mass
containing a great quantity of matter
zh: a. 大而重的, 宽大的, 宏伟的
examples: This is the most massive structure I have ever seen.
Hey, look! Look! There's a massive rainbow!
exampleZh: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。
喏，快看快看！那有一道巨大的彩虹！

defsEn: n. a telegram sent abroad
n. a conductor for transmitting electrical or optical signals or electric power
n. a very strong thick rope made of twisted hemp or steel wire
n. a nautical unit of depth
zh: n. 电缆, 海底电报, 缆, 索
vi. 打海底电报
vt. 发海底电报, 缚住
examples: We need to connect this cable to the generator.
What kind of cable do you need?

defsEn: n. the best people or things in a group
n. the part of milk containing the butterfat
n. toiletry consisting of any of various substances in the form of a thick liquid that have a soothing and moisturizing effect when applied to the skin
v. make creamy by beating
zh: n. 乳酪, 奶油, 面霜
examples: Would you like some cream in your coffee?
I put some cream in my coffee.
exampleZh: 你要在咖啡上加些奶油吗？
我在我的咖啡里放了一些奶油。

defsEn: n. a person who is head of an administrative department of government
n. an assistant who handles correspondence and clerical work for a boss or an organization
n. a desk used for writing
zh: n. 秘书, 书记, 大臣
examples: The secretary stuffed the letter into an envelope.
His secretary seems to know the truth.
exampleZh: 秘书把信塞到了信封里。
他的秘书好像了解真相。

defsEn: r. by bad luck
zh: adv. 恐怕, 不幸的是
examples: Unfortunately, I have to get up early every morning.
Unfortunately I will not have much free time.
exampleZh: 不幸的是，我必须每天早起。
遗憾的是我空闲时间不会有很多。

defsEn: n. law enacted by a legislative body
n. the act of making or enacting laws
zh: n. 立法, 法律
examples: We have to pass this legislation.
The government has the power of legislation.

defsEn: n the action of accomplishing something
zh: n. 完成, 成就, 功业
examples: The moon landing was a monumental achievement.
This will be the crowning achievement of my career.
exampleZh: 登月是一项里程碑式的成就。

defsEn: n. the act of someone who fishes as a diversion
n. the occupation of catching fish for a living
zh: n. 钓鱼, 鱼业
a. 钓鱼的
examples: You can catch a variety of fish while fishing.
You can learn a lot about nature while fishing.

defsEn: a. being of use or service
zh: a. 有用的, 有益的
examples: This knife was very useful to me.
The horse is a useful animal.
exampleZh: 这把刀对我很有用。
马是种很有用的动物。

defsEn: n. a person who possesses unusual innate ability in some field or activity
zh: n. 天才, 才能, 有才干的人, 天资
examples: She is very proud of her talent.
With all the talent he has, he never makes any effort.
exampleZh: 她对自己的才能很自豪。
他虽然很有才能，但却不肯努力上进。

defsEn: n. a distinguishing quality
n. the integer part (positive or negative) of the representation of a logarithm
in the expression log 643 = 2.808 the characteristic is 2
n. any measurable property of a device measured under closely specified conditions
a. typical or distinctive
zh: n. 特性, 特征, 特色
a. 特性的, 特有的, 有特色的
examples: What are the characteristics of this new type of urban life?
I got over the difficulty with my characteristic tenacity.
exampleZh: 这种新型的城市生活有什么特点？
我凭韧性克服了困难。

defsEn: n. the actors in a play
n. the distinctive form in which a thing is made
n. bandage consisting of a firm covering (often made of plaster of Paris) that immobilizes broken bones while they heal
n. object formed by a mold
zh: n. 演员阵容, 投掷, 铸件, 预测, 特性
vt. 投, 掷, 抛, 脱落, 铸, 使弯曲, 计算
vi. 投, 计算, 浇铸成型
examples: She cast a shy glance on the youth.
The tree cast a long shadow.
exampleZh: 她羞怯地看了一眼那个年轻人。
树投下长长的影子。

defsEn: a. not usual or common or ordinary
s. not commonly encountered
zh: a. 不寻常的, 罕见的, 与众不同的
examples: The house stood out because of its unusual shape.
My mother is an unusual person.
exampleZh: 那房子因为其少有的形状被突显出来。
我母亲是个奇特的人。

defsEn: n. the vertical dimension of extension
distance from the base of something to the top
zh: n. 高度, 海拔, 高地, 顶点
examples: She's almost the same height as you.
She's about the same height as you.
exampleZh: 她差不多和你一样高。
她大概跟你一样高。

defsEn: n a licensed medical practitioner
zh: n. 医师, 内科医师, 解除痛苦者
examples: The physician prescribed his patient some medicine.
I want to be a physician in the future.
exampleZh: 医生给他的病人开了一些药。

defsEn: r. in essence or effect but not in fact
zh: adv. 事实上
examples: It would be virtually impossible to do that.
It would be virtually impossible to convince Tom to come along with us.

defsEn: n. a component that is added to something to improve it
n. the act of adding one thing to another
n. a quantity that is added
n. a suburban area laid out in streets and lots for a future residential area
zh: n. 加法, 增加的人(或物)
examples: In addition, we will issue the 'employee of the month' award afterwards.
In addition to English, he can speak French.
exampleZh: 另外，之后我们会颁发“每月最佳员工”奖。
除了英语，他还会说法语。

defsEn: a. marked by suitability or rightness or appropriateness
s. having all the qualities typical of the thing specified
not just a snack"
s. limited to the thing specified
s. appropriate for a condition or purpose or occasion or a person's character, needs
zh: a. 适当的, 固有的, 高尚的, 专属的
adv. 完全地, 彻底地
examples: A proper test does not allow the use of correction fluid.
We need to have a proper clear-out here.
exampleZh: 正规的考试不允许使用涂改液。

defsEn: n. a field on which the buildings of a university are situated
zh: n. 校园, 大学生活
examples: In the center of the university campus stands the statue of the founder.
I met her on campus yesterday.
exampleZh: 创校人的雕像在大学校园的中心矗立着。
我昨天在校园里遇到了她。

defsEn: n. a line of units following one after another
n. a vertical glass tube used in column chromatography
a mixture is poured in the top and washed through a stationary substance where components of the mixture are adsorbed selectively to form colored bands
n. a vertical array of numbers or other information
n. anything that approximates the shape of a column or tower
zh: n. 专栏, 圆柱, 纵队, 列, 柱形物
examples: The opinion column discusses the importance of voting.
A column of white smoke rose into the sky.
exampleZh: 意见栏讨论了投票的重要性，

defsEn: n. a mutual or reciprocal action
interacting
n. (physics) the transfer of energy between elementary particles or between an elementary particle and a field or between fields
mediated by gauge bosons
zh: n. 交互作用, 交感
examples: Social interaction is the very foundation of social life.
All interactions involve the use of some kind of turn-taking organization.

defsEn: n. the complex of all the attributes--behavioral, temperamental, emotional and mental--that characterize a unique individual
n. a person of considerable prominence
zh: n. 个性, 人格, (团体、地方、国家)特有特性, 名人
examples: She has a very open personality.
A connection between personality and blood type has not been scientifically proven.
exampleZh: 她是个很坦率的人。
科学上，血型和性格的关联性没有被证明。

defsEn: n an integrated course of academic studies
zh: n. 课程
examples: The curriculum of this school is wide and shallow.
How can I print my curriculum vitae?

defsEn: n. a male sovereign
ruler of a kingdom
n. a competitor who holds a preeminent position
n. preeminence in a particular category or group or field
n. United States woman tennis player (born in 1943)
zh: n. 国王, 君主
vt. 使...成为君主
vi. 君临, 统治
examples: When I grow up, I want to be king.
They demanded the king be put to death at once.
exampleZh: 当我长大后，我想当国王。
他们要求马上把国王处死。

defsEn: n the activity of contributing to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose
n a resource
zh: n. 协助, 援助
examples: Your assistance is indispensable for us.
What would you like? Perhaps I could be of assistance?
exampleZh: 您的帮助对我们来说是必不可少的。

defsEn: n. (usually plural) a polite expression of desire for someone's welfare
n. a feeling of friendship and esteem
v. look at attentively
zh: n. 关心, 注意, 尊敬, 关系, 问候
vt. 视为, 注意, 考虑, 和...有关, 看待
vi. 注视, 注意
examples: They regard him as the best doctor in town.
She told me the matter regarding her teacher.
exampleZh: 他们把他视为城里最好的医生。
她告诉我关于她老师的事。

defsEn: n. a workplace for the conduct of scientific research
zh: n. 实验室, 研究室
examples: The air conditioner in the lab is broken.
Can you meet me in the lab?
exampleZh: 实验室里的空调坏了。

defsEn: n. cloak that is folded or wrapped around a person
n. a sandwich in which the filling is rolled up in a soft tortilla
v. arrange or fold as a cover or protection
v. crash into so as to coil around
zh: n. 外套, 围巾, 包裹物, 限制, 约束, 秘密, 换行
vt. 包装, 卷, 缠绕, 包, 裹, 覆盖, 遮蔽, 隐藏, 掩护
vi. 缠绕, 穿外衣, 包起来
examples: Please wrap it like a Christmas present.
Can you wrap it up for me? It's a gift.
exampleZh: 请把它包装得像一个圣诞礼物。
可以帮我包起来吗？我拿来送人的。

defsEn: n. a useful or valuable quality
zh: n. 资产, 有益的东西
examples: Assets have earning power or some other value to their owner.
He has over a million dollars in assets.
exampleZh: 资产对所有者来说，具有盈利能力或一些其他的价值。
他有超过一百万美元的资产。

defsEn: n. a kind of religious song originated by Blacks in the southern United States
s. concerned with or affecting the spirit or soul
s. lacking material body or form or substance
zh: a. 精神上的, 神圣的, 崇高的, 高尚的, 鬼的, 招魂术的
n. 有关教会的事
examples: Not material, but spiritual things determine our life.
She used to be a very spiritual person in the past.
exampleZh: 我们的生活不是由物质，而是由精神来决定的。

defsEn: n. a play or film whose action and dialogue is interspersed with singing and dancing
a. characterized by or capable of producing music
a. talented in or devoted to music
a. characteristic of or resembling or accompanied by music
zh: n. 音乐片, 音乐舞台剧
a. 音乐的, 声音美妙的, 喜爱音乐的
examples: Do you play a musical instrument?
Mozart: one of the great musical prodigies of all time.
exampleZh: 你演奏乐器吗？
莫札特: 一个永远的音乐奇才

defsEn: n. a writer for newspapers and magazines
zh: n. 新闻记者, 从事新闻杂志业的人
examples: I think of the woman as a journalist.
I want to be a journalist.
exampleZh: 我想到那位当记者的女人。
我想成为记者。

defsEn: n. a learned person (especially in the humanities)
someone who by long study has gained mastery in one or more disciplines
n. a student who holds a scholarship
zh: n. 学者, 奖学金获得者, 有文化者, 学习者
examples: He is the scholar in our class.
According to some scholars, a major earthquake could occur at any moment now.
exampleZh: 他是我们班里的秀才。
据一些学者称，现在可能随时发生一场特大地震。

defsEn: n. a solid food prepared from the pressed curd of milk
v. used in the imperative (get away, or stop it)
v. wind onto a cheese
zh: n. 乳酪
examples: We make milk into cheese and butter.
I want to eat the cheese.
exampleZh: 我们把牛奶制成乳酪和奶油。
我想吃奶酪。

defsEn: n. the act of making and recording a measurement
n. the act of observing
taking a patient look
n. a remark expressing careful consideration
n. facts learned by observing
zh: n. 观察, 注意, 观测, 观察力
examples: His observations are sharp, but he doesn't say much.
They set up an observation station in the desert.
exampleZh: 他的观察是敏锐的，但他没有说太多。

defsEn: n. a sum of money paid or a claim discharged
n. the act of paying money
zh: n. 付款, 支付的款项(或实物), 偿还, 报应, 惩罚
examples: We will make the payment by bank transfer.
I prefer payment in full to payment in part.
exampleZh: 我们会用银行转帐付款。

defsEn: n. a concise explanation of the meaning of a word or phrase or symbol
n. clarity of outline
zh: n. 定义, 精确度, 清晰度
examples: Can you show me the definition?
Why limit the definition of mating to just a male and female?

defsEn: n. the human act of creating
n. an artifact that has been brought into existence by someone
n. the event that occurred at the beginning of something
n. (theology) God's act of bringing the universe into existence
zh: n. 创造, 创作物, 发明
examples: The creation of most schools was not to transform society, but to reconstruct society.
I criticize by creation, not by finding fault.
exampleZh: 大部分学校的创建不是用来转变社会，而是用来重建社会的。

defsEn: n. a measuring instrument for measuring fluid volume
a glass container (cup or cylinder or flask) whose sides are marked with or divided into amounts
v. receive an academic degree upon completion of one's studies
v. confer an academic degree upon
s. of or relating to studies beyond a bachelor's degree
zh: n. 毕业生, 量杯
a. 已得学位的, 研究生的, 毕业的
vi. 毕业, 得学位, 逐渐变为
vt. 准予...毕业, 授予...学位, 分等级, 刻刻度
examples: If you pass this test, you could graduate next month.
After I graduate, I'd like to take the graduate school entrance examination.
exampleZh: 如果你通过这个考试，你下个月就可以毕业了。
大学毕业以后我也想考研究生。

defsEn: a. suitable to or characteristic of drama
s. sensational in appearance or thrilling in effect
a. pertaining to or characteristic of drama
a. used of a singer or singing voice that is marked by power and expressiveness and a histrionic or theatrical style
zh: a. 戏剧性的, 生动的
examples: He put on a big dramatic act of dying.
Why do you have to be so dramatic?

defsEn: n. a conspicuous disparity or difference as between two figures
n. a narrow opening
n. a difference (especially an unfortunate difference) between two opinions or two views or two situations
v. make an opening or gap in
zh: n. 缝隙, 缺口, 间断, 间距, 通用汇编程序
vt. 打开缺口, 造成缝隙
vi. 豁开
examples: Please mind the gap between the train and the platform.
The gap between them has narrowed.
exampleZh: 请小心月台与车厢之间的空隙。
两人之间的距离已拉近。

defsEn: n. the phenomenon of resistance to motion through a fluid
n. something that slows or delays progress
n. something tedious and boring
n. clothing that is conventionally worn by the opposite sex (especially women's clothing when worn by a man)
zh: n. 拖, 拖累
v. 拖累, 拖拉, 沉重缓慢地走, 拖动
examples: Tom dragged himself out of bed and put on his clothes.
The stage charisma of drag performers compels audiences to reconsider their own stereotypes.
exampleZh: 汤姆从床上爬起来，穿上了衣服。
反串秀者的舞台魅力使观众不禁重新审视自己的刻板印象。

defsEn: n. a room where books are kept
n. a collection of literary documents or records kept for reference or borrowing
n. a depository built to contain books and other materials for reading and study
n. (computing) a collection of standard programs and subroutines that are stored and available for immediate use
zh: n. 图书馆, 藏书, 库
examples: I see him in the library now and then.
How about we go to the library together to study?
exampleZh: 有时我会在图书馆看见他。
咱们一起去图书馆学习，你觉得怎么样？

defsEn: n. a temporally organized plan for matters to be attended to
n. a list of matters to be taken up (as at a meeting)
zh: pl. 议程, 日常工作事项
examples: What's on the agenda for today?
What's on your agenda for today?

defsEn: n. an assortment of things from which a choice can be made
zh: n. 选择, 选文, 精选品
examples: We have a wide selection of fruit and vegetables in our shop.
There was a large selection of fruit on the market.

defsEn: n. a protective covering that covers or forms the top of a building
n. protective covering on top of a motor vehicle
n. the inner top surface of a covered area or hollow space
v. provide a building with a roof
cover a building with a roof
zh: n. 屋顶, 室顶
vt. 给...盖屋顶, 遮蔽
examples: You can see the roof of the house from there.
There is a lot of snow on the roof.
exampleZh: 你能从那里看到房顶。
房顶上有很多雪。

defsEn: n readiness to embark on bold new ventures
n the first of a series of actions
s serving to set in motion
zh: n. 主动行动, 首创精神, 主动权
a. 自发的, 起始的
examples: He takes the initiative in helping his mother do the housework.
The initiative measurably improved quality of life for the villagers.
exampleZh: 他主动帮他妈妈做家务。
计划使村民的生活改善了不少。

defsEn: n financial resources provided to make some project possible
n the act of financing
v convert (short-term floating debt) into long-term debt that bears fixed interest and is represented by bonds
v place or store up in a fund for accumulation
v provide a fund for the redemption of principal or payment of interest
v invest money in government securities
v accumulate a fund for the discharge of a recurrent liability
v furnish money for
zh: 债务转期
examples: Our project will wither on the vine without funding.
This researcher does not disclose the source of his funding.

defsEn: n. (medicine) the act of caring for someone (as by medication or remedial training etc.)
zh: n. 治疗
examples: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.
Will the therapy cause me any pain?
exampleZh: 这几年对作业疗法的需求在迅速增长。

defsEn: n. structures collectively in which people are housed
n. a protective cover designed to contain or support a mechanical component
zh: n. 遮盖, 住房供给, 居留(处), 房屋, 装饰
examples: We live in a housing estate.
They could not get good housing.

defsEn: n. the position where someone (as a guard or sentry) stands or is assigned to stand
n. an upright consisting of a piece of timber or metal fixed firmly in an upright position
n. United States aviator who in 1933 made the first solo flight around the world (1899-1935)
n. United States female author who wrote a book and a syndicated newspaper column on etiquette (1872-1960)
zh: n. 柱, 杆, 准星, 邮件, 邮政, 标竿, 职位, 岗位, 哨所, 兵营
vt. 张帖, 邮递, 公布, 登入帐, 使熟悉, 布置
vi. 快速行进
adv. 急速地
examples: There used to be a post office here.
Please post this letter when you next go to the post office.
exampleZh: 这里以前有邮局。
下次去邮局的时候，请把这封信寄出去。

defsEn: s. presently existing
s. existing in something specified
zh: a. 存在的, 目前的, 现存的, 现有的
examples: There is no existing grammar that can be said to be absolutely correct.
That's just an extension of an existing idea. There's little novel about it.

defsEn: v deem to be
v look at attentively
v connect closely and often incriminatingly
zh: prep. 关于
examples: I once thought the same as you regarding this issue.
They have a different opinion regarding your problem.

defsEn: v stay the same
remain in a certain state
v continue in a place, position, or situation
v be left
of persons, questions, problems, results, evidence, etc.
v stay behind
s not used up
zh: 剩余的
examples: Do you want to spend your remaining time in prison?
The door remaining locked up from inside, he could not enter the house.

defsEn: r. without favoring one party, in a fair evenhanded manner
r. in conformity with the rules or laws and without fraud or cheating
zh: adv. 美观地, 公平地, 相当地, 清楚地
examples: We must deal fairly with these people.
That sounds like a fairly good proposal.
exampleZh: 我们必须公平地对待这些人。
这方案听起来不错。

defsEn: a. acting with or marked by or resulting from great force or energy or emotional intensity
s. effected by force or injury rather than natural causes
s. (of colors or sounds) intensely vivid or loud
zh: a. 暴力的, 猛烈的, 激烈的, 极端的, 凶暴的
examples: She's violent right now. It'd be better to avoid her.
Let us pray that this violent crisis would soon be over.
exampleZh: 她现在很暴力。最好避着点。

defsEn: n. a triangular wooden float attached to the end of a log line
n. a piece of dried bovine dung
n. a thin crisp slice of potato fried in deep fat
n. a small disk-shaped counter used to represent money when gambling
zh: n. 屑片, 薄片, 碎片
vt. 削, 切, 削成碎片, 使摔倒, 凿
vi. 削下屑片
examples: We all chipped in to buy our teacher a birthday present.
There was a single potato chip on each plate.
exampleZh: 我们所有人凑分子给老师买生日礼物。
每个盘子里都有一块薯片。

defsEn: s. marked by absence of sound
s. implied by or inferred from actions or statements
s. not made to sound
s. having a frequency below or above the range of human audibility
zh: a. 沉默的, 安静的, 无声的, 静止的
examples: He asked that we be silent.
He kept silent during the meeting.
exampleZh: 他要求我们安静。
他开会的时候一句话也没有说。

defsEn: n. the act of examining resemblances
n. relation based on similarities and differences
n. qualities that are comparable
zh: n. 比较, 对照, 比喻
examples: This is a multi-language word comparison table.
In comparison to him, I am still older.
exampleZh: 这是一张多语言的单词对照表。
我比他年纪还大。

defsEn: n. a conclusive resolution of a matter and disposition of it
n. something settled or resolved
the outcome of decision making
n. an area where a group of families live together
zh: n. 安顿, 解决, 处理, 结算, 殖民, 殖民地, 沉降
examples: We expect an early settlement of the affair.
Ziri saw a human settlement on the other side of the river.

defsEn: n. an act of formulating a program for a definite course of action
n. the act or process of drawing up plans or layouts for some project or enterprise
n. the cognitive process of thinking about what you will do in the event of something happening
zh: n. 计划的制订, 策划, 设计, 规划
examples: We have a lot of planning to do.
Good planning can make the difference between success and failure.

defsEn: n. a statement that represents something in words
n. the act of describing something
n. sort or variety
zh: n. 描述, 说明, 种类
examples: The man answers to the description in the newspaper.
He gave a detailed description of the accident.
exampleZh: 那个男人和报纸上描述的一模一样。
他详细地敍述了那场意外的经过。

defsEn: n. the social event at which the ceremony of marriage is performed
n. a party of people at a wedding
zh: n. 婚礼, 结婚, 结婚周年纪念日, 结合
examples: Not long before his wedding he decided not to get married.
The wedding will take place on Saturday.
exampleZh: 他在要结婚之际决定还是不结婚了。
婚礼会在星期六举行。

defsEn: s. characterized by active hostility
zh: n. 对手, 敌手, 反对者
a. 敌对的, 反对的, 对面的
examples: He is superior to his opponents in all respects.
He beat one opponent after the next.
exampleZh: 他在各方面都超出他的对手。

defsEn: n. (psychology) a state of mental or emotional strain or suspense
n. the physical condition of being stretched or strained
n. a balance between and interplay of opposing elements or tendencies (especially in art or literature)
n. (physics) a stress that produces an elongation of an elastic physical body
zh: n. 紧张, 不安, 拉紧, 张力, 压力, 电压
vt. 拉紧, 使紧张
examples: I have a lot of tension in my back.
You could feel the tension in the air.

defsEn: s. indicating the most important performer or role
s. greatest in importance or degree or significance or achievement
a. going or proceeding or going in advance
showing the way
zh: n. 领导, 指挥, 神示, 铅板
a. 领导的, 主要的, 在前的
examples: I saw some people there leading a low life.
Do you like the people leading the country?

defsEn: v. intrude or enter uninvited
v. make nervous or agitated
v. make confused or perplexed or puzzled
zh: vt. 烦扰, 迷惑
vi. 烦恼, 操心
n. 麻烦, 纠纷, 讨厌的人
examples: Do not bother to come to my home.
May I bother you for a moment?
exampleZh: 不用特地来我家了。
我可以打扰你一下吗？

defsEn: s. characterized by thriftiness
zh: n. 存款, 挽救, 节约
a. 搭救的, 节约的, 保留的, 补偿的
prep. 除...之外
examples: Saving energy can reduce the emission of greenhouse gases into the atmosphere.
They are saving their money for the purchase of a house.
exampleZh: 节约能源可减少温室气体排出到大气层。
他们在储钱买房子。

defsEn: n. a circular segment of a curve
n. curved segment (of a road or river or railroad track etc.)
n. a town in central Oregon at the eastern foot of the Cascade Range
n. diagonal line traversing a shield from the upper right corner to the lower left
zh: vi. 变弯曲, 屈服
vt. 使弯曲, 使屈服
n. 弯曲
examples: Tom took the bend too fast and landed in the ditch.
I can't bend my right arm.
exampleZh: 汤姆拐弯儿拐得太快了，把车开到了水沟里。
我无法弯曲我的右手臂。

defsEn: n uncomplimentary terms for a policeman
v take by theft
v take into custody
zh: n. 警官
vt. 抓住
examples: Don't let the cops find a heater on you.
The cops threw tear-gas bombs into the building.
exampleZh: 不要给警察发现你身上有枪。
警方将催泪弹投掷到了建筑中。

defsEn: n. the Romance language spoken in most of Spain and the countries colonized by Spain
n. the people of Spain
a. of or relating to or characteristic of Spain or the people of Spain
zh: n. 西班牙人, 西班牙语
a. 西班牙的
examples: I know how to speak Spanish and French.
The Spanish make a type of brandy with the fruits of the strawberry tree.
exampleZh: 我会说西班牙语和法语。
西班牙人用草莓树的果实酿造一种白兰地。

defsEn: n. a domain that seems to be specially reserved for someone
n. a reservation where animals are protected
v. prevent (food) from rotting
v. keep undisturbed for personal or private use for hunting, shooting, or fishing
zh: vt. 保护, 保持, 保存, 维持, 腌, 禁猎
vi. 加工食品, 禁猎
