n. 加工成的食品, 禁猎地, 保护区, 防护物
examples: Salt helps to preserve food from decay.
Preserve life; please don't waste water.
exampleZh: 盐可以帮助保存食物避免腐烂。
关爱生命，请勿嬉水。

defsEn: n. the act of passing from one state or place to the next
n. a section of text
particularly a section of medium length
n. a way through or along which someone or something may pass
n. a journey usually by ship
zh: n. 通道, 通过, 移居, 航行, 一段, 走廊
vi. 通过, 经过, 航行, 横渡, 争吵
vt. (使)马以斜横步前进, 使传代
examples: Translate the passage word for word.
There's a secret passage on the left.
exampleZh: 逐字地翻译这个段落。
在左边有一条秘密通道。

defsEn: a. being in accord with established forms and conventions and requirements (as e.g. of formal dress)
s. characteristic of or befitting a person in authority
a. (of spoken and written language) adhering to traditional standards of correctness and without casual, contracted, and colloquial forms
s. logically deductive
zh: a. 正式的, 形式的, 礼仪的, 拘于礼节的, 拘谨的
n. 正式的社交活动
examples: You don't need to prepare a formal speech.
You don't have to be so formal.
exampleZh: 您没必要准备一个正式的演讲。
你没必要那么正式。

defsEn: n. a change from one place or state or subject or stage to another
n. a musical passage moving from one key to another
n. a passage that connects a topic to one that follows
v. cause to convert or undergo a transition
zh: n. 转变, 转换, 变迁, 过渡时期, 临时转调
examples: How to achieve the transition from oil to a diverse economy in Algeria?
The transition from farm life to city life is often difficult.

defsEn: n the state or fact of existing
n everything that exists anywhere
zh: n. 存在, 生存
examples: Do you believe in the existence of ghosts?
Three out of four Americans believe in the existence of paranormal phenomena.
exampleZh: 你相信有幽灵吗？
四分之三的美国人相信存在超自然现象。

defsEn: v. put into a proper or systematic order
v. make arrangements for
v. adapt for performance in a different way
v. arrange thoughts, ideas, temporal events
zh: v. 安排, 排列, 达成协议
examples: Can you arrange for a night tour bus?
In the afternoon I must arrange for the trip.
exampleZh: 你能安排一个晚上坐观光巴士吗?
下午我必须为旅行做准备了。

defsEn: n. a fastener fitted to a door or drawer to keep it firmly closed
n. a strand or cluster of hair
n. a mechanism that detonates the charge of a gun
n. enclosure consisting of a section of canal that can be closed to control the water level
used to raise or lower vessels that pass through it
zh: n. 锁, 刹车, 水闸, 一缕头发
vt. 锁, 锁上, 拘禁, 隐藏, (用锁等)拴住, 刹住
vi. 锁住, (齿轮等)啮合, (船)过闸
examples: Please lock the door when you leave.
Could you please lock the door?
exampleZh: 请你出门的时候把门锁上。
请你锁门好吗？

defsEn: v. be worthy or deserving
zh: vt. 该得到, 值得
vi. 应得报答
examples: She deserves to know the truth.
He deserves six of the best for being so rude.
exampleZh: 该有人告诉她真实情况。
他这样粗鲁，该棒打几下。

defsEn: a. (sometimes followed by `with') in agreement or consistent or reliable
s. the same throughout in structure or composition
zh: a. 一致的, 坚持的, 并立的, 坚固的
examples: His daily behavior is not consistent with his principles.
Her behavior is consistent with her words.
exampleZh: 他的日常行为并不和他的原则相一致。
她言行一致。

defsEn: n. the action of opposing something that you disapprove or disagree with
n. any mechanical force that tends to retard or oppose motion
n. the military action of resisting the enemy's advance
n. the capacity of an organism to defend itself against harmful environmental agents
zh: n. 抵抗力, 反抗, 耐力, 阻力, 电阻
examples: The resistance to theory is the resistance to the use of language about language.
We must put up resistance against the English invasion.

defsEn: n. the act of discovering something
n. something that is discovered
n. a productive insight
n. (law) compulsory pretrial disclosure of documents relevant to a case
enables one side in a litigation to elicit information from the other side concerning the facts in the case
zh: n. 发现, 被发现的事物
examples: This discovery will be recorded in history.
The discovery of truth should remain the single aim of science.
exampleZh: 这个发现将会在历史上留下光辉的一页。

defsEn: n. vulnerability to the elements
to the action of heat or cold or wind or rain
n. the act of subjecting someone to an influencing experience
n. the disclosure of something secret
n. aspect resulting from the direction a building or window faces
zh: n. 暴露, 揭发, 揭露
examples: Long-term exposure to radiation may cause genetic damage.
Exposure to nature can decrease our blood pressure.

defsEn: n. a natural body of running water flowing on or under the earth
n. dominant course (suggestive of running water) of successive events or ideas
n. something that resembles a flowing stream in moving continuously
v. to extend, wave or float outward, as if in the wind
zh: n. 水流, 小河, 流出, 趋势, 人潮
vt. 流出, 流动, 展开
vi. 流, 涌, 飘扬
examples: A stream of people came out of the theater.
The stream flows into the pond.
exampleZh: 剧场里涌出一大群人。
溪水流进这个池塘里。

defsEn: n. a particular instance of selling
n. the general activity of selling
n. an occasion (usually brief) for buying at specially reduced prices
n. the state of being purchasable
offered or exhibited for selling
zh: n. 出售, 卖, 拍卖, 销售额, 廉价出售
examples: Sales fell off in the third quarter.
This house is not for sale.
exampleZh: 在第三季时销售跌了下来。
这房子不出售。

defsEn: n. metal or earthenware cooking vessel that is usually round and deep
often has a handle and lid
n. the quantity contained in a pot
n. a container in which plants are cultivated
n. the cumulative amount involved in a game (such as poker)
zh: n. 盆, 罐, 壶, 坩埚, 奖杯
vt. 装入盆中, 在锅中煮, 随手射击
vi. 随手射击
examples: There's a red rose in the pot.
There is no sugar left in the pot.
exampleZh: 花盆里有一朵红玫瑰。
罐头里没有砂糖了。

defsEn: s. large and impressive in physical size or extent
s. the most important and magnificent in adornment
zh: a. 庄重的, 壮观的, 显赫的, 重大的, 最高的, 雄伟的, 宏大的, 豪华的, 傲慢的
examples: Please take me to the Grand Hotel.
Look at this grand view of the ocean.
exampleZh: 请带我到大饭店。

defsEn: n a message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events
presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program
n a trivial lie
zh: n. 故事, 谎言, 谣言, 陈述, 叙述
examples: This fairy tale is easy enough for a seven-year-old child to read.
It is a very sad tale.
exampleZh: 这个童话故事很浅白，七岁的小孩也看得懂。
这是一个非常悲伤的故事。

defsEn: n. an outer garment that has sleeves and covers the body from shoulder down
worn outdoors
n. growth of hair or wool or fur covering the body of an animal
v. put a coat on
cover the surface of
furnish with a surface
v. cover or provide with a coat
zh: n. 外套
vt. 外面覆盖, 给...穿外套
examples: Do you have a coat and a hat?
I think this coat should fit you.
exampleZh: 你有外套和帽子吗？
我认为这外套应该适合你。

defsEn: n. (medicine) any sensation or change in bodily function that is experienced by a patient and is associated with a particular disease
n. anything that accompanies X and is regarded as an indication of X's existence
zh: n. 症状, 征候, 征兆
examples: If symptoms do not ease after taking Suxiao Jiuxin Pills, take nitroglycerin immediately.
Do you have this symptom often?
exampleZh: 如果服用速效救心丸后症状并未缓解，请立即服用硝酸甘油。

defsEn: a on a regular route of a railroad or bus or airline system
a connected to a computer network or accessible by computer
s being in progress now
zh: 联机
examples: He found out this information online.
I sold my old car online.
exampleZh: 他是在网上发现这个信息的。
我在网上卖了我的旧车。

defsEn: n. a discussion intended to produce an agreement
n. the activity or business of negotiating an agreement
coming to terms
zh: n. 谈判, 磋商, 交涉
examples: We want to break off this negotiation.
In labor negotiation union leaders play an important role.

defsEn: n. reason
n. the time of a particular event
n. an opportunity to do something
v. give occasion to
zh: n. 场合, 时机, 机会, 诱因, 理由
vt. 惹起, 引起
examples: On gift-giving occasions, people generally avoid giving money, but there are exceptions.
I meet her on occasion at a beauty shop.
exampleZh: 人们送礼通常都不会送钱，但是也会有例外的情况。

defsEn: n. a short coat
n. an outer wrapping or casing
n. the outer skin of a potato
n. the tough metal shell casing for certain kinds of ammunition
zh: n. 夹克, 外套, 护套
vt. 给...穿夹克, 给...装护套
examples: This tie and that jacket go well together.
He put on the red jacket.
exampleZh: 这条领带和那件上衣很配。
他穿上了红色的外套。

defsEn: n. a judge of a probate court
n. the expected or commonplace condition or situation
n. a clergyman appointed to prepare condemned prisoners for death
n. an early bicycle with a very large front wheel and small back wheel
zh: a. 平常的, 普通的, 平凡的
n. 平常的人(或事)
examples: We lead a very ordinary life.
You cannot solve this problem in an ordinary way.
exampleZh: 我们过着十分平凡的生活。
这个问题不能用普通的办法解决。

defsEn: n. any process in which electrons are added to an atom or ion (as by removing oxygen or adding hydrogen)
always occurs accompanied by oxidation of the reducing agent
n. the act of reducing complexity
zh: n. 减少, 缩影, 变化
examples: They demand a reduction in working hours.
Tom works at a harm reduction clinic.
exampleZh: 他们要求减少工作时长。
汤姆在一家减害诊所工作。

defsEn: r. not often
zh: adv. 很少地, 罕有地
examples: In French, you can rarely omit the subject.
You rarely ever wake up this early.
exampleZh: 用法语，很少会遗漏主语。
你很少这么早起床。

defsEn: n. a complete collection of similar things
n. a convenient package or parcel (as of cigarettes or film)
n. a group of hunting animals
n. a cream that cleanses and tones the skin
zh: n. 包裹, 一伙, 一副, 背包, 包装
vt. 包装, 捆扎, 塞满, 压紧, 挑选
vi. 包装货物, 挤, 群集, 被包装
examples: She helped me pack my suitcase.
My father smokes a pack of cigarettes a day.
exampleZh: 她帮我打包我的手提箱。
我爸爸每天抽一包烟。

defsEn: s. amounting to a large indefinite number
zh: a. 很多的, 数目众多的, 多数的
examples: I have numerous books on my bookshelf.
They are too numerous to enumerate.
exampleZh: 我有大量的书在我的书架上。
他们人太多了，数不过来。

defsEn: n. a branch of knowledge
n. a system of rules of conduct or method of practice
n. the trait of being well behaved
n. training to improve strength or self-control
zh: n. 训练, 纪律
vt. 训练, 惩罚
examples: Take a belt and discipline your son right now.
School discipline is not as it should be.

defsEn: r. in or to another place
zh: adv. 在别处
examples: Could you park your car elsewhere, please?
We found him like that elsewhere.

defsEn: a. concerned with actual use or practice
s. having or put to a practical purpose or use
zh: a. 实际的, 现实的, 实用性的
examples: He was an intelligent and practical man.
It's practical to have a laptop.
exampleZh: 他是聪明能干的人。
有一台笔记本电脑很实用。

defsEn: r in addition
furthermore, their quality is improving"
moreover, mice nested there"
zh: adv. 而且, 此外
examples: It's a cat, and moreover an orange one.
They laugh and, moreover, with an open throat.
exampleZh: 这是一只猫，而且是一只橘色的猫。

defsEn: n. a strong feeling or emotion
n. a feeling of strong sexual desire
n. the suffering of Jesus at the Crucifixion
zh: n. 激情, 酷爱, 热爱, 强烈感情, 耶稣受难(故事)
examples: She has a passion for cake.
Though passion may have strained, it must not break our bonds of affection.
exampleZh: 她酷爱蛋糕。
虽然激情可能会褪去，但我们不能切断感情上的联系。

defsEn: n. (genetics) a segment of DNA that is involved in producing a polypeptide chain
it can include regions preceding and following the coding DNA as well as introns between the exons
it is considered a unit of heredity
zh: n. 基因
examples: The function of most genes remains a mystery.
If you could choose the genes for your children, would you?

defsEn: n. flavorful relish or dressing or topping served as an accompaniment to food
v. behave saucily or impudently towards
v. dress (food) with a relish
v. add zest or flavor to, make more interesting
zh: n. 酱油, 调味汁, 酱
vt. 给...调味, 使增加趣味
examples: I'd like the sauce on the side.
Can I have the sauce on the side, please?
exampleZh: 我想要酱料放在旁边。

defsEn: n. freedom from control or influence of another or others
n. the successful ending of the American Revolution
n. a city in western Missouri
the beginning of the Santa Fe Trail
zh: n. 独立, 自立, 自主
examples: I like this independence a lot.
I prefer to maintain my independence and freedom without the constraints of marriage.

defsEn: n. the commercial processes involved in promoting and selling and distributing a product or service
n. shopping at a market
zh: n. 行销, 买卖
examples: We need to develop a marketing plan.
I have a background in marketing.

defsEn: s. surprising greatly
s. inspiring awe or admiration or wonder
zh: a. 令人惊异的
examples: This week has been an amazing experience.
It would be amazing if we could do that.
exampleZh: 这周的经历真是太棒了。

defsEn: n. an amount paid before it is earned
n. increase in price or value
v. move forward, also in the metaphorical sense
v. bring forward for consideration or acceptance
zh: n. 前进, 进展, 行过的路程
vi. 前进, 进展, 提高, 上涨
vt. 使前进, 促进, 提出, 提高, 使提前, 预付
a. 前面的, 预先的
examples: Thank you in advance for your help.
Thank you in advance for your cooperation.
exampleZh: 我先谢谢你的帮忙。
提前感谢你们的合作。

defsEn: n. a person or firm that employs workers
zh: n. 雇主, 老板
examples: Germany is to ban employers from snooping on Facebook.
The employer must provide a safe working environment.
exampleZh: 德国将禁止雇主在脸书上偷窥。

defsEn: v. heighten or intensify
v. supply the inspiration for
zh: vt. 使感动, 激发, 启示, 吸入, 鼓舞, 产生, 使生灵感
vi. 吸入, 赋予灵感
examples: His speech inspired all the boys.
I inspired my students to work harder.
exampleZh: 他的演说激励了所有的男孩。
我鼓励学生们更努力地学习。

defsEn: n. impairment of normal physiological function affecting part or all of an organism
zh: n. 疾病, 恶意
examples: The medicine cured him of his illness.
His illness caused her great misery.
exampleZh: 那药治好了他的病。
他的病使她非常伤心。

defsEn: n. a tight-fitting headdress
n. a top (as for a bottle)
n. something serving as a cover or protection
n. a fruiting structure resembling an umbrella or a cone that forms the top of a stalked fleshy fungus such as a mushroom
zh: n. 盖子, 帽子
vt. 戴帽子, 覆盖, 胜过
vi. 脱帽致意
examples: Take off your caps in the classroom!
The cap is too small for me.
exampleZh: 在教室里请摘下帽子！
这顶帽子对我来说太小了。

defsEn: a. involving competition or competitiveness
s. subscribing to capitalistic competition
s. showing a fighting disposition
zh: a. 竞争的
examples: To remain competitive, we've got to play to our strengths.
Having a competitive mentality can give rise to negative emotions.
exampleZh: 为了保持竞争力，我们得发挥我们的优势。
攀比心理会让人产生负面情绪。

defsEn: n. an established custom
n. (psychology) an automatic pattern of behavior in reaction to a specific situation
may be inherited or acquired through frequent repetition
n. a distinctive attire worn by a member of a religious order
n. the general form or mode of growth (especially of a plant or crystal)
zh: n. 习惯, 嗜好, 习性
vt. 使穿衣
examples: My father is in the habit of reading the newspaper before breakfast.
I wish I could break the habit of smoking.
exampleZh: 我父亲有个习惯，早餐之前读报纸。
真希望自己能把烟瘾戒掉。

defsEn: a. of or relating to congress
zh: a. 会议的, 议会的, 国会的
examples: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.
The congressional staffer who leaked classified documents has been arrested.
exampleZh: 议员受到了议会道德委员会的谴责。

defsEn: n. the liquid part that can be extracted from plant or animal tissue by squeezing or cooking
n. energetic vitality
n. electric current
n. any of several liquids of the body
zh: n. 汁, 活力, 体液
vt. 挤出汁来, 加汁
examples: Tell her that I am drinking juice.
Strawberry juice is good for the memory.
exampleZh: 告诉她我在喝果汁。
草莓汁对记忆力有利。

defsEn: v. consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning
v. make a mathematical, chemical, or grammatical analysis of
break down into components or essential features
v. break down into components or essential features
zh: vt. 分析, 细察, 分解
examples: We want to analyze your urine.
You must analyze all the data before drawing a conclusion.
exampleZh: 我们想验一下您的尿液。

defsEn: n. space in which vehicles can be parked
n. the act of maneuvering a vehicle into a location where it can be left temporarily
zh: n. 停车
a. 停车的
examples: He left his car in a public parking lot.
Can you find a parking spot near the apartment?

defsEn: n. (formerly) a loud cry (or repeated cries) of pain or rage or sorrow
n. an expression of grievance or resentment
n. (civil law) the first pleading of the plaintiff setting out the facts on which the claim for relief is based
zh: n. 诉苦, 抱怨, 控诉
examples: An increase in customer complaints could signal a decline in business.
There is no cause for complaint.
exampleZh: 顾客投诉量增加，可能代表生意正在走下坡。
没有理由抱怨。

defsEn: n. the status of being a champion
n. a competition at which a champion is chosen
zh: n. 冠军身份, 冠军称号, 捍卫
examples: I competed with him for the championship.
I hope that we win that championship.
exampleZh: 我和他竞争冠军。

defsEn: n. the act of spending or disbursing money
zh: n. 经费, 开销
examples: Spending time with your family should be your priority.
Will you be spending the night with us?

defsEn: n. an item inserted in a written record
n. a written record of a commercial transaction
zh: n. 登录, 条目, 进入, 入口, 报关
examples: I gave my daughter an entry ticket to the concert for her birthday.
Entry is strictly for staff only.
exampleZh: 我送了我女儿一张音乐会门票作为生日礼物。
非工作人员禁止入内。

defsEn: n. verb inflections that express how the action or state is conceived by the speaker
zh: n. 心情, 气氛, 生气, 基调
examples: Why are you in such a bad mood this morning?
I'm not in a mood to see you today.
exampleZh: 你今天早上为什么心情这么差？
我今天没心情见你。

defsEn: v put in effect
v to gain with effort
zh: vt. 完成, 达到, 实现, 使完美
examples: He is sure to accomplish his purpose.
Without me, you wouldn't accomplish anything.
exampleZh: 他很肯定可以达到目标。
如果没有我，你什么也做不到。

defsEn: n. footwear that covers the whole foot and lower leg
n. British term for the luggage compartment in a car
n. protective casing for something that resembles a leg
n. an instrument of torture that is used to heat or crush the foot and leg
zh: n. 长靴, 踢, 解雇, 效用
vt. 使穿靴, 踢, 解雇, 有用
examples: He scraped the mud off his boots.
Her pair of mountain boots are black.
exampleZh: 他刮下靴子上的泥巴。
她的这双山地靴是黑色的。

defsEn: n. an activity that is diverting and that holds the attention
zh: n. 娱乐, 款待, 娱乐表演
examples: She is reading one entertainment magazine.
Korean entertainment culture is popular worldwide.
exampleZh: 她在看一本娱乐杂志。
韩国的娱乐文化在全球都很受欢迎。

defsEn: n. any of various edible seeds of plants of the family Leguminosae used for food
n. any of various seeds or fruits that are beans or resemble beans
n. any of various leguminous plants grown for their edible seeds and pods
v. hit on the head, especially with a pitched baseball
zh: n. 豆子
examples: Chocolate is made from cocoa beans.
A single bad bean can make a pound of coffee undrinkable.
exampleZh: 巧克力是用可可豆做的。

defsEn: n. act of ascertaining or fixing the value or worth of
n. an appraisal of the value of something
zh: n. 评估, 估价, 求值
examples: I want a full evaluation as soon as possible.
He has not taken the highest level evaluation, but he is good at mathematics.

defsEn: n. someone in an official position of authority who can command or control others
n. a commissioned naval officer who ranks above a lieutenant commander and below a captain
zh: n. 司令官, 指挥官
examples: The commander said they would stay.
He is commander of our troops.

defsEn: a. displaying numbers rather than scale positions
a. relating to or performed with the fingers
a. of a circuit or device that represents magnitudes in digits
zh: a. 数字显示的, 数字的
n. 数字仪表, 数字式电子表(或时钟)
examples: Can I borrow your digital camera tonight?
My father bought me a digital watch for birthday present.
exampleZh: 我今晚能借你的数码相机吗？
我爸爸送了一块电子表给我作为生日礼物。

defsEn: n. an orderly grouping (of things or persons) considered as a unit
the result of arranging
n. an organized structure for arranging or classifying
n. the act of arranging and adapting a piece of music
zh: n. 排列, 整齐, 安排
examples: Flower arrangement is a part of Japanese culture.
I like the arrangement of the furniture in this room.
exampleZh: 花道是日本文化的一部分。

defsEn: s. mental or emotional as opposed to physical in nature
a. of or relating to or determined by psychology
zh: a. 心理学的, 精神上的, 心灵的
examples: We live in a time of psychological warfare.
I worry about his psychological well-being.

defsEn: n. the top or extreme point of something (usually a mountain or hill)
zh: n. 山峰, 巅, 山顶, 顶点, 尖峰, 帽舌
a. 最高的, 最大值的
vi. 到达最高点, 消瘦, 变憔悴, 逐渐缩小
vt. 使竖起, 使达到最高点
examples: The peak of Fujiyama was covered with snow.
Toy sales peak just before Christmas.
exampleZh: 富士山顶盖满了雪。

defsEn: r. (of quantities) imprecise but fairly close to correct
zh: adv. 大约, 大致, 近于
examples: Approximately how much money should I take with me?
Approximately how much money would be good to take with me?

defsEn: n. a physical condition in which there is a disturbance of normal functioning
n. a disturbance of the peace or of public order
v. bring disorder to
zh: n. 杂乱, 混乱
vt. 扰乱, 使失调
examples: They spread disorder until the country fell into chaos.
They have come down with a hepatic disorder.

defsEn: n. (statistics) an arrangement of values of a variable showing their observed or theoretical frequency of occurrence
n. the spatial or geographic property of being scattered about over a range, area, or volume
n. the act of distributing or spreading or apportioning
n. the commercial activity of transporting and selling goods from a producer to a consumer
zh: n. 分配
examples: Ubuntu is a popular Linux distribution.
They argue that the distribution of wealth should be equitable.
exampleZh: Ubuntu是一个流行的Linux发行版。

defsEn: n. a mental representation of the meaning or significance of something
n. an explanation that results from interpreting something
n. an explanation of something that is not immediately obvious
zh: n. 解释, 演出, 翻译
examples: Your interpretation is a bit too literal.
Your interpretation is based merely on the surface meaning.
exampleZh: 你的理解有点望文生义了。
你的理解有点望文生义了。

defsEn: n. the first meal of the day (usually in the morning)
v. eat an early morning meal
v. provide breakfast for
zh: n. 早餐
examples: Do you eat breakfast every day?
It will soon be breakfast time.
exampleZh: 你每天吃早餐吗
快吃早饭了。

defsEn: n. the discipline dealing with the art or science of applying scientific knowledge to practical problems
n. a room (as on a ship) in which the engine is located
zh: n. 工程学, 工程, 操纵
examples: I would love to do an engineering course.
I plan to take up engineering at college.

defsEn: n. a medical establishment run by a group of medical specialists
n. meeting for diagnosis of problems and instruction or remedial work in a particular activity
n. a healthcare facility for outpatient care
zh: n. 诊所, 临床教学
examples: A new health clinic is set to open next month.
She went to the Takasu clinic.
exampleZh: 一家新的健康诊所将于下个月开幕。
她去了高须诊所。

defsEn: n. a serviceman who has seen considerable active service
n. a person who has served in the armed forces
n. an experienced person who has been through many battles
someone who has given long service
zh: n. 老手, 退伍军人, 老兵, 老树
a. 老兵的, 老练的, 经验丰富的
examples: I'm a veteran of the Gulf War.
They congratulated the veteran on his promotion.

defsEn: s. easily agitated
a. of or relating to the nervous system
zh: a. 神经紧张的, 不安的, 神经的
examples: I always get nervous just before a match.
Let me be nervous about this.
exampleZh: 比赛前我一直都很紧张。
这个让我紧张。

defsEn: n. someone who travels for pleasure
zh: n. 观光客, 旅行者
a. 旅游的
examples: Where is the tourist information office?
When out of tourist season, the tickets will be cheap.
exampleZh: 游客谘询处在哪里?
在旅游淡季，机票会很便宜。

defsEn: n. an abrupt movement
v. agitate
zh: n. 投掷, 抛, 摇摆, 震荡, 掷钱币决定
vt. 投掷, 猛抬, 摇荡, 使不安, 掷钱币决定
vi. 被到处扔, 摇摆, 颠簸, 辗转, 掷钱币决定某事
examples: The coin toss decides who will kick off the match.
He tossed the ball towards the wall.
exampleZh: 裁判抛硬币来决定谁来开球。
他把球掷向墙上。

defsEn: n. mildly acid red or yellow pulpy fruit eaten as a vegetable
n. native to South America
widely cultivated in many varieties
zh: n. 番茄, 西红柿
examples: The tomato is a vegetable, not a fruit.
The tomato is subject to a number of diseases.
exampleZh: 番茄是蔬菜而不是水果。
番茄容易遭受很多病害。

defsEn: n. a deliberate act of omission
n. an instance that does not conform to a rule or generalization
the only exception was her last child"
n. grounds for adverse criticism
zh: n. 例外, 除外, 异议
examples: This is an exception to the rule.
There are exceptions to every rule.
exampleZh: 这是一个例外。
每条规则都有例外。

defsEn: n. an edible emulsion of fat globules made by churning milk or cream
for cooking and table use
n. a fighter who strikes the opponent with his head
v. spread butter on
zh: n. 奶油, 黄油
vt. 涂黄油于
examples: You have to butter the guy up first.
I ate bread and butter this morning.
exampleZh: 你得先拍拍他的马屁。
今天早上，我吃了面包夹黄油。

defsEn: n. a room (as in a residence) containing a bathtub or shower and usually a washbasin and toilet
zh: n. 浴室, 厕所
examples: I have to go to the bathroom.
I need to go to the bathroom.
exampleZh: 我要去厕所。
我要上厕所。

defsEn: a. of or relating to electronics
concerned with or using devices that operate on principles governing the behavior of electrons
a. of or concerned with electrons
zh: a. 电子的
examples: This man is like a filthy electronic without a battery.
Clive wants to be an electronic engineer.
exampleZh: 这个男人简直像一台被扯掉了电源的肮脏电器。
克里夫想成为一名电子工程师。

defsEn: n. notoriety for some particular characteristic
n. the general estimation that the public has for a person
zh: n. 名誉, 名声, 声望
examples: That scandal cost him his reputation.
We have the reputation of this clinic to protect.
exampleZh: 丑闻让他付出了失去声誉的代价。

defsEn: n. a structure taller than its diameter
can stand alone or be attached to a larger building
zh: n. 塔, 高楼, 堡垒
vi. 高耸, 翱翔
examples: We saw the tower in the distance.
This tower commands a full view of the city.
exampleZh: 我们远远地就看见了那座塔。
从这塔上可以看到城市的全貌。

defsEn: n. (chemistry) a substance consisting of two or more substances mixed together (not in fixed proportions and not with chemical bonding)
zh: n. 混合, 混淆, 混合物
examples: Every opinion is a mixture of truth and error.
Every opinion is a mixture of truth and mistakes.
exampleZh: 任何意见都是事实与谬误的混合体。
所有意见是真相和错误的综合。

defsEn: v. oppose, as in hostility or a competition
v. deal with (something unpleasant) head on
v. present somebody with something, usually to accuse or criticize
v. be face to face with
zh: vt. 使面对, 对抗, 遭遇, 使对质, 比较
examples: He is confronted by many difficulties.
Japan is confronted with severe economic problems.
exampleZh: 他面临着许多困难。
日本正面临着严重的经济问题。

defsEn: n. a quick look
v. throw a glance at
take a brief look at
v. hit at an angle
zh: n. 一瞥, 闪光, 掠过, 辉矿类
vi. 扫视, 闪光, 掠过, 提到, 略说
vt. 扫视, 反射, 使掠过
examples: With a glance of her, he left swiftly.
At first glance, the question seemed easy.
exampleZh: 他看了她一眼就马上离开了。
第一眼看起来，那个问题似乎很容易。

defsEn: n. a nonfunctional replica of something else (frequently used as a modifier)
n. a device regarded as providing amusement
v. manipulate manually or in one's mind or imagination
zh: n. 玩具, 小玩艺儿, 小型的东西, 消遣
a. 供玩耍的, 作为玩具的
vi. 玩弄, 戏弄, 调情
examples: You just put a toy down on the table.
I want to buy this toy doll.
exampleZh: 你刚才把一个玩意儿落在桌上了。
我想买这个玩具娃娃。

defsEn: n. a person who is of equal standing with another in a group
n. a nobleman (duke or marquis or earl or viscount or baron) who is a member of the British peerage
v. look searchingly
zh: n. 同等的人, 匹敌, 贵族
vi. 凝视, 窥视, 费力地看, 隐现
vt. 与...同等, 封为贵族
examples: My cat peers bemusedly at her reflection in the water.
Children imitate their peers rather than their parents.
exampleZh: 我的猫儿一脸迷惘地盯着自己在水中的倒影。
比起父母，儿童更喜欢模仿自己的同龄人。

defsEn: n group of people willing to obey orders
n the department responsible for hiring and training and placing employees and for setting policies for personnel management
zh: n. 人员, 人事部门, 人事科(处)
examples: There will be a surplus of personnel.
There's been a reduction in personnel at our factory.

defsEn: n. a person who devises plots or intrigues
zh: n. 设计者, 谋划者, 制图者
examples: In the hands of a skilled designer, any two colors can go well together.
She wants to be a designer.
exampleZh: 无论是多么不协和的两种颜色，在技术高超的设计师手里，也能化成悦目的配搭。
她希望成为一名设计师。

defsEn: n. endless loop of flexible material between two rotating shafts or pulleys
n. a band to tie or buckle around the body (usually at the waist)
n. an elongated region where a specific condition or characteristic is found
n. ammunition (usually of small caliber) loaded in flexible linked strips for use in a machine gun
zh: n. 带子, 地带
examples: The belt became a symbol of fear for me.
China is incorporating Algeria into its Belt and Road strategy.
exampleZh: 这条腰带对我来说成为了恐惧的象征。
中国正将阿尔及利亚纳入「一带一路」战略。

defsEn: n. migration into a place (especially migration to a country of which you are not a native in order to settle there)
n. the body of immigrants arriving during a specified interval
zh: n. 移民, 移居
examples: We have to report to the immigration office.
We need to reform our immigration system.

defsEn: n. an accusation that brings into intimate and usually incriminating connection
n. a logical relation between propositions p and q of the form `if p then q'
if p is true then q cannot be false
n. a relation implicated by virtue of involvement or close connection (especially an incriminating involvement)
zh: n. 牵连, 含义, 暗示
examples: The implication was that where there was a well, there were residents.
He condemned the court and, by implication, the entire legal system.
exampleZh: 含义是哪里有水井，哪里就有居民。

defsEn: n. the state or quality of being recognized or acknowledged
n. the process of recognizing something or someone by remembering
n. approval
n. (biology) the ability of one molecule to attach to another molecule that has a complementary shape
zh: n. 赞誉, 认得, 识别, 承认, 认可, 认识
examples: She gave me a smile of recognition.
He gave me a smile of recognition.
exampleZh: 她给了我一个认可的微笑。
他给了我一个认可的微笑。

defsEn: n. the state of being retired from one's business or occupation
n. withdrawal from your position or occupation
n. withdrawal for prayer and study and meditation
zh: n. 退休, 隐居, 撤退
examples: His life after retirement was unhappy.
From graduation to retirement, Laowang worked as a teacher without intermission.
exampleZh: 他退休后的生活不快乐。
从大学毕业到退休，老王一直担任教学工作。

defsEn: n. speaking softly without vibration of the vocal cords
v. speak softly
in a low voice
zh: n. 耳语, 密谈, 谣传, 沙沙声
vi. 耳语, 密谈, 沙沙地响
vt. 低声说
examples: What did she whisper to you?
Let me whisper in your ear.
exampleZh: 她跟你说了什么悄悄话？
我凑到你耳边说。

defsEn: s. located inward
a. located or occurring within or closer to a center
s. innermost or essential
s. exclusive to a center
especially a center of influence
zh: a. 内部的, 内心的
n. 内部
examples: This inner conflict tends to diminish as the years go by.
Music is inner life, and he will never suffer loneliness who has inner life.
exampleZh: 这种内心的冲突往往会随着岁月流逝而平息。
音乐是内心世界，拥有了内心世界的他永远不会觉得孤独。

defsEn: n. term of address for a disrespectful and annoying male
n. a third-year undergraduate
n. the younger of two persons
n. a son who has the same first name as his father
zh: n. 年少者, 地位较低者, 大学三年级学生
a. 年少的, 下级的, 后进的
examples: He's just a normal junior high school student, not particularly intelligent.
I'm not a junior high school student.
exampleZh: 他只不过是个普普通通的中学生，不算特别聪明。
我不是个初中生。

defsEn: n. a state of steady vigorous action that is characteristic of an activity
n. mechanical device used as a plaything to support someone swinging back and forth
n. a sweeping blow or stroke
n. changing location by moving back and forth
zh: n. 摇摆, 振幅, 音律, 节奏, 涨落, 秋千, 旋转, 行动自由
vi. 摇摆, 悬挂, 旋转, 大摇大摆地走, 转向
vt. 挥舞, 使旋转, 使转向, 悬挂, 吊运
a. 旋转的, 悬挂的, 强节奏爵士音乐的
examples: Mennad always has those mood swings.
Do you want to swing from that tree branch?
exampleZh: 梅纳德总是情绪波动很大。

defsEn: n. the passage to the stomach and lungs
in the front part of the neck below the chin and above the collarbone
n. an opening in the vamp of a shoe at the instep
n. a passage resembling a throat in shape or function
n. the part of an animal's body that corresponds to a person's throat
zh: n. 咽喉, 喉咙, 嗓音
vt. 用喉音说, 开沟于
examples: I have a frog in my throat.
A fish bone has stuck in my throat.
exampleZh: 我的喉咙里有一只青蛙。
一根鱼刺卡在我嗓子里了。

defsEn: n something that remunerates
zh: n. 薪水
vt. 给...加薪
examples: He would not raise my salary.
Does your salary get put on your pay card on a monthly basis?
exampleZh: 他不肯给我涨工资。
您的工资是每个月打入您的工资卡吗？

defsEn: n. (psychiatry) a relatively permanent state of worry and nervousness occurring in a variety of mental disorders, usually accompanied by compulsive behavior or attacks of panic
n. a vague unpleasant emotion that is experienced in anticipation of some (usually ill-defined) misfortune
zh: n. 焦虑, 忧虑, 令人焦虑的事
examples: She has anxiety for your safety.
The way to solve pre-exam anxiety is to start learning now.
exampleZh: 她担心你的安全。
解决考前焦虑的办法是立刻开始学习。

defsEn: r. in a literal sense
r. (intensifier before a figurative expression) without exaggeration
zh: adv. 逐字地, 按照字面上地, 不夸张地
examples: I didn't literally translate from English into Japanese.
We have, literally, a pile of food to eat.
exampleZh: 我没有把英语直译成日语。

defsEn: n. the act of clasping another person in the arms (as in greeting or affection)
n. the state of taking in or encircling
n. a close affectionate and protective acceptance
v. include in scope
include as part of something broader
have as one's sphere or territory
zh: n. 拥抱
vt. 拥抱, 互相拥抱, 包含, 收买
vi. 拥抱
examples: Embrace your children and tell them you love them.
I find it hard to embrace my true identity.

defsEn: n. the act of exhibiting
n. a collection of things (goods or works of art etc.) for public display
zh: n. 表现, 展览会, 展览品
examples: Did you go to the art exhibition?
The exhibition has drawn much attention from the public.
exampleZh: 你去看艺术展览了吗？
展览大大地吸引了公众的注意。

defsEn: n. cooking utensil consisting of a wide metal vessel
n. (Greek mythology) god of fields and woods and shepherds and flocks
represented as a man with goat's legs and horns and ears
identified with Roman Sylvanus or Faunus
n. shallow container made of metal
n. chimpanzees
more closely related to Australopithecus than to other pongids
zh: n. 平锅, 浅盘, 盆地, 硬土层, 拍摄全景
v. 上下左右移动, 摇镜头, 淘洗, 淘金
examples: Wipe the pan dry with a paper towel.

把平底锅离火。

defsEn: n an expert who gives advice

defsEn: n. someone who administers a business

n. someone who manages a government agency or department

defsEn: r. now and then or here and there

Dick is occasionally late to school.

迪克偶尔会上学迟到。

defsEn: n. the process of giving careful thought to something
n. a discussion of a topic (as in a meeting)

n. a considerate and thoughtful act

We should've taken the schedule into consideration.

我们本该考虑一下行程。

defsEn: n. a light shade of red

v. cut in a zigzag pattern with pinking shears, in sewing

She was wearing pink panties under the skirt.

裙子下她穿着一条粉红色的内裤。

of what is important or famous in the past

There are many famous historic buildings in Kyoto.

京都有很多有名的古建筑。

v. resist

a. 雄的

He borrowed one hundred bucks from me.
exampleZh: 你的二十块在哪里? 我给你五块钱找到它。
他跟我借一百块。

defsEn: n. something that hinders as if with bonds
v. create social or emotional ties
v. make fast
tie or secure, with or as if with a rope
v. wrap around with something so as to cover or enclose

vi. 凝固, 有约束力
examples: They are binding the gravel with cement to repair the road.
This decision is not binding on all of you.

defsEn: n. a quantity of liquor equal to one fifth of a United States gallon
n. position five in a countable series of things
n. the musical interval between one note and another five notes away from it
s. coming next after the fourth and just before the sixth in position
zh: num. 第五, 五分之一
examples: Take the elevator to the fifth floor.
I like shopping on Fifth Avenue in New York.
exampleZh: 搭乘电梯到五楼。
我喜欢在纽约第五大街购物。

defsEn: r. without variation or change, in every case
r. without interruption
zh: adv. 不变地, 不断地, 时常地
examples: I constantly went over this problem in my mind.
She is constantly in and out of hospital.
exampleZh: 我的脑海里不停地翻腾着这个问题。
她一直在进进出出医院。

defsEn: n. a purposeful or industrious undertaking (especially one that requires effort or boldness)
n. an organization created for business ventures
n. readiness to embark on bold new ventures
zh: n. 企业, 事业心, 进取心, 干事业

I share with him in the enterprise.

defsEn: n. an act of gracious kindness
n. an advantage to the benefit of someone or something
n. an inclination to approve
zh: n. 好意, 喜爱
vt. 赐予, 支持, 喜欢, 证实
examples: He said to me, "Please, do me a favor."
I have a favor to ask of you.
exampleZh: 他对我说：「请你帮我一个忙。」
我想你帮我做一件事。

defsEn: n. an enlarged and muscular saclike organ of the alimentary canal
the principal organ of digestion
n. an inclination or liking for things involving conflict or difficulty or unpleasantness
n. an appetite for food
v. bear to eat
zh: n. 胃, 食欲, 欲望, 肚子
vt. 吃下, 忍受
examples: The cancer has spread to her stomach.
George hit him in the stomach.
exampleZh: 癌细胞已经扩散到她的胃。
乔治击中了他的腹部。

defsEn: v. set up for use
v. put into an office or a position
v. place

examples: The man tried to install his own antenna.
They installed a vending machine at work.
exampleZh: 这男人试着安装他自己的天线。
他们在办公室安装了一台自动贩卖机。

defsEn: a. responsive to physical stimuli
a. being susceptible to the attitudes, feelings, or circumstances of others
s. hurting
s. of or pertaining to classified information or matters affecting national security
zh: a. 敏感的, 易感的, 灵敏的, 感光的
examples: I am very sensitive to heat.
She is sensitive to the heat.
exampleZh: 我对热气很敏感。
她很怕热。

defsEn: n. an idea that is suggested
n. a proposal offered for acceptance or rejection
n. persuasion formulated as a suggestion
n. the sequential mental process in which one thought leads to another by association
zh: n. 提议, 意见
examples: What do you think of his suggestion?
I do not accept your suggestion.
exampleZh: 你觉得他的建议怎样？
我不接受你给我的建议。

defsEn: n. directions for making something
zh: n. 食谱, 处方, 秘诀
examples: Could you give me the recipe for your salad?
Will you give me the recipe for your salad?

defsEn: s. easy and not involved or complicated
a. of or pertaining to or characteristic of elementary school or elementary education
s. of or being the essential or basic part
zh: a. 初步的, 基本的
examples: When I was in elementary school, my mother always fetched me from school.
I miss my elementary school teachers.
exampleZh: 我读小学的时候，我母亲常常来接我。
我很想念我小学的老师。

defsEn: a. having or showing determination and energetic pursuit of your ends
positive in his convictions"
s. tending to spread quickly
s. characteristic of an enemy or one eager to fight
zh: a. 侵略的, 挑畔的, 进取的
examples: Sami became more aggressive with customers.
Mary is very aggressive, isn't she?
exampleZh: 萨米对顾客变得更加挑衅了。
玛丽有些咄咄逼人，不是吗？

defsEn: n. a performance of music by players or singers not involving theatrical staging
v. contrive (a plan) by mutual agreement
v. settle by agreement
zh: n. 音乐会, 和声, 一致
vt. 协力, 协调
vi. 协力
examples: I would like to go to the concert with you.
Do you know the concert schedule of London Symphony Orchestra?
exampleZh: 我想和你一起去音乐会。
你知道伦敦交响乐团的演奏会行程吗？

defsEn: n. (usually plural) the goal with respect to a marriage proposal
n. an act of intending
a volition that you intend to carry out
zh: n. 意图, 目的, 含义
examples: I have no intention of telling you the result.
I have no intention in arguing about your theory.
exampleZh: 我并不打算把结果告诉你。
我无意争辩你的理论。

defsEn: n. an illustration that is drawn by hand and published in a book, magazine, or newspaper
n. a representation of forms or objects on a surface by means of lines
n. the creation of artistic pictures or diagrams
n. act of getting or draining something such as electricity or a liquid from a source
zh: n. 图画, 制图, 拉
examples: Which of your drawings do you consider your best?
He found the drawings in the wardrobe.

defsEn: v put an end to a state or an activity
v give up or retire from a position
v go away or leave
v turn away from
give up

admit defeat

vt. 离开, 放弃, 使解除, 停止
n. 离开
examples: I would rather quit than work under him.
I mean to quit this company.
exampleZh: 与其让我在他手下干，我宁愿辞职。
我想从这家公司辞职。

defsEn: n. any of a large group of nitrogenous organic compounds that are essential constituents of living cells
consist of polymers of amino acids
essential in the diet of animals for growth and for repair of tissues
can be obtained from meat and eggs and milk and legumes
zh: n. 蛋白质
a. 蛋白质的

This protein is essential to the proper function of the organism.

defsEn: n. the state of being absent
n. failure to be present
n. the time interval during which something or somebody is away
n. the occurrence of an abrupt, transient loss or impairment of consciousness (which is not subsequently remembered), sometimes with light twitching, fluttering eyelids, etc.
common in petit mal epilepsy

examples: No one noticed her absence until the end of the meeting.
Did anyone come in my absence?
exampleZh: 直到会议结束之前都没人注意到她不在。
我不在的时候有没有人来？

defsEn: n. the condition or result of being changeable
zh: n. 差异, 多样性
examples: I just admire the diversity of life on our planet.
They consider linguistic diversity a threat.

vi. 踱步, 缓慢走
vt. 用步测, 踱步于

I could do with a change of pace.
exampleZh: 他们前进了几步。

defsEn: n. the state of being employed or having a job
n. the occupation for which you are paid
n. the act of giving someone a job
zh: n. 雇用, 职业, 工作
examples: She found employment as a typist.
They guaranteed regular employment to their workers.
exampleZh: 她找到打字员的工作。
他们对他们的员工保证就业。

defsEn: n. someone who expresses in language
someone who talks (especially someone who delivers a public speech or someone especially garrulous)
n. the presiding officer of a deliberative assembly
zh: n. 说话人, 讲演者, 发言人, 喇叭, 扬声器
examples: She is a native speaker of French.
At the time there were no native English speakers teaching in any public school.
exampleZh: 她的母语是法语。
当时没有任何以英语为母语的人在公立学校任教。

defsEn: n. an analytic or interpretive literary composition
n. a tentative attempt

examples: When have you got to hand in your essay?
Your essay still needs some improvement.

你的论文还需要改进。

My first impression of him proved to be correct.

我对他的第一印象果然没有错。

unemotional

n. (Christianity) the taking up of the body and soul of the Virgin Mary when her earthly life had ended
zh: n. 假定, 自负, 担任, 假装
examples: What is the basis of your assumptions?
She put on an assumption of ignorance.
exampleZh: 您的假设是根据什么?

defsEn: n. a toothed wheel that engages another toothed mechanism in order to change the speed or direction of transmitted motion
n. a mechanism for transmitting motion for some specific purpose (as the steering gear of a vehicle)
n. equipment consisting of miscellaneous articles needed for a particular operation or sport etc.
v. set the level or character of
zh: n. 齿轮, 工具
vt. 以齿轮连起, 开动, 使适应, 安排
vi. 连接上, 适合
examples: Dust in the gears gummed up the machine.
What sort of gear do you like to wear?
exampleZh: 齿轮里的灰尘把机器卡住了。

defsEn: n. a body serving in an administrative capacity
n. (Christianity) an assembly of theologians and bishops and other representatives of different churches or dioceses that is convened to regulate matters of discipline or doctrine
n. a meeting of people for consultation
zh: n. 会议, 委员会
examples: What will the city council do about it?
They live in a council house.

defsEn: n. a stipulated condition
n. the activity of supplying or providing something
n. a store or supply of something (especially of food or clothing or arms)
v. supply with provisions
zh: n. (政府提供的)钱和设备, 准备, 供应品, 规定, 条款
vt. 供给...食物及必需品
examples: There was a provision in his will for his mistress.
It's time to stock up on provisions.

defsEn: n. someone who causes the death of a person or animal
n. a difficulty that is hard to deal with
zh: n. (非正式)杀人者, 屠杀者, 猛兽, 致死(疾病), 杀手, 止痛药, 限制器, 瞄准器
examples: He is a killer, he should be behind bars!
Sami was speaking to Layla's killer.
exampleZh: 他是个凶手，应该进到牢里。
萨米在与莱拉的杀手说话。

defsEn: n. an association of criminals
n. an organized group of workmen
n. tool consisting of a combination of implements arranged to work together
v. act as an organized group
zh: n. 队, 群, 帮
vi. 成群结队, 结成一伙
vt. 使成群结队
examples: The gang was planning a robbery.
I found my gang at the cafe.
exampleZh: 这伙人计划抢劫。

defsEn: n. the abode of God and the angels
zh: n. 天堂, 上帝, 天空
examples: How can I get to heaven?
God created the heaven and the earth.
exampleZh: 我要怎么上天堂？
上帝创造了天地。

defsEn: v. utter or declare in a very loud voice
zh: vi. 叫喊, 大叫, (齐声)呐喊欢呼
vt. 喊叫着说
n. 叫声, 喊声, 呐喊
examples: Do not yell into my ear.
He is always yelling at his children.
exampleZh: 别在我耳边大叫。
他总是训斥他的孩子。

defsEn: a. separated in space or coming from or going to a distance
a. far apart in relevance or relationship or kinship
s. separate or apart in time
s. located far away spatially
zh: a. 远的, 疏远的
examples: Tom is a distant relative of mine.
Ants and giraffes are distant cousins.
exampleZh: 汤姆是我的远亲。
蚂蚁和长颈鹿是远亲。

defsEn: n. a food made from roasted ground cacao beans
n. a medium brown to dark-brown color
zh: n. 巧克力
a. 巧克力制的
examples: Would you like a bit of chocolate cheese?
What chocolate do you like to eat?
exampleZh: 想吃一点巧克力奶酪吗？
你喜欢吃什么巧克力？

defsEn: n. a native or inhabitant of Canada
n. a river rising in northeastern New Mexico and flowing eastward across the Texas panhandle to become a tributary of the Arkansas River in Oklahoma
a. of or relating to Canada or its people
zh: a. 加拿大的
examples: You're the only Canadian I know.
Who is your favorite Canadian singer?
exampleZh: 我只知道你一位加拿大人。
你最喜欢的加拿大歌手是谁？

defsEn: n. a wide scope
n. a long oar used in an open boat
n. a movement in an arc
v. move with sweeping, effortless, gliding motions
zh: n. 扫除, 打扫, 肃清, 视野, 范围, 全胜
vt. 扫除, 掸去, 猛拉, 扫荡, 肃清, 冲走, 刮起, 环视, 掠过, 扫射
vi. 扫, 打扫, 袭击, 席卷, 扫视, 掠过
examples: You have to sweep the floor.
I made him sweep the floor.
exampleZh: 你必须扫地。
我让他扫地了。

defsEn: n. the business of drawing public attention to goods and services
zh: n. 广告业, 广告
a. 广告的
examples: We should ban advertising aimed towards children.
He works for an advertising agency.
exampleZh: 我们应该禁止针对儿童的广告。
他为一家广告公司工作。

defsEn: n. the overhead upper surface of a covered space
n. (meteorology) altitude of the lowest layer of clouds
n. an upper limit on what is allowed
n. maximum altitude at which a plane can fly (under specified conditions)
zh: n. 天花板
examples: I saw a fly on the ceiling.
There's a big fly on the ceiling.
exampleZh: 我看到天花板上有一只苍蝇
有一只大苍蝇在天花板上。

defsEn: n. (linguistics) a grammatical rule (or other linguistic feature) that is found in all languages
n. (logic) a proposition that asserts something of all members of a class
n. a behavioral convention or pattern characteristic of all members of a particular culture or of all human beings
s. applicable to or common to all members of a group or set
zh: a. 全世界的, 普遍的, 宇宙的, 通用的
n. 一般概念
examples: English is a universal language and is used all over the world.
English is a kind of universal language.
exampleZh: 英语是一种世界性的语言，用于世界各地。
英语是一种世界语言。

defsEn: n. a swift whirling motion (usually of a missile)
n. the act of rotating rapidly
n. a short drive in a car
n. a distinctive interpretation (especially as used by politicians to sway public opinion)
zh: n. 旋转, 自旋, 疾驰, 情绪低落
vt. 纺织, 纺, 使旋转, 编造
vi. 纺纱, 吐丝, 作茧, 结网, 旋转, 自旋, 疾驰
examples: To make a top spin, you need a string.
A lie is a lie, no matter how you spin it.

defsEn: n. a row or line of people (especially soldiers or police) standing abreast of one another
n. relative status
v. take or have a position relative to others
v. take precedence or surpass others in rank
zh: n. 等级, 排, 横列, 队伍, 阶级
a. 茂密丛生的, 恶臭的, 十足的, 粗俗的
vt. 排列, 归类于, 把...分等
vi. 列为, 列队
n. 秩
examples: This firm ranks second in the oil trade.
He is immediately above me in rank.
exampleZh: 这家公司在石油行业排名第二。
他的军阶比我高一级。

defsEn: n. a covering designed to be worn on a person's body
zh: n. 衣服
examples: We found a new clothing store in the shopping mall.
Come back next week and the clothing will be ready.

defsEn: n. an amount of a product
v. be the cause or source of
v. give in, as to influence or pressure
v. bring in
zh: n. 生产量, 投资收益
vt. 出产, 给予, 让出, 放弃, 使屈服
vi. 出产, 屈服, 投降, 倒塌
examples: I would rather die than yield.
These fields yield an abundant harvest.
exampleZh: 我宁可死也不屈服。
这些田有很多收获。

defsEn: n. any likeness of a person, in any medium
zh: n. 肖像, 人像, 半身像, 描写, 竖排格式
examples: There is a portrait of Bob on the wall.
The portrait of the king was unveiled and received enthusiastic applause.
exampleZh: 墙上有一张鲍勃的肖像画。
国王的肖像揭晓，收获了热烈的掌声。

defsEn: n. a state of surviving
remaining alive
n. a natural process resulting in the evolution of organisms best adapted to the environment
n. something that survives
zh: n. 生存, 残存, 幸存者
a. 赖以生存的
examples: I gave up all hope of survival.
His own survival is more important now.
exampleZh: 我放弃了所有生存的希望。
他自己的生存现在更重要了。

defsEn: r. with roughness or violence (`rough' is an informal variant for `roughly')
r. with rough motion as over a rough surface
zh: adv. 概略地, 粗糙地, 粗暴地
examples: Asia is roughly four times the size of Europe.
Roughly how long does it take to walk from here to the town hall?
exampleZh: 亚洲的大小约四倍于欧洲。

defsEn: n. a grouping of a number of similar things
n. any collection in its entirety
v. gather or cause to gather into a cluster
zh: n. 串, 束
examples: He foisted a bunch of hard work on me.
He dropped a bunch of hard tasks on me.
exampleZh: 他把那么难做的活儿丢给我。
他把那么难做的活儿丢给我。

defsEn: n. a comprehensive term for any proceeding in a court of law whereby an individual seeks a legal remedy
zh: n. 诉讼
examples: If we win this lawsuit, it will become precedent.
How do I file a lawsuit in the United States.

defsEn: n. a solemn statement made under oath
n. an assertion offering firsthand authentication of a fact
n. something that serves as evidence
zh: n. 证言, 证据, 声明
examples: In Islam, the shahada is the testimony of faith.
That testimony might help convict him, but it would not be admissible in court.
exampleZh: 萨哈达在伊斯兰教是信仰的证明。

defsEn: n. an onerous or difficult concern
n. the central idea that is expanded in a document or discourse
v. weight down with a load
zh: n. 负担, 重载, 担子, 责任
vt. 装货于, 烦扰, 使负担
examples: That responsibility is a burden to him.
I know I'm a burden; you don't have to repeat it.
exampleZh: 那个责任对他是个负担。
我知道自己是个累赘，你没必要反复提。

defsEn: n. a natural or artificial enclosed space
n. an enclosed volume in the body
n. a room where a judge transacts business
n. a deliberative or legislative or administrative or judicial assembly
zh: n. 室, 房间, 枪膛
vt. 装(弹药), 把...关在室内
a. 室内的
examples: Hitler used a gas chamber in an attempt to murder the Jewish people.
I heated the chamber with an electric heater.

defsEn: n. joint operation or action
n. the practice of cooperating
zh: n. 合作, 协力, 配合
examples: Completing this project would require the cooperation of multiple parties.
He has investigated the possibility of cooperation.
exampleZh: 这个项目要多方合作才能完成。
他调查了两方合作的可能性。

defsEn: n. furnishings that make a room or other area ready for occupancy
zh: n. 家具, 帆具
examples: What style of furniture would you like?
That piece of furniture is not fitting for the living room.
exampleZh: 你想要哪种风格的家具？
那件家具不适合摆在客厅。

defsEn: n. a lightweight cord
n. a tightly stretched cord of wire or gut, which makes sound when plucked, struck, or bowed
n. a sequentially ordered set of things or events or ideas in which each successive member is related to the preceding
n. a linear sequence of symbols (characters or words or phrases)
zh: n. 线, 细绳, 一串, 字符串
vt. 串起, 成串, 收紧, 缚, 扎
vi. 成一串
examples: She tied up the package with string.
I broke a string on my guitar.
exampleZh: 她用绳子把包裹紧紧绑好了。
我弄断了我吉他的一根弦。

defsEn: n. an analysis (often in graphical form) representing the extent to which something exhibits various characteristics
n. an outline of something (especially a human face as seen from one side)
n. biographical sketch
n. a vertical section of the Earth's crust showing the different horizons or layers
zh: n. 侧面, 轮廓, 传略
vt. 描绘...轮廓, 写...的传略
examples: Have you changed your profile picture recently?
Tom always has the cutest profile pictures.
exampleZh: 你最近更改过你的头像吗？
汤姆永远有最可爱的头像。

defsEn: n. a payment required for not fulfilling a contract
n. the disadvantage or painful consequences of an action or condition
n. (games) a handicap or disadvantage that is imposed on a competitor (or a team) for an infraction of the rules of the game
zh: n. 处罚, 刑罚, 罚款, 罚球, 报应, 不利结果, 妨碍
examples: Is the incurrence of this penalty correct?
The death penalty had been done away with in many states in the USA.
exampleZh: 这个点球的判罚正确吗？
死刑在美国的很多州都被废除了。

defsEn: n. a hotel located in a resort area
zh: n. 度假胜地, 手段, 凭借, 常去之地
vi. 诉诸, 常去
examples: Karuizawa is famous as a summer resort.
The train was crowded, so I resorted to walking.
exampleZh: 轻井泽是著名的避暑胜地。
火车里太多人了，所以我走路算了。

defsEn: n. the termination of something by causing so much damage to it that it cannot be repaired or no longer exists
n. an event (or the result of an event) that completely destroys something
zh: n. 破坏, 毁灭
examples: Death and destruction will rain on you.
The destruction of the ozone layer affects the environment.

defsEn: a. has little chance of being the case or coming about
zh: a. 不太可能的
examples: He is unlikely to come today.
I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone knows me.
exampleZh: 他今天不见得会来。
我知道有人认识我的可能性微乎其微。

defsEn: n. a regular walk taken as a form of exercise
a. of benefit to or intended to benefit your physical makeup
a. sanctioned by or consistent with or operating under the law determining the fundamental political principles of a government
zh: a. 宪法的, 立宪的, 体质的
examples: The constitutional court will issue a decision by noon today.
I'm out for my morning constitutional.

defsEn: n. the noise made by a short puff of steam (as from an engine)
v. breathe noisily, as when one is exhausted
v. utter while panting, as if out of breath
zh: n. 喘息, 悸动
vi. 喘息, 渴望
vt. 气喘吁吁地说
examples: Tom rolled up his pant legs so people could see his bright red socks.
I bought two pairs of pants.
exampleZh: 汤姆卷起了他的裤腿，好让人看到他鲜红色的袜子。
我买了两条裤子。

defsEn: n. the pathological state resulting from the invasion of the body by pathogenic microorganisms
n. (phonetics) the alteration of a speech sound under the influence of a neighboring sound
n. (medicine) the invasion of the body by pathogenic microorganisms and their multiplication which can lead to tissue damage and disease
n. an incident in which an infectious disease is transmitted
zh: n. 传染, 影响, 传染病
examples: He had an infection in his belly button.
You have an infection in your throat.
exampleZh: 他的肚脐发炎了。

defsEn: n. the act of gambling
v. maintain with or as if with a bet
v. stake on the outcome of an issue
zh: n. 打赌, 赌注
v. 打赌
examples: I bet it will rain tomorrow.
I bet he will get mad.
exampleZh: 我赌明天会下雨。
我打赌他会生气。

defsEn: a. of or relating to or characteristic of literature
s. knowledgeable about literature
s. appropriate to literature rather than everyday speech or writing
zh: a. 文学的, 文艺的, 精通文学的
examples: Noted literary personalities gathered together last evening.
In literary works, night-blooming jasmine is often used to symbolize longing and tenderness.
exampleZh: 知名文学界人士昨晚齐聚一堂。
文学作品中常用夜来香来象征思念与柔情。

defsEn: a. relating to or concerned with strategy
s. highly important to or an integral part of a strategy or plan of action especially in war
zh: a. 战略的, 战略上的
examples: This project offers strategic advantages for Algeria.
That was a huge strategic error.
exampleZh: 这项专案给阿尔及利亚带来策略性优势。

defsEn: n. a large amount of wealth or prosperity
n. your overall circumstances or condition in life (including everything that happens to you)
zh: n. 财富, 运气, 兴隆, 大量财产, 好运, 命运
examples: He left his fortune to his son.
Last month I spent a fortune on the telephone bill.
exampleZh: 他把财产留给了他的儿子。
上个月我在话费上花了很多钱。

defsEn: n. a person who contributes to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose
zh: n. 助手, 助理, 助教
a. 有帮助的, 辅助的, 助理的
examples: I need an assistant who speaks French.
He made me his own assistant.
exampleZh: 我需要一个会说法语的助理。
他让我做他的助理。

defsEn: v. get on top of
deal with successfully
zh: vt. 战胜, 克服, 胜过
vi. 得胜
examples: How to overcome the high value of the yen is a big problem.
You have to overcome the difficulties.
exampleZh: 如何克服日元升高是个大问题。
你必须克服困难。

defsEn: s. unusual or striking
zh: a. 不平常的, 值得注意的, 显著的
examples: This company achieved a remarkable increase in turnover last year.
He was able to put up remarkable performances at the sports competition.
exampleZh: 这家公司去年获得显着的营业额增长。
他在运动会上的表现十分出色。

defsEn: n. a branch of applied mathematics concerned with the collection and interpretation of quantitative data and the use of probability theory to estimate population parameters
zh: n. 统计学, 统计资料
examples: Take a look at these statistics.
Tell that creep to stop ticking us off with his worthless statistics.

defsEn: n. searching for or buying goods or services
n. the commodities purchased from stores
zh: n. 买东西, 购物
examples: They go shopping with each other all the time.
I have some last-minute Christmas shopping to do.

defsEn: r. at the beginning
zh: adv. 最初, 开头
examples: It was much worse than we initially thought.
Initially I found it difficult to deal with my new environment.
exampleZh: 事情比我们最初想象的更严重。

defsEn: a. pertaining to or referring to origin
a. of or relating to the science of genetics
zh: a. 创始的, 遗传的, 起源的, 遗传学的
examples: Should we use genetic engineering on people?
There seems to be some genetic problem with this animal.
exampleZh: 我们应该对人使用基因编辑吗？

defsEn: n. a male spokesperson
zh: n. 发言人, 代言者
examples: Do you want to be the spokesman of our group?
The spokesman explained the contents of the treaty to the press.

defsEn: n. the second of two or the second mentioned of two
a. referring to the second of two things or persons mentioned (or the last one or ones of several)
zh: a. 后者的, 较后的, 近来的
examples: The latter half of the drama was a little dull.
The former is inferior to the latter in some respect.

defsEn: n. the act of increasing (something) in size or volume or quantity or scope
n. a function expressed as a sum or product of terms
n. a discussion that provides additional information
zh: n. 扩充, 开展, 膨胀
examples: The expansion of the building's west end is being studied.
Some opine that human expansion into outer space is like Manifest Destiny.
exampleZh: 西面大楼的扩建在研究中。

defsEn: n. a group or class of persons enjoying superior intellectual or social or economic status
zh: n. 精华, 精锐, 中坚分子
examples: Only the elite study at that school.
The elite want a world war again.

defsEn: a. of or relating to the Olympic Games
zh: a. 奥林匹亚的, 奥林匹斯山的, 强有力的, 巨大的
examples: They want to participate in the Olympic Games.
He took part in the Olympic Games.
exampleZh: 他们想参加奥运会。
他参加了奥运会。

defsEn: a. closely constrained or constricted or constricting
s. set so close together as to be invulnerable to penetration
s. affected by scarcity and expensive to borrow
a. of such close construction as to be impermeable
zh: a. 紧的, 密封的, 吝啬的, 严厉的
adv. 紧紧地
examples: I am in a tight place.
This jacket is a tight fit.
exampleZh: 我身陷困境。
这夹克很合身。

defsEn: n. the sacred writings of the Christian religions
n. a book regarded as authoritative in its field
zh: n. 圣经
examples: It says in the Bible, "Man shall not live on bread alone."
He's reading the Bible in Berber.
exampleZh: 圣经里有一句话，叫做“人不能只靠面包生活”。
他在用伯伯尔语阅读圣经。

defsEn: a. relating to or derived from the sun or utilizing the energies of the sun
zh: a. 太阳的, 日光的, 源自太阳的
examples: The Sun is in the center of the solar system.
The solar system is a small celestial system in the Milky Way.
exampleZh: 太阳在太阳系的中心。
太阳系是银河系中一个小的天体系统。

defsEn: s. difficult to analyze or understand
zh: a. 复杂的
examples: I thought it would be complicated to do that.
It might be more complicated than you think.

defsEn: n. a relatively long narrow piece of something
n. artifact consisting of a narrow flat piece of material
n. thin piece of wood or metal
n. a form of erotic entertainment in which a dancer gradually undresses to music
zh: n. 长条, 条状, 带, 脱衣舞
vt. 脱衣, 被剥去, 剥夺, 拆卸
vi. 脱衣服
examples: Tom was stripped to the waist.
I want you to strip naked and rail me.
exampleZh: 汤姆光着膀子。

defsEn: n. the phenomenon of a propagating wave (light or sound) being thrown back from a surface
n. the image of something as reflected by a mirror (or other reflective material)
n. (mathematics) a transformation in which the direction of one axis is reversed
n. the ability to reflect beams or rays
zh: n. 反映, 沉思, 映像, 想法, 责难
examples: I saw my reflection in the window.
A little reflection will show you that you are wrong.
exampleZh: 我在窗户上看见了我的映像。
只要你细心想一想，就会明白自己的错处了。

defsEn: n. a sporting competition in which contestants play a series of games to decide the winner
n. a series of jousts between knights contesting for a prize
zh: n. 比赛, 竞赛, 锦标赛, 联赛
examples: We have a soccer tournament in May.
Where will the tournament take place?

defsEn: n. a literary work based on the imagination and not necessarily on fact
zh: n. 小说, 虚构故事
examples: This is a science fiction book.
This is the best science fiction film in the past few years.
exampleZh: 这是一部科学幻想小说。
这部科幻电影是这几年最好看的了。

defsEn: n. something (as a course of action) that is recommended as advisable
n. something that recommends (or expresses commendation of) a person or thing as worthy or desirable
n. any quality or characteristic that gains a person a favorable reception or acceptance or admission
zh: n. 推荐, 介绍, 推荐信, 劝告
examples: Tom got the job on the strength of your recommendation.
Thanks to your recommendation, Tom got that job.
exampleZh: 多亏了你的推荐，汤姆得到了那份工作。
多亏了你的推荐，汤姆得到了那份工作。

defsEn: s extraordinarily large in size or extent or amount or power or degree
that a whole civilization should be dependent on technology"- Walter Lippman
s extraordinarily good or great
used especially as intensifiers
s extreme in degree or extent or amount or impact
zh: a. 巨大的, 非常的, 可怕的
examples: The rocket travels at a tremendous speed.
Coming out of the closet requires tremendous courage.
exampleZh: 火箭飞得极快。
出柜需要莫大的勇气。

defsEn: n. a member of a senate
zh: n. 参议员, (某些大学的)理事
examples: The senator remained neutral in the furious controversy.
The senators will praise my act.

defsEn: n the pursuit and killing or capture of wild animals regarded as a sport
n the activity of looking thoroughly in order to find something or someone
n the work of finding and killing or capturing animals for food or pelts
v pursue for food or sport (as of wild animals)
v pursue or chase relentlessly
v chase away, with as with force
v yaw back and forth about a flight path
v oscillate about a desired speed, position, or state to an undesirable extent
v seek, search for
v search (an area) for prey
zh: n. 狩猎, 猎狐, 探求
examples: He cut the hunting trip short for that season.
If you go hunting, you lose your seat.

defsEn: n. food mixtures either arranged on a plate or tossed and served with a moist dressing
usually consisting of or including greens
zh: n. 色拉
examples: Put the tomato salad in the refrigerator.
I bought a bottle of salad oil.
exampleZh: 把蕃茄沙拉放进冰箱里。
我买了一瓶沙拉油。

defsEn: n. the line or plane indicating the limit or extent of something
n. a line determining the limits of an area
zh: n. 边界, 分界线
examples: There is a fence marking the boundary between our yard and the neighbor's.
Sebatik Island is one of the boundary regions between Indonesia and Malaysia.
exampleZh: 我家和邻居家以院子之间的篱笆为分界线。
石峇迪岛是印度尼西亚和马来西亚的边境地区之一。

defsEn: n a device that can be used to control a machine or apparatus from a distance
s located far away spatially
s very unlikely
s separate or apart in time
s inaccessible and sparsely populated
a far apart in relevance or relationship or kinship
zh: a. 遥远的, 偏僻的, 疏远的, 微少的
examples: I used to live in a remote town.
The TV remote control is under the couch.
exampleZh: 我以前住在一个偏远的小镇。
电视遥控器在沙发下面。

defsEn: n. the contentment one feels when one has fulfilled a desire, need, or expectation
n. (law) the payment of a debt or fulfillment of an obligation
n. act of fulfilling a desire or need or appetite
zh: n. 满足, 满意, 快事, 赔偿, 赎罪, 报仇的机会
examples: I won't give them the satisfaction.
I get a lot of satisfaction out of my work.
exampleZh: 我不会让他们得逞的。

defsEn: n. a long seat for more than one person
n. the magistrate or judge or judges sitting in court in judicial capacity to compose the court collectively
n. the reserve players on a team
n. (law) the seat for judges in a courtroom
zh: n. 长椅子
examples: He and his friend sat on the bench.
I'm going to sit on the bench over there next to the street lamp.
exampleZh: 他和他朋友坐在长凳上。
我会在那盏街灯旁边的长凳上坐下来。

defsEn: n. informal terms for nakedness
s. having the surface exposed and painful
a. not treated with heat to prepare it for eating
s. not processed or refined
zh: n. 擦伤处, 半成品
a. 生的, 未加工的, 生疏的, 不成熟的, 阴冷的, 刺痛的, 擦掉皮的
vt. 擦伤
examples: Have you eaten a piece of raw fish?
Eating raw eggs could be bad for you.
exampleZh: 你吃过生鱼片吗？
吃生蛋可能是危险的。

defsEn: n. having knowledge of
n. state of elementary or undifferentiated consciousness
zh: n. 意识, 认识
examples: I have awareness of my surroundings.
You must develop an awareness of your strengths.

defsEn: n. any of various platforms built into a vessel
n. street name for a packet of illegal drugs
n. a porch that resembles the deck on a ship
v. be beautiful to look at
zh: n. 甲板, (汽车后部的)行李仓
vt. 装饰, 打扮, 装甲板
examples: She stood on the deck with her long hair waving in the wind.
Place the deck of cards on the oaken table.
exampleZh: 她站在甲板上，长头发随风飞舞。
把扑克牌放在橡木桌上。

defsEn: n. a long (usually round) rod of wood or metal or plastic
n. a native or inhabitant of Poland
n. one of two divergent or mutually exclusive opinions
n. one of two points of intersection of the Earth's axis and the celestial sphere
zh: n. 波兰人, 极点, 磁极, 电极, 杆, 竿, 相反的极端
vt. 用竿支撑
vi. 撑篙
examples: The temperature at the North Pole is different from at the South Pole.
Santa lives at the North Pole.
exampleZh: 北极与南极的温度不一样。
圣诞老人住在北极。

defsEn: v. give testimony in a court of law
v. provide evidence for
zh: v. 证明, 作证, 声明, 表明
examples: He is not willing to testify for his compatriot.
She testified that she saw the man.
exampleZh: 他不愿意为同胞作证。
她作证说她看见了这名男子。

defsEn: n. a conversation between two persons
n. the lines spoken by characters in drama or fiction
n. a literary composition in the form of a conversation between two people
zh: n. 对话
vi. 对话
vt. 用对话表达
examples: Diplomatic dialogue helped put an end to the conflict.
We need to open up a dialogue.
exampleZh: 外交谈判帮助结束了冲突。

defsEn: s. farther along in physical or mental development
s. comparatively late in a course of development
s. ahead of the times
s. at a higher level in training or knowledge or skill
zh: a. 在前的, 高级的, 先进的, 年老的
examples: Do you have an advanced or beginner level?
The manager advanced a proposal at the meeting.

defsEn: n. a person who founds or establishes some institution
n. a worker who makes metal castings
v. sink below the surface
v. stumble and nearly fall
zh: n. 创立者, 建立者
vt. 使沉没, 使摔倒, 弄跛, 浸水, 破坏
vi. 沉没, 摔到, 变跛, 倒塌, 失败
examples: She is not the founder, she's the investor.
He is the founder of a large company.
exampleZh: 她不是创办人，她是投资人。

defsEn: n. a feeling of self-respect and personal worth
n. satisfaction with your (or another's) achievements
n. the trait of being spurred on by a dislike of falling below your standards
n. a group of lions
zh: n. 骄傲, 自尊心, 自豪, 精华, 勇气
vt. 以...自豪
examples: Do you take pride in your work?
What I said hurt his pride.
exampleZh: 你为你的工作感到自豪吗？
我的话伤了他的自尊心。

defsEn: n. a vehicle that can fly
zh: n. 航空器, 飞机
examples: China has the means to destroy your aircraft carriers.
How many aircraft can an aircraft carrier hold?
exampleZh: 中国有能力摧毁你们的航空母舰。

defsEn: n. the act of delivering or distributing something (as goods or mail)
n. the event of giving birth
n. the voluntary transfer of something (title or possession) from one party to another
n. the act of delivering a child
zh: n. 递送, 交付, 分娩, 交货, 引渡
examples: I have missed the delivery time, what should I do next?
The pizza delivery guy hasn't come by yet.
exampleZh: 已经错过了交货时间了，接来下该怎么办？
送比萨的人还没来。

defsEn: n. a raised horizontal surface
n. a document stating the aims and principles of a political party
n. the combination of a particular computer and a particular operating system
n. any military structure or vehicle bearing weapons
zh: n. 站台, 月台, 讲台, 论坛, 平台
examples: She came close to falling off the platform.
Tom stood on the platform in Westminster Underground Station.
exampleZh: 她差点从台上掉了下来。
汤姆站在威斯敏斯特地铁站的站台上。

defsEn: v. cook and make edible by putting in a hot oven
v. prepare with dry heat in an oven
v. be very hot, due to hot weather or exposure to the sun
zh: vt. 烘焙, 烤
vi. 烤面包
n. 烘焙, 烤
examples: She baked an apple pie for him.
Bread is baked in an oven.
exampleZh: 她为男生烤了一个苹果派。
面包是在烤箱里烤的。

defsEn: a. pleasing to the eye or mind especially through beauty or charm
s. having power to arouse interest
a. having the properties of a magnet
the ability to draw or pull
zh: a. 吸引人的, 有魅力的
examples: Mary has as attractive a personality as her sister.
Her line of reasoning is attractive, but ultimately fallacious.
exampleZh: 玛丽性格很好，就像她姐姐一样。
她说理的主线引人注目，但从根本上是靠不住的。

defsEn: n. the idea of something that is perfect
something that one hopes to attain
n. model of excellence or perfection of a kind
one having no equal
s. conforming to an ultimate standard of perfection or excellence
embodying an ideal
s. constituting or existing only in the form of an idea or mental image or conception
zh: n. 理想, 典范, 观念, 思想, 最后目标
a. 理想的, 完美的, 空想的, 观念的, 唯心论的
examples: The beach is an ideal place for children to play.
He proved to be an ideal husband.
exampleZh: 海滩是一个供孩子们玩乐的理想场所。
他被证实是个理想丈夫。

defsEn: r. in a regular manner
r. having a regular form
r. in a regular way without variation
zh: adv. 有规则地, 一丝不苟地, 正式地
examples: She used to visit me regularly.
I regularly go to bed at nine.
exampleZh: 她以前定期来看我。
我通常九时睡觉。

defsEn: n. a mine or quarry that is being or has been worked
s. actively engaged in paid work
s. adequate for practical use
especially sufficient in strength or numbers to accomplish something
s. adopted as a temporary basis for further work
zh: n. 工作, 运转, 劳动
a. 工作的, 劳动的, 经营的, 抽搐的, 运转的
examples: Understand the inner workings of you.
I think you've got the workings of a great college essay.

defsEn: n. an occurrence of improvement by virtue of preventing loss or injury or other change
n. the preservation and careful management of the environment and of natural resources
n. (physics) the maintenance of a certain quantities unchanged during chemical reactions or physical transformations
zh: n. 保护, 保存
examples: He was in charge of the conservation of the temple.
Forest conservation is an important issue all over the world.

defsEn: n. table consisting of a horizontal surface over which business is transacted
n. game equipment (as a piece of wood, plastic, or ivory) used for keeping a count or reserving a space in various card or board games
n. a calculator that keeps a record of the number of times something happens
n. a person who counts things
zh: n. 计算器, 计算者, 柜台, 筹码
a. 反方向的, 相反的
adv. 反方向地, 相反地
examples: On which counter can I make my appointment?
When the counter value reaches the assigned 'lucky-number' it displays a congratulatory message.
exampleZh: 我可以在哪个柜台预约?
当计数器的数值达到预设的「幸运号码」时，就会显示一则恭喜讯息。

defsEn: n. a vehicle designed for navigation in or on water or air or through outer space
n. people who perform a particular kind of skilled work
n. skill in an occupation or trade
n. shrewdness as demonstrated by being skilled in deception
zh: n. 技艺, 手艺, 诡计
vt. 精心制作
examples: This wood wallet is crafted from a single piece of walnut.
Sami had some arts and crafts things to do.
exampleZh: 这款木质皮夹由一整块胡桃木制成。
萨米有一些手工艺术方面的事情要做。

defsEn: n. a small metal plate that attaches to the toe or heel of a shoe (as in tap dancing)
n. a tool for cutting female (internal) screw threads
n. a plug for a bunghole in a cask
n. a light touch or stroke
zh: n. 轻打, 水龙头
vt. 轻打, 轻敲, 敲打出, 选择, 装上嘴子, 使流出, 开发, 分接, 向...乞讨
vi. 轻叩, 轻拍, 啪塔啪塔地走
examples: He tapped me on the shoulder.
Mend the tap in the kitchen.
exampleZh: 他拍了拍我的肩膀。
修理厨房的水龙头。

defsEn: s. large in spatial extent or range or scope or quantity
a. of agriculture
increasing productivity by using large areas with minimal outlay and labor
zh: a. 广的, 广泛的, 多方面的
examples: She has extensive knowledge of birds, flowers, and plants.
His extensive knowledge of music was a revelation to us.
exampleZh: 她对鸟类和花草很有研究。

defsEn: n. a happening that is distinctive in a series of related events
n. a brief section of a literary or dramatic work that forms part of a connected series
n. a part of a broadcast serial
zh: n. 插曲, 插话, 有趣的事件, 一段情节
examples: I've only seen the first episode.
That reminds me of a Spongebob episode.
exampleZh: 我只看过第一集。
这让我想起一集《海绵宝宝》。

defsEn: n. (geology) a crack in the earth's crust resulting from the displacement of one side with respect to the other
n. (electronics) equipment failure attributable to some defect in a circuit (loose connection or insulation failure or short circuit etc.)
n. responsibility for a bad situation or event
n. (sports) a serve that is illegal (e.g., that lands outside the prescribed area)
zh: n. 过错, 故障, 毛病
vt. 挑剔
vi. 产生断层, 弄错
examples: He is constantly finding fault with other people.
They told me it was your fault.
exampleZh: 他总是挑别人的毛病。
他们告诉我这是你的错。

defsEn: n. hoop that covers a wheel
v. lose interest or become bored with something or somebody
v. exhaust or get tired through overuse or great strain or stress
zh: n. 轮胎, 头饰
vt. 使疲倦, 使厌烦, 打扮
vi. 疲劳, 厌倦
examples: You look tired. You should rest a little.
You look tired. You ought to rest for an hour or two.
exampleZh: 你看起来累了。你该歇息一会儿了。
你看起来很累。你应该休息一两个小时。

defsEn: a. not compact or dense in structure or arrangement
s. (of a ball in sport) not in the possession or control of any player
a. not tight
not closely constrained or constricted or constricting
s. not tense or taut
zh: n. 发射, 放任, 放纵
a. 宽松的, 松的, 宽的, 不牢固的, 散漫的, 自由的, 不精确的
vt. 释放, 放枪, 开船
vi. 变松, 开火
adv. 松散地
examples: She wore a long, loose coat.
To be a good batter, you've got to hang loose and follow your instincts.
exampleZh: 她穿了一件宽松的长外套。
想成为一个好的击球手的话，你要在球场上时刻保持镇定，还要学会相信自己的直觉。

defsEn: r. in an original manner
zh: adv. 本来, 原来, 最初, 就起源而论, 独创地
examples: I find this problem easier than I originally thought.
Originally, I knew nothing about it at all!
exampleZh: 我发现问题比我原以为的容易。
我本来什么也不知道啊！

defsEn: n. a person who uses the mind creatively
s. of or associated with or requiring the use of the mind
a. appealing to or using the intellect
zh: n. 有知识者, 知识分子, 凭理智做事者
a. 智力的, 用脑力的, 聪明的
examples: In terms of intellectual hobbies, I really like learning Chinese characters.
An intellectual is a person who has discovered something more interesting than sex.
exampleZh: 对知识的爱好而言，我真的喜欢学汉字。
一个知识分子是发现到一种比性行为更有意思的活动的人。

defsEn: v. be characteristic of
zh: vt. 描绘...的特性, 刻划...的性格
examples: How would you characterize the economy right now?
How would you characterize your current relationship?

defsEn: n. close fighting during the culmination of a military attack
n. a threatened or attempted physical attack by someone who appears to be able to cause bodily harm if not stopped
n. thoroughbred that won the triple crown in 1946
zh: n. 攻击, 袭击
vt. 袭击, 攻击
vi. 发动攻击
examples: People physically assault you to steal your money.
They will make an assault on the summit, weather permitting.

defsEn: n. a wild and exciting undertaking (not necessarily lawful)
zh: n. 冒险, 冒险经历
v. 冒险
examples: She exposed me to dangerous adventures.
What kind of adventure do you want to have?
exampleZh: 她使我处于危险的冒险。

defsEn: n. any factual evidence that helps to establish the truth of something
n. a formal series of statements showing that if one thing is true something else necessarily follows from it
n. a measure of alcoholic strength expressed as an integer twice the percentage of alcohol present (by volume)
n. (printing) an impression made to check for errors
zh: n. 证据, 证明, 试验, 检验, 考验
a. 不能透入的, 证明用的, 防...的, 耐...的
vt. 检验, 试验, 校对, 使不被穿透
examples: This is proof that you're the murderer.
Just as if that was proof that that was correct English.
exampleZh: 这证明了你是杀人犯。
就好像那证明了英语是正确的。

defsEn: a. having or marked by confidence or assurance
s. not liable to error in judgment or action
zh: a. 有信心的, 有把握的
examples: I'm fairly confident that I can do that.
I'm fairly confident I can do that.
exampleZh: 我相当有自信我能做到这一点。
我相当有自信我能做到这一点。

defsEn: n. an act that disregards an agreement or a right
zh: n. 违反, 违背, 妨碍
examples: I consider it a violation of my privacy.
They said it was a clear violation of international law.

defsEn: n. a mobile mass of muscular tissue covered with mucous membrane and located in the oral cavity
n. any long thin projection that is transient
n. a manner of speaking
n. the tongue of certain animals used as meat
zh: n. 舌, 语言能力, 讲话方式, 语言
vt. 舔, 斥责, 发...的音
vi. 使用舌头, 吹管乐器
examples: It's on the tip of my tongue.
I get tongue-tied in front of you.
exampleZh: 话在嘴边
在你面前我说不出话来。

defsEn: n. a legal document giving official permission to do something
n. freedom to deviate deliberately from normally applicable rules or practices (especially in behavior or speech)
n. excessive freedom
lack of due restraint
n. the act of giving a formal (usually written) authorization
zh: n. 执照, 许可证, 特许
vt. 许可, 特许
examples: It was dark and I couldn't make out the license plate number.
Having a driver's license is an advantage for this job.
exampleZh: 天很黑，我看不清楚车牌号码。
有驾照者优先得到这个职位。

defsEn: n. something that provides access (to get in or get out)
n. a movement into or inward
n. the act of entering
v. put into a trance
zh: n. 入口, 进入点, 入场, 入学, 进入, 开始(阶段), 就任
vt. 使出神, 使入迷
examples: I have to take the entrance examination today.
Where can I buy an entrance ticket?
exampleZh: 我今天要参加入学试。
我在哪里可以买到门票？

defsEn: n. an attitude of defensiveness (especially in the phrase `on the defensive')
a. intended or appropriate for defending against or deterring aggression or attack
s. attempting to justify or defend in speech or writing
zh: a. 防卫的, 防备用的, 自卫的
n. 守势, 防卫姿势, 防卫物
examples: The German Shepherd was in a defensive position.
There's no need to be so defensive.

defsEn: n. gradually ceasing to be visible
v. become less clearly visible or distinguishable
disappear gradually or seemingly
v. lose freshness, vigor, or vitality
zh: vi. 褪色, 消失, 凋谢
vt. 使褪色
n. 淡入, 淡出
a. 平淡的
examples: Her beauty will fade in time.
Love may fade but can reignite over time.
exampleZh: 她的美貌会随着时间而流逝。

defsEn: n. drama in which the protagonist is overcome by some superior force or circumstance
excites terror or pity
zh: n. 悲剧, 惨案, 悲剧作品
examples: This would be a terrible tragedy.
All tragedies end with a death.
exampleZh: 这将是一个可怕的悲剧。
所有悲剧都由死亡终结。

defsEn: n. a trap made of netting to catch fish or birds or insects
n. a goal lined with netting (as in soccer or hockey)
n. game equipment consisting of a strip of netting dividing the playing area in tennis or badminton
n. an open fabric of string or rope or wire woven together at regular intervals
zh: n. 网, 网状物, 罗网, 净利, 净价
a. 净的, 最终的
vt. 用网捕, 撒网, 净赚, 得到
vi. 编网
examples: The fisherman caught a purple jellyfish in his net.
He is using a fishing net to fish.
exampleZh: 渔民用他的网捕到了一只紫色的水母。
他在用渔网捕鱼。

defsEn: n. the act of gripping and pressing firmly
n. a situation in which increased costs cannot be passed on to the customer
n. (slang) a person's girlfriend or boyfriend
n. a twisting squeeze
zh: n. 紧握, 挤, 榨, 榨取, 佣金
vt. 紧握, 挤, 榨取
vi. 压榨, 榨
examples: She squeezed the juice from many oranges.
If you can hear me, squeeze my hand.
exampleZh: 她榨了许多柳橙汁。

defsEn: n. a covering to disguise or conceal the face
n. activity that tries to conceal something
n. a protective covering worn over the face
v. put a mask on or cover with a mask
zh: n. 面具, 假面具, 掩饰, 石膏面模
vt. 戴面具, 掩饰, 使模糊
vi. 化装, 戴面具, 掩饰, 参加化装舞会
examples: He wore a mask so that no one could recognize him.
You must wear a mask on the shop floor.
exampleZh: 他戴着面具以至于没有人认出他。

defsEn: s having a quality that thrusts itself into attention
s conspicuous in position or importance
zh: a. 卓越的, 显著的, 突出的, 凸出的
examples: Prominent figures in the literary world gathered together last night.
The prominent poet attempted to commit suicide in his study.
exampleZh: 知名文学界人士昨晚齐聚一堂。

defsEn: n. the activity of formally presenting something (as a prize or reward)
n. a show or display
the act of presenting something to sight or view
n. the act of making something publicly available
presenting news or other information by broadcasting or printing it
n. the act of presenting a proposal
zh: n. 赠与, 描述, 介绍
examples: What kind of presentation do you want to give?
I have to congratulate you on your presentation.

defsEn: r. in spite of everything
without regard to drawbacks
zh: a. 不管, 不注意, 不顾
