examples: Regardless of whether you come tomorrow or not, let me know.
Regardless what you may do, the outcome will still be the same.
exampleZh: 不管您明天来不来，请通知我。
不管你怎么做，结果都一样。

defsEn: n. the act of beginning something new
n. the first section of a communication
n. a basic or elementary instructional text
n. a new proposal
zh: n. 介绍, 传入, 采用, 初步
examples: Could you give us a brief introduction of yourself?
I came to work here though his introduction.
exampleZh: 你能简短地介绍一下你自己吗？
通过他的介绍，我来到这里工作。

defsEn: v. put forward a claim and assert right or possession of
zh: v. 假装, 伪称, 自命, 自称
examples: She pretended not to hear what he said.
My brother pretended to be working very hard.
exampleZh: 他说话时她假装听不见。
我哥哥假装工作很努力。

defsEn: n people who are old collectively
s advanced in years
(`aged' is pronounced as two syllables)
zh: a. 过了中年的, 稍老的
examples: She gave her seat to an elderly person.
An elderly person in the street fell and broke a leg.
exampleZh: 她把她的座位让给了一个老人。
一位老人在街上摔断了腿。

defsEn: n. a presentation to the mind in the form of an idea or image
n. a creation that is a visual or tangible rendering of someone or something
n. the act of representing
standing in for someone or some group and speaking with authority in their behalf
n. the state of serving as an official and authorized delegate or agent
zh: n. 表示法, 表现, 陈述, 代表
examples: This painting is a representation of a storm at sea.
We have plenty of trans representation on the development team.

defsEn: n. undesirable state of the natural environment being contaminated with harmful substances as a consequence of human activities
zh: n. 污染, 玷污
examples: Air pollution will be a threat to our survival.
Noise pollution could be avoided if only people were more sensitive to the environment.
exampleZh: 空气污染将会威胁我们的生存。
如果大家都懂得关心环境的话，就不会有噪音污染了。

defsEn: v. make steady
a. not subject to change or variation especially in behavior
s. securely in position
not shaky
s. not easily excited or upset
zh: a. 稳定的, 不动摇的, 沉着的, 稳固的, 坚定的, 经常的
vt. 使稳定, 使坚定
vi. 变为沉着, 稳固
examples: He was walking up the hill at a steady pace.
There was a steady increase in population.
exampleZh: 他迈着稳健的步伐登上了山丘。
人口稳定地增加。

defsEn: n. the act of emitting
causing to flow forth
n. the release of electrons from parent atoms
n. the occurrence of a flow of water (as from a pipe)
zh: n. 发射, 射出, 发行
examples: Filters stop emission of gas into the atmosphere.
This machine is robust and emission-free.

defsEn: s. performing an essential function in the living body
s. manifesting or characteristic of life
zh: a. 生命的, 重要的, 充满活力的, 生死攸关的, 致命的
examples: The elevators in a skyscraper are vital systems.
I view sleep as a vital need.
exampleZh: 摩天大厦里的电梯是至关重要的。

defsEn: n. kitchen appliance used for baking or roasting
zh: n. 烤箱, 灶, 子宫
examples: There is an oven to bake bread in the kitchen.
Did you remember to turn off the oven?
exampleZh: 厨房有烤箱，可以用来烤面包。
你记得关烤箱了吗？

defsEn: n. a distinguishing quality
n. a distinguishing difference
zh: n. 区别
examples: He makes no distinction between right and wrong.
I can make a distinction between good and bad.
exampleZh: 他是非不分。

defsEn: n. one of the parts into which something naturally divides
v. divide into segments
v. divide or split up
zh: n. 片段, 部分, 分节, 段
v. 分割, 分裂
examples: This segment of the audio contains too much background noise.
Divide this line segment into twenty equal parts.

defsEn: n. a writer of poems (the term is usually reserved for writers of good poetry)
zh: n. 诗人
examples: I would like to become a poet.
She's famous as a singer but not as a poet.
exampleZh: 我想要成为诗人。
她是一个有名的歌手，但却没有多少人知道她也有写诗。

defsEn: n. a small pond of standing water
s. being nothing more than specified
zh: n. 小湖, 池塘
a. 仅仅的, 只不过的
examples: The mere thought of a snake makes me shiver.
Our current crisis is no mere economic crisis.
exampleZh: 一想到蛇就发颤。
我们当前的危机绝非单纯的经济危机。

defsEn: a. creating or arousing excitement
s. stimulating interest and discussion
zh: a. 令人兴奋的, 刺激的
examples: The space race was an exciting time in history.
What's the most exciting thing you've done this year?
exampleZh: 太空竞赛是历史上激动人心的时期。
你今年做的最刺激的事是什么？

defsEn: n. an instance of change
the rate or magnitude of change
n. an activity that varies from a norm or standard
n. a repetition of a musical theme in which it is modified or embellished
n. an artifact that deviates from a norm or standard
zh: n. 变更, 变化, 变种, 变奏
examples: This is the humorous variation of a certain proverb.
This is a humorous variation of a proverb.

defsEn: n. someone who communicates by means of letters
n. a journalist employed to provide news stories for newspapers or broadcast media
zh: n. 通讯记者, 通信者
examples: A correspondent must soon adjust himself to life abroad.
Tom used to be a war correspondent.

defsEn: v. turn pale, as if in fear
s. very light colored
highly diluted with white
s. (of light) lacking in intensity or brightness
dim or feeble
s. lacking in vitality or interest or effectiveness
zh: n. 栅栏, 界线, 范围
a. 苍白的, 暗淡的, 无力的
vi. 变苍白, 变暗, 失色
vt. 使变苍白, 使失色, 用栅栏围
examples: You look pale. You had better lie down in bed at once.
He told me that I looked pale and asked me what the matter was.
exampleZh: 你的脸色这么差，还是赶快去睡觉吧。
他跟我说我很苍白，并问我怎么了。

defsEn: n. the quality of being significant
n. a meaning that is not expressly stated but can be inferred
zh: n. 重要性, 意义, 意味
examples: It has no absolute and universal significance.
The result was of little significance.

defsEn: n. a tube in which a body fluid circulates
n. a craft designed for water transportation
n. an object used as a container (especially for liquids)
zh: n. 船, 容器, 脉管
examples: He burst a blood vessel in the brain.
A blood vessel burst inside his brain.

defsEn: n. the act of storing something
n. the commercial enterprise of storing goods and materials
n. (computer science) the process of storing information in a computer memory or on a magnetic tape or disk
zh: n. 存储器, 储藏, 保管, 库存, 仓库
examples: I need to clear out my storage unit.
How much storage space do you need?

defsEn: n. an animal skin made smooth and flexible by removing the hair and then tanning
v. whip with a leather strap
zh: n. 皮革, 皮制品, 马镫的皮带
vt. 覆以皮革, 鞭苔, 抽打
a. 皮革的, 皮制的
examples: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.
I bought a pair of leather gloves.
exampleZh: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。
我买了一双皮手套。

defsEn: n. (biology) the sequence of events involved in the evolutionary development of a species or taxonomic group of organisms
zh: n. 进化, 发展, 进展, (气体)放出, 开方
examples: We associate Darwin with the theory of evolution.
They opposed Darwin's theory of evolution.
exampleZh: 一提到进化论，我们就会想起达尔文。
他们反对达尔文的进化论。

defsEn: n. a support that consists of a horizontal surface for holding objects
zh: n. 架子, 搁板
examples: He put the book on the shelf.
He put the books on the shelf out of order.
exampleZh: 他把书放在了书架上。
他胡乱把书本放在架上。

defsEn: n. a field of cultivated and mowed grass
zh: n. 草地, 草坪, 上等细麻布
examples: Mother told me to mow the lawn.
I'm going to mow the lawn tomorrow, weather permitting.
exampleZh: 妈妈叫我修剪草坪。
如果天气情况允许的话，我明天就去割草坪。

defsEn: n. the act of eating dinner
zh: n. 正餐, 宴会
examples: What do you say to dining out tonight?
Sorry, I was dining and I didn't see the message.
exampleZh: 我们今晚出去吃饭，你说怎么样？
抱歉，我刚才在吃饭，没有看到信息。

defsEn: n. accumulated knowledge or erudition or enlightenment
n. the trait of utilizing knowledge and experience with common sense and insight
n. ability to apply knowledge or experience or understanding or common sense and insight
n. the quality of being prudent and sensible
zh: n. 智慧, 明智行为, 学识, 名言, 贤人
examples: He is remarkable for his wisdom.
He is gifted with perfect wisdom.
exampleZh: 他的智慧非凡。
他天生拥有完美的智慧。

defsEn: a. susceptible to attack
s. susceptible to criticism or persuasion or temptation
s. capable of being wounded or hurt
zh: a. 易受伤害的, 有弱点的, 易受影响的, 脆弱的, 成局的
examples: I feel vulnerable, yet safe with you.
Do vulnerable road users always have the right of way?

defsEn: n. the quality of being capable -- physically or intellectually or legally
n. the susceptibility of something to a particular treatment
n. an aptitude that may be developed
zh: n. 能力, 性能, 约束力
examples: She has the wonderful capability to overcome any obstacle.
The new team has the capability to win.

defsEn: n. a widely known person
zh: n. 名声, 名人
examples: If you saw a celebrity, what would you ask them?
Which celebrity would you like to meet?

defsEn: n. the quality or attribute of being firm and steadfast
n. a stable order (especially of society)
zh: n. 安定, 稳定性, 坚实, 巩固
examples: I want stability in my life.
They fought to maintain peace and stability in the galaxy.

defsEn: n. imagination unrestricted by reality
n. fiction with a large amount of imagination in it
v. indulge in fantasies
zh: n. 幻想, 想象的产物
examples: Reality and fantasy are hard to distinguish.
He lives in a world of fantasy.
exampleZh: 现实和幻想是很难区分的。
他住在一个奇幻世界里。

defsEn: n. motion of hands or body to emphasize or help to express a thought or feeling
n. the use of movements (especially of the hands) to communicate familiar or prearranged signals
n. something done as an indication of intention
zh: n. 手势, 姿态
vi. 作手势, 作姿态
examples: Father gestured to me to leave the room.
Gestures are very important in human communication.
exampleZh: 父亲示意我离开房间。
在人类的交流活动中，身体语言非常重要。

defsEn: n. someone who gives advice about problems
n. someone who has supervisory duties at a summer camp
zh: n. 顾问, 参事, 法律顾问
examples: The camp counselors are supposed to provide guidance and mentorship to the students.
You could talk to a different counselor if you want to.
exampleZh: 营辅员应负责为学生提供指引和辅导。

defsEn: n. the legal dissolution of a marriage
v. get a divorce
formally terminate a marriage
zh: n. 离婚
vt. 与...离婚
examples: I think she will divorce him.
She told him she wanted a divorce.
exampleZh: 我想她会和他离婚。
她告诉他说，她想要离婚。

defsEn: v. pay no attention to, disrespect
zh: n. 轻蔑, 怠慢
a. 轻微的, 纤细的, 脆弱的, 苗条的
vt. 轻视, 忽略, 怠慢
examples: I have a slight headache today.
I have a slight fever today.
exampleZh: 我今天有轻微的头痛。
我今天有点发烧。

defsEn: n. relative darkness caused by light rays being intercepted by an opaque body
n. a quality of a given color that differs slightly from another color
n. protective covering that protects something from direct sunlight
n. a position of relative inferiority
zh: n. 荫, 阴暗, 遮光物, 灯罩, 帘, 浓淡, 微量, 底纹
vi. 渐变
vt. 使阴暗, 使渐变, 遮蔽, 微减
examples: Park the car in the shade.
There's no light without shade, and no shade without light.
exampleZh: 把车停到阴影里。
不存在没有阴影的光明，也不存在没有光明的阴影。

defsEn: n. the posterior part of the body of a vertebrate especially when elongated and extending beyond the trunk or main part of the body
n. any projection that resembles the tail of an animal
n. a spy employed to follow someone and report their movements
n. (usually plural) the reverse side of a coin that does not bear the representation of a person's head
zh: n. 尾部, 后部, 辫子, 随员, 特务, 燕尾服, 踪迹, 限定继承(权)
a. 在后面的, 从后面而来的, 限定继承的, 尾部的, 后部的
vt. 为...装尾, 附于其后, 尾随, 使搭牢, 跟踪, 监视
vi. 跟踪, 船尾搁浅
examples: The child caught the cat by the tail.
Just as if it were my tail, wherever I go, it goes too.
exampleZh: 孩子抓住了猫的尾巴。
它就像我的尾巴一样，我去哪里它就去哪里。

defsEn: n. a mounting consisting of a piece of metal (as in a ring or other jewelry) that holds a gem in place
v. attach to a support
v. fix onto a backing, setting, or support
v. put up or launch
zh: n. 乘骑用马, 框, 衬纸, 山
vi. 乘马, 爬上, 增长
vt. 爬上, 使上马, 装上, 装裱, 安放, 制作...的标本, 设置, 上演
examples: The jeweler mounted a big pearl in the brooch.
She is going to Mount Tate.
exampleZh: 宝石师傅在胸针上镶了一枚大珍珠。
她将去立山。

defsEn: n. the state of being obligated to do or pay something
n. a personal relation in which one is indebted for a service or favor
n. a legal agreement specifying a payment or action and the penalty for failure to comply
zh: n. 义务, 责任, 约束, 契约, 恩惠, 债务
examples: It is our obligation to help.
I actually don't have an obligation to help you.
exampleZh: 帮助是我们的义务。
我并没有义务帮助你。

defsEn: n. the space between two lines or planes that intersect
the inclination of one line to another
measured in degrees or radians
n. a member of a Germanic people who conquered England and merged with the Saxons and Jutes to become Anglo-Saxons
v. move or proceed at an angle
v. fish with a hook
zh: n. 角, 角度, 角落
vi. 钓鱼, 谋取, 博取, 斜向移动, 转变角度
vt. 使转动角度, 在...钓鱼, 获取
examples: The angle would be too narrow.
A right angle has ninety degrees.
exampleZh: 这个角度会过于狭窄。
直角是九十度。

defsEn: v. be different
zh: vi. 不一致, 不同
examples: The north and south differ greatly from each other.
I differ from you on that point.
exampleZh: 南方和北方的差异很大。
关于这一点，我的想法和你不同。

defsEn: n. the inner surface of the hand from the wrist to the base of the fingers
n. a linear unit based on the length or width of the human hand
n. any plant of the family Palmae having an unbranched trunk crowned by large pinnate or palmate leaves
zh: n. 手掌, 棕榈, 胜利
vt. 与...握手, 藏...于掌中
examples: Palm oil production is the leading cause of deforestation in Indonesia.
I am interested in palm reading.
exampleZh: 棕榈油制造是导致印度尼西亚森林砍伐的主要原因。
我对掌上阅读很感兴趣。

defsEn: n. liquid food especially of meat or fish or vegetable stock often containing pieces of solid food
n. any composition having a consistency suggestive of soup
n. an unfortunate situation
v. dope (a racehorse)
zh: n. 汤, 马力
vt. 加速, 增加马力
examples: You have the choice of soup or salad.
I would like to have this soup.
exampleZh: 你有两种选择，汤，或沙拉。
我要这个汤。

defsEn: a. being effective without wasting time or effort or expense
zh: a. 有效率的, 能干的
examples: There is no denying that she is very efficient.
There must be a more efficient way to do this.
exampleZh: 无可否认她非常有能力。

defsEn: n. the spatial property resulting from the arrangement of parts in relation to each other and to the whole
n. a mixture of ingredients
n. an essay (especially one written as an assignment)
n. something that is created by arranging several things to form a unified whole
zh: n. 作文, 创作, 组成
examples: Your composition was good except for the spelling.
Her composition is very good except for a few errors in spelling.
exampleZh: 你的文章写得很好，但却有很多字拼错了。
她的作文写得十分好，只是有几个词拼错了。

defsEn: n. a collection of objects laid on top of each other
n. a large sum of money (especially as pay or profit)
n. a column of wood or steel or concrete that is driven into the ground to provide support for a structure
n. the yarn (as in a rug or velvet or corduroy) that stands up from the weave
zh: n. 堆, 大堆, 大厦, 建筑群, 电池, 大量, 桥桩, 软毛, 痔疮
vi. 堆起, 堆积, 积累, 挤, 猛烈攻击
vt. 堆于, 累积, 堆叠, 打桩于, 用桩支撑
examples: He donated a large pile of items to the museum.
The luggage is piled up in the truck.
exampleZh: 他将一大堆东西捐赠给博物馆。
行李堆放在卡车里。

defsEn: n. an abundant nonmetallic tetravalent element occurring in three allotropic forms: amorphous carbon and graphite and diamond
occurs in all organic compounds
n. a copy made with carbon paper
zh: n. 碳, 副本, 复写纸
examples: He is a carbon copy of his father.
Use carbon paper to trace your pattern onto the cloth.
exampleZh: 他是他父亲的翻版。

defsEn: n. a long narrow opening
n. a sudden sharp noise
n. a blemish resulting from a break without complete separation of the parts
n. a purified and potent form of cocaine that is smoked rather than snorted
highly addictive
zh: n. 裂缝, 爆裂声
v. (使)爆裂, (使)裂开, (使)发出爆裂声
a. 第一流的
adv. 啪地一声
examples: I can crack the password of this box.
I'll take a crack at it.
exampleZh: 我能破译这个箱子的密码。
我试试。

defsEn: n. the number of occurrences within a given time period
n. the ratio of the number of observations in a statistical category to the total number of observations
n. the number of observations in a given statistical category
zh: n. 频率, 频数
examples: The recent frequency of earthquakes makes us nervous.
With what frequency do you read your Bible?
exampleZh: 最近频繁的地震让我们很焦虑。

defsEn: n. leaves of the tobacco plant dried and prepared for smoking or ingestion
n. aromatic annual or perennial herbs and shrubs
zh: n. 烟草, 香烟
examples: Today is World No Tobacco Day.
You should know that tobacco is harmful to your health.
exampleZh: 今天是世界无烟日。

defsEn: n. one who lives through affliction
n. one who outlives another
n. an animal that survives in spite of adversity
zh: n. 生还者, 幸存者
examples: He's the only survivor in the village.
The survivors were found on an island, dying of starvation.
exampleZh: 他是村子里面唯一在世的人。
幸存者在一个岛上被找到了，已经饿得要死了。

defsEn: r. making an additional point
anyway
besides, we can't afford it"
r. in addition
zh: prep. 除...之外
adv. 而且, 此外
examples: Besides being an actress, she was a famous painter.
Besides the piano, can you play any other instruments?
exampleZh: 她不但是一个演员，她还曾是一个著名的画家。
除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？

defsEn: n. a scientist trained in psychology
zh: n. 心理学家
examples: I told him to see a psychologist.
She's a psychologist working in the hospital environment.

defsEn: n. a splendid assemblage (especially of famous people)
n. (astronomy) a collection of star systems
any of the billions of systems each having many stars and nebulae and dust
zh: n. 银河, 星系, 一群(显赫的人物)
examples: Most large galaxies have a central supermassive black hole.
There are many galaxies in the universe.
exampleZh: 大多数大星系的中心都有一个超大质量黑洞。
在宇宙中有很多星系。

defsEn: n. the quality of being limited or restricted
n. (law) a time period after which suits cannot be brought
n. an act of limiting or restricting (as by regulation)
zh: n. 限制, 缺陷, 限额
examples: Tom is aware of his own limitations.
Rightness of limitation is essential for growth of reality.
exampleZh: 汤姆清楚自己的局限。

defsEn: n. the act of putting a person into a non-elective position
n. (usually plural) furnishings and equipment (especially for a ship or hotel)
n. the job to which you are (or hope to be) appointed
n. (law) the act of disposing of property by virtue of the power of appointment
zh: n. 约会, 委任的职位, 委派
examples: Make another appointment at the front desk.
I have an appointment with him at six.
exampleZh: 在服务台另外预约。
我约了他六点钟见面。

defsEn: n. a strong liking
n. the right or chance to choose
n. grant of favor or advantage to one over another (especially to a country or countries in matters of international trade, such as levying duties)
zh: n. 偏爱, 优先, 喜爱物
examples: Individual preferences play an important role in this field.
He has a preference for modern music.

defsEn: n. a violent release of energy caused by a chemical or nuclear reaction
n. the act of exploding or bursting
n. a sudden great increase
n. the noise caused by an explosion
zh: n. 爆发, 激增, 爆炸(声)
examples: Yesterday, an explosion occurred at the fireworks factory.
What was the cause of the explosion?
exampleZh: 昨晚，烟花厂发生了爆炸。
爆炸的原因是什么？

defsEn: a. beyond belief or understanding
zh: a. 难以置信的
examples: This matter is of incredible urgency!
It's incredible that your mother speaks six languages!
exampleZh: 这件事十万火急！
你母亲说六种语言真是让人难以置信！

defsEn: n. a part of a river where the current is very fast
s. done or occurring in a brief period of time
s. characterized by speed
moving with or capable of moving with high speed
zh: a. 迅速的, 飞快的, 急促的, 陡的
n. 急流
examples: We're amazed by the rapid growth in import quantities.
I'm amazed at his rapid progress in English.
exampleZh: 进口数量的急速增长让我们感到惊讶。
我被他英语的快速进步惊呆了。

defsEn: n. the act of admitting someone to enter
n. an acknowledgment of the truth of something
zh: n. 准许进入, 入场费, 录用, 承认
examples: She made out the application for admission.
There is no admission fee for children under five.
exampleZh: 她提出了入学申请。
五岁以下的小孩票价全免。

defsEn: n a very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk
zh: n. 婴儿, 儿童, 初学者
a. 婴儿的, 幼稚的
examples: You should really take an infant CPR class.
She put the infant in the child seat.
exampleZh: 你应该去上婴儿心肺复苏课程。

defsEn: v. make a mathematical calculation or computation
v. judge to be probable
v. specifically design a product, event, or activity for a certain public
zh: v. 计算, 预测, 计划, 打算
examples: We calculated that we could reach the place within two weeks.
I can't calculate the final cost without first discussing it with our contractors.
exampleZh: 我们估计能在两周内到那个地方。
不先与我们的承包商讨论的话我无法计算出最后的费用。

defsEn: n. a characteristic likelihood of or natural disposition toward a certain condition or character or effect
n. a general direction in which something tends to move
zh: n. 趋向, 倾向
examples: There is a tendency for people to think that hang gliding is dangerous.
You have a tendency to talk too fast.
exampleZh: 人们普遍认为悬挂式滑翔运动是危险的。

defsEn: v. relieve from
zh: vt. 免除, 以...清除, 使获自由, 使摆脱
examples: You must get rid of that bad habit.
I want to get rid of it.
exampleZh: 你必须改掉这个坏习惯。
我想摆脱它。

defsEn: n. a structure attached to the exterior of a building often forming a covered entrance
zh: n. 门廊, 走廊
examples: Three men are waiting for you on the porch.
Yanni left the flowers on Skura's porch.
exampleZh: 三个男人在门廊上在等你。
雅尼把花放在了斯库拉家的门廊上。

defsEn: n. financial aid provided to a student on the basis of academic merit
zh: n. 学问, 学术成就, 奖学金
examples: He won a scholarship to study in Germany.
Thirty-two Madagascan students who receive scholarship are flying to China.
exampleZh: 他赢取了一份去德国留学的奖学金。
三十二名领奖学金的马达加斯加学生飞往中国。

defsEn: n. an arrangement of people or things acting as a unit
n. the act of fabricating something in a particular shape
n. a particular spatial arrangement
n. natural process that causes something to form
zh: n. 形成, 构造, 编队
examples: Fundamentally, the formation of the twelve zodiac signs is related to animal worship.
A possible explanation would be the formation of pore-like structures.
exampleZh: 从根本上说，十二生肖的形成，与动物崇拜有关。

defsEn: n. a district that is reserved for particular purpose
n. a statement that limits or restricts some claim
n. the written record or promise of an arrangement by which accommodations are secured in advance
n. something reserved in advance (as a hotel accommodation or a seat on a plane etc.)
zh: n. 保留, 预定, 保留品, 保留地
examples: Can I make a reservation for golf?
I have a reservation for tonight.
exampleZh: 我能预定一下打高尔夫球吗？
我有今晚的预订。

defsEn: n. the ratio of the output to the input of any system
n. skillfulness in avoiding wasted time and effort
zh: n. 效率, 效能, 功效
examples: I used to live in an efficiency.
Efficiency is the dominant idea in business.

defsEn: v. prove capable or fit
meet requirements
v. pronounce fit or able
v. make more specific
v. make fit or prepared
zh: vi. 取得资格, 有资格
vt. 使有资格, 使合格, 限定, 限制, 准予
examples: Do you think that you are qualified for that aspect of the work?
Do you think I'm qualified for that job?
exampleZh: 你认为可以胜任那些方面的工作？
你觉得我能胜任那个工作吗？

defsEn: n a public area set aside as a pedestrian walk
n mercantile establishment consisting of a carefully landscaped complex of shops representing leading merchandisers
usually includes restaurants and a convenient parking area
a modern version of the traditional marketplace
zh: n. 林荫路
examples: Find a mall near the school.
I'd like to go to the mall.
exampleZh: 找个学校附近的商场。
我想去商场。

defsEn: n. disgraceful gossip about the private lives of other people
n. a disgraceful event
zh: n. 丑闻, 中伤, 耻辱, 反感, 流言蜚语
examples: He admits being involved in the scandal.
This scandal will likely ruin your chances of being elected.
exampleZh: 他承认自己与这宗丑闻有牵连。
这则丑闻很有可能会断送您的选举。

defsEn: a. providing assistance or serving a useful function
zh: a. 有帮助的, 有益的, 有用的
examples: It would be helpful if you could do that for me.
I'll never forget how helpful you've been.
exampleZh: 您那样做的话，可就帮到我了。
我永远不会忘记您的帮助。

defsEn: n. the bottom of a shoe or boot
the back part of a shoe or boot that touches the ground and provides elevation
n. the back part of the human foot
n. one of the crusty ends of a loaf of bread
n. the lower end of a ship's mast
zh: n. 脚后跟, 踵, 后部, 倾侧
vt. 尾随, 装以鞋跟, 倾侧, 追赶
vi. 紧随, 用脚后跟传球
examples: She wears high heels to make herself look taller.
The heels of his socks had been worn out.
exampleZh: 她穿着高跟鞋，这样显得更高一些。
他袜子的后跟破了。

defsEn: v. appear like
be similar or bear a likeness to
zh: vt. 相似, 类似
examples: She resembles her mother in every respect.
He resembles his father very much.
exampleZh: 她在各方面都像她的母亲。
他很像他的父亲。

defsEn: n. artifact made by weaving or felting or knitting or crocheting natural or synthetic fibers
zh: n. 织物, 布, 结构, 构造, 建筑物
examples: The dress is made of a thin fabric.
These fabrics are made of pure wool.
exampleZh: 这件衣服是由薄织物制成的。
这些布是全羊毛的。

defsEn: n. the quality of being secluded from the presence or view of others
n. the condition of being concealed or hidden
zh: n. 隐私, 隐居, 秘密
examples: I worry about his privacy and personal space.
We get a lot of privacy here.

defsEn: n. an occasion on which a winner is selected from among two or more contestants
n. a struggle between rivals
v. to make the subject of dispute, contention, or litigation
zh: n. 竞赛, 争论
vt. 竞争, 争取, 争辩
vi. 竞争
examples: He endeavored to win the contest.
She won the public speaking contest.
exampleZh: 他试着赢得竞赛。
她在演讲比赛中取得了第一名。

defsEn: n. a shoulder firearm with a long barrel and a rifled bore
v. go through in search of something
search through someone's belongings in an unauthorized way
zh: n. 来复枪, 步枪
vt. 用步枪射击, 抢夺
vi. (抱有不良意图)迅速翻查
examples: He carried a rifle on his shoulder.
Benjamin shot a bear with a rifle.
exampleZh: 他把步枪背在他的肩上。
班杰明用步枪射了一只熊。

defsEn: n. an unshakable belief in something without need for proof or evidence
n. (criminal law) a final judgment of guilty in a criminal case and the punishment that is imposed
zh: n. 定罪, 信服, 坚信
examples: Betty has a previous conviction for theft.
She said all this with complete conviction.
exampleZh: 贝蒂有盗窃前科。

defsEn: n. means of maintenance of a family or group

n. the unauthorized interference in a legal action by a person having no interest in it (as by helping one party with money or otherwise to continue the action) so as to obstruct justice or promote unnecessary litigation or unsettle the peace of the community
zh: n. 维护, 保持, 维修, 生活费用, 坚持, 扶养
examples: Regular maintenance should keep the machine in good working order.
He was in charge of maintenance at the chocolate factory.

defsEn: n. the act of examining something closely (as for mistakes)
n. a set of questions or exercises evaluating skill or knowledge
n. the act of giving students or candidates a test (as by questions) to determine what they know or have learned
zh: n. 考试, 测验, 审查
examples: He could pass the examination, could not he?
He failed in the examination for lack of preparation.
exampleZh: 他能过考试的，是不是？
他因为准备太少考试不及格了。

defsEn: n. a fertilizer that is derived from animal or vegetable matter
a. relating or belonging to the class of chemical compounds having a carbon basis
a. being or relating to or derived from or having properties characteristic of living organisms
a. involving or affecting physiology or bodily organs
zh: a. 器官的, 有机的, 组织的, 根本的
examples: Tom and Mary own a small organic farm.
Just throw the organic waste in the compost bin.
exampleZh: 汤姆和玛丽拥有一个小型的有机农场。

defsEn: v. make strong or stronger
v. gain strength
zh: vt. 加强, 变坚固
vi. 变强, 股票上涨
examples: The government should strengthen their army once and for all!
What can we do to strengthen the movement of solidarity with the Palestinian people?
exampleZh: 政府应该彻底加强军队建设！
我们能做些什么来加强声援巴勒斯坦人民的运动？

defsEn: n. a traditional story accepted as history
serves to explain the world view of a people
zh: n. 神话, 虚构的事, 虚构的人
examples: The myth that people who talk about suicide never follow through is deadly.
The mountain is famous in myth and legend.

defsEn: a. having or appealing to those having worldly knowledge and refinement and savoir-faire
s. intellectually appealing
zh: a. 复杂的, 久经世故的
examples: I can bring in some more sophisticated equipment if you think we need it.
Each cell is a complete and highly sophisticated living world in its own right.

defsEn: n. social or financial or professional status or reputation
n. an ordered listing of scores or results showing the relative positions of competitors (individuals or teams) in a sporting event
n. the act of assuming or maintaining an erect upright position
s. having a supporting base
zh: n. 起立, 持续, 身分
a. 立着的, 不动的, 经常的, 持续的
examples: At my job, I spend the day standing up.
Do you know the man standing on the bridge?

defsEn: n. a game played with rackets by two or four players who hit a ball back and forth over a net that divides the court
zh: n. 网球
examples: I used to play tennis in high school.
Can I borrow your tennis racket today?
exampleZh: 我高中时曾打网球
今天可以借你的网球拍一用吗？

defsEn: n. a tube through which a bullet travels when a gun is fired
n. a cylindrical container that holds liquids
n. a bulging cylindrical shape
hollow with flat ends
n. the quantity that a barrel (of any size) will hold
zh: n. 桶
vt. 装入桶内
examples: Wine is put in barrels to mature.
Cookie's house is a laid barrel.
exampleZh: 酒被放在桶里发酵。
曲奇的窝是一个平放的木桶。

defsEn: n. the body of members of an organization or group
n. the state of being a member
zh: n. 会员的资格, 全体会员, 会员数目
examples: I applied for membership in the association.
There's no membership fee for joining.
exampleZh: 我申请成为协会会员。
参加不用会员费。

defsEn: n. a list of dishes available at a restaurant
n. the dishes making up a meal
n. (computer science) a list of options available to a computer user
n. an agenda of things to do
zh: n. 菜单, (功能)选择单
examples: Can I have the menu again, please?
Can I see the menu, please?
exampleZh: 麻烦让我再看看菜单好吗？
麻烦给我菜单。

defsEn: a. marked by or capable of arousing controversy
zh: a. 争论的, 论争的, 被议论的
examples: He sows discord by raising controversial subjects.
We need to reinvestigate this controversial event.
exampleZh: 他挑起争议性高的话题，制造纷争。

defsEn: n. a person who is frightened and in need of help
s. desperately determined
s. (of persons) dangerously reckless or violent as from urgency or despair
s. showing extreme courage
especially of actions courageously undertaken in desperation as a last resort
zh: a. 不顾一切的, 危急的, 令人绝望的, 极渴望的
examples: Desperate times call for desperate measures.
You must be desperate to do that.
exampleZh: 非常时期需要非常措施。

defsEn: n a manner of living that reflects the person's values and attitudes
zh: n. 生活方式
examples: He has problems with adapting to lifestyle changes.
Tell me about your lifestyle before and after Islam.
exampleZh: 他在适应新的生活方式上有问题。

defsEn: n. a message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events
presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program
s. consisting of or characterized by the telling of a story
zh: n. 叙述, 故事
a. 叙述的, 叙事的, 故事体的
examples: The narrative provided some eye-opening social commentary on the state of the country.
A narrative can be a genre of text.

defsEn: a. marked by simplicity
having a humble opinion of yourself
s. not large but sufficient in size or amount
s. free from pomp or affectation
a. not offensive to sexual mores in conduct or appearance
zh: a. 谦逊的, 羞怯的, 端庄的, 适度的
examples: As a woman, I want to be a modest person.
A modest ceremony would suit me perfectly.

defsEn: n. (sports) the act of swinging or striking at a ball with a club or racket or bat or cue or hand
n. a sudden loss of consciousness resulting when the rupture or occlusion of a blood vessel leads to oxygen lack in the brain
n. a light touch
n. a light touch with the hands
zh: n. 笔划, 打, 中风, 抚, 摩, 冲程
vt. 划尾桨, 抚, 摩, 划去
examples: One stroke of the pen will not solve this problem.
What a stroke of luck! You found a parking spot right away.

defsEn: n. a small number or amount
n. the quantity that can be held in the hand
zh: n. 少数, 一把, 棘手事
examples: Only a handful of people know the fact.
The boy gathered a handful of peanuts and put them in a small box.
exampleZh: 知道真相的人只有几个。
男孩收集了一把花生，然后把它们放到了一个小箱子里。

defsEn: s. beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
a. eager to investigate and learn or learn more (sometimes about others' concerns)
s. having curiosity aroused
eagerly interested in learning more
zh: a. 好奇的, 求知的, 古怪的
examples: She was so curious that she opened the box.
She's curious to find out who sent the flowers.
exampleZh: 她太过好奇，以至于打开了盒子。
她很想知道那束花是谁寄来的。

defsEn: n. the line at which the sky and Earth appear to meet
n. the range of interest or activity that can be anticipated
n. a specific layer or stratum of soil or subsoil in a vertical cross section of land
n. the great circle on the celestial sphere whose plane passes through the sensible horizon and the center of the Earth
zh: n. 地平线, 眼界, (天)视地平
examples: The sun rose over the horizon.
The sun went below the horizon.
exampleZh: 太阳升出了地平线。
太阳落到地平线下了。

defsEn: n. a cue given to a performer (usually the beginning of the next line to be spoken)
n. (computer science) a symbol that appears on the computer screen to indicate that the computer is ready to receive a command
v. serve as the inciting cause of
v. assist (somebody acting or reciting) by suggesting the next words of something forgotten or imperfectly learned
zh: n. 激励, 提示, 提醒物, 提词, 付款期限
a. 迅速的, 敏捷的, 立刻的, 提词员的
vt. 激励, 鼓动, 提示
adv. 准时地
examples: He pressed me for a prompt reply.
Thank you for your prompt reply.
exampleZh: 他要求我尽快回覆。

defsEn: n. any female friend
n. a girl or young woman with whom a man is romantically involved
zh: n. 女朋友
examples: I know that you have a girlfriend.
I know you have a girlfriend.
exampleZh: 我知道你有女朋友！
我知道你有女朋友！

defsEn: a. of or located in the lower part of a town, or in the business center
r. toward or in the lower or central part of town
zh: n. 市中心区
a. 市中心的
adv. 往闹市区
examples: The downtown area is the heart of the city.
I often go downtown on Sunday.
exampleZh: 市中心是城市之心。
我常常星期日去市中心。

defsEn: n. (physics) the six kinds of quarks
zh: n. 滋味, 调味品
vt. 加味于
examples: The lemon has a flavor all of its own.
This drink's flavor is obviously that of tea.
exampleZh: 柠檬有独特的味道。
这个饮料的味道很明显是茶的味道。

defsEn: v. become imbued
v. take up mentally
v. take up, as of debts or payments
v. take in, also metaphorically
zh: vt. 吸收, 使全神贯注, 同化, 买进, 理解, 承受, 忍受, 承担
examples: I can't absorb all of the lesson in an hour.
She was absorbed in writing a poem.
exampleZh: 我不能一小时内彻底的了解那堂课程。
她全神贯注地写着诗。

defsEn: n. making or becoming suitable
adjusting to circumstances
n. the act of adjusting something to match a standard
zh: n. 调整, 调节, 校正
examples: What adjustments do I need to make to get this to work?
She made a quick adjustment to her new job.

defsEn: a. having or showing keen interest or intense desire or impatient expectancy
zh: a. 热心的, 渴望的, 热望的
examples: He is eager to go there.
He thinks that they are eager for glory.
exampleZh: 他渴望去那里。
他以为他们渴望荣耀。

defsEn: s. developed or executed with care and in minute detail
zh: a. 详细的, 复杂的
examples: Thank you very much for the very detailed response.
Thank you very much for your detailed explanation.

defsEn: n. the psychological feature that arouses an organism to action toward a desired goal
the reason for the action
that which gives purpose and direction to behavior
n. the condition of being motivated
n. the act of motivating
providing incentive
zh: n. 动机, 刺激, 推动
examples: I would do it, but I lack motivation.
I lack motivation to do this.

defsEn: n. a principle that limits the extent of something
n. the act of keeping something within specified bounds (by force if necessary)
zh: n. 限制, 限定, 约束
examples: We should not put restrictions on foreign trade.
We face restrictions from the community.

defsEn: n. a duty that you are assigned to perform (especially in the armed forces)
n. the instrument by which a claim or right or interest or property is transferred from one person to another
n. the act of distributing something to designated places or persons
n. an undertaking that you have been assigned to do (as by an instructor)
zh: n. 分配, 功课, 任务, 转让, 归因, 陈述
examples: I was abroad on an assignment.
The assignment took me longer than I had expected.
exampleZh: 我在国外指派了。
我用了比我预期更长的时间来完成作业。

defsEn: n. small workplace where handcrafts or manufacturing are done
n. a brief intensive course for a small group
emphasizes problem solving
zh: n. 工场, 车间, 研讨会
examples: He set up a secret workshop in the basement.
I have a workshop in my garage.

defsEn: n. French writer whose novels described the sordid side of city life (1804-1857)
zh: vt. 控告, 起诉, 请求
vi. 提出诉讼, 提出请求
examples: Tom and Sue love each other.
Sue and John decided to get married.
exampleZh: 汤姆和苏彼此相爱。
Sue 和 John 决定结婚。

defsEn: n. a high place affording a good view
v. look past, fail to notice
v. watch over
zh: vt. 俯瞰, 远眺, 没注意到
n. 眺望, 俯瞰到的景色
examples: We have overlooked this important fact.
They often overlook the value of patience and perseverance.
exampleZh: 我们看漏了这件重要的事。

defsEn: n. a show of military force or preparedness
n. a public display of group feelings (usually of a political nature)
n. proof by a process of argument or a series of proposition proving an asserted conclusion
n. a visual presentation showing how something works
zh: n. 示范, 实证
examples: Did the union participate in the demonstration?
I'm going to join a demonstration.
exampleZh: 工会参加了示威游行吗？
我要参加一个示威游行。

defsEn: n. the process of taking food into the body through the mouth (as by eating)
n. (economics) the utilization of economic goods to satisfy needs or in manufacturing
n. the act of consuming something
zh: n. 消费, 消费量, 痨病
examples: Limit the consumption of white sugar and salt.
Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.
exampleZh: 限制白糖和盐的摄取量。
酒的消费每年都在上升。

defsEn: v. state categorically
v. insist on having one's opinions and rights recognized
zh: vt. 主张, 坚称, 断言
examples: He feels the need to assert his masculinity.
I know how to assert myself.

defsEn: n. especially a leaf of grass or the broad portion of a leaf as distinct from the petiole
n. a dashing young man
n. something long and thin resembling a blade of grass
n. a cut of beef from the shoulder blade
zh: n. 叶片, 刀锋, 刀口, 剑
examples: The knife has a keen blade.
Your blade... Do you know its significance?
exampleZh: 这把刀的刀锋很利。

defsEn: n. small room on a ship or boat where people sleep
n. a small house built of wood
usually in a wooded area
n. the enclosed compartment of an aircraft or spacecraft where passengers are carried
v. confine to a small space, such as a cabin
zh: n. 小屋, 客舱
vt. 关在小屋
examples: He built a cabin on the beach.
The little cabin was bathed in moonlight.
exampleZh: 他在沙滩上建了座小屋。
小木屋沐浴在月光之中。

defsEn: n. the form in which a text (especially a printed book) is published
n. all of the identical copies of something offered to the public at the same time
n. an issue of a newspaper
zh: n. 版本, 版, 翻版
examples: I found the rare edition that I've been looking so long for.
The original edition is great, but the Portuguese translation contains errors.
exampleZh: 找到了寻找已久的珍本。
原版很好，然而葡萄牙语译文有误。

defsEn: n. the property of sound that varies with variation in the frequency of vibration
n. (baseball) the act of throwing a baseball by a pitcher to a batter
n. a vendor's position (especially on the sidewalk)
n. degree of deviation from a horizontal plane
zh: n. 程度, 坡度, 顶点, 前倾, 倾斜, 投掷, 音高, 螺距, 节距, 摊位, 树脂, 沥青
vt. 投, 掷, 向前倾跌, 扎营, 竭力推销, 为...定调, 定位于, 用沥青涂
vi. 搭帐篷, 投掷, 向前跌, 猛然摔倒, 坠落, 倾斜
examples: This is a good place to pitch a tent.
The players ran off the pitch and had a meeting during half-time.
exampleZh: 这是搭帐篷的好地方。
球员们跑下场，在中场休息时开了一个会。

defsEn: n. a coniferous tree
n. straight-grained durable and often resinous white to yellowish timber of any of numerous trees of the genus Pinus
zh: n. 松树, 松木
vi. 消瘦, 憔悴, 痛苦, 怀念, 渴望
examples: There used to be a big pine tree in front of my house.
He looked at the pine tree behind the house.
exampleZh: 以前我家前面有棵大松树。
他望向房子后面的那棵松树。

defsEn: s. of surpassing excellence
s. characterized by grandeur
s. full of light
shining intensely
zh: a. 光辉的, 灿烂的, 有才气的
examples: A brilliant future lay before him.
He thought of a brilliant idea.
exampleZh: 大好的前途摆在他面前。
他想到了一个绝妙的想法。

defsEn: prep. Against
as, John Doe versus Richard Roe
-- chiefly
used in legal language, and abbreviated to v. or vs.
zh: prep. 对...
examples: What's the effect of taking the medication orally versus applying it as eye drops?

defsEn: n. a professional cook
zh: n. 厨师
examples: Our chef is very busy today.
A brilliant, seductive chef turns to espionage in Napoleon-era France.
exampleZh: 我们的厨师今天很忙。
拿破仑时代的法国，魅力诱人的天才厨师摇身一变成为间谍。

defsEn: n. something that is conceived or that exists independently and not in relation to other things
something that does not depend on anything else and is beyond human control
something that is not relative
a. perfect or complete or pure
s. complete and without restriction or qualification
sometimes used informally as intensifiers
s. not limited by law
zh: a. 绝对的, 专制的, 完全的, 独立的
n. 绝对事物
examples: I have absolute trust in you.
I have absolute faith in you.
exampleZh: 我绝对信任你。
我百分之百相信你。

defsEn: n. a deep prolonged loud noise
n. a state of economic prosperity
n. a sudden happening that brings good fortune (as a sudden opportunity to make money)
n. a pole carrying an overhead microphone projected over a film or tv set
zh: n. 繁荣, 隆隆声
vi. 急速发展, 发隆隆声
vt. 使兴旺, 发隆隆声
examples: His voice boomed through the room.
The small car boom is ending.

defsEn: n. (music) the fifth note of the diatonic scale
a. exercising influence or control
a. (of genes) producing the same phenotype whether its allele is identical or dissimilar
zh: a. 占优势的, 支配的
examples: I want to be more dominant.
The Roman Empire was the dominant power in the region.

defsEn: n. practices that are handed down from the past by tradition
zh: n. 遗产, 祖先遗留物, 继承物
examples: Ironbridge Gorge is a Unesco world heritage site.
They acknowledge their Berber heritage to this day.
exampleZh: 铁桥峡谷是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。

defsEn: n. yellow oval fruit with juicy acidic flesh
n. a small evergreen tree that originated in Asia but is widely cultivated for its fruit
n. a distinctive tart flavor characteristic of lemons
n. an artifact (especially an automobile) that is defective or unsatisfactory
zh: n. 柠檬, 柠檬树, 柠檬色
examples: Use lemon juice instead of vinegar.
Add the honey, lemon juice, chopped almonds and the chopped apples.
exampleZh: 用拧檬汁代替醋。
加入蜂蜜，柠檬汁，切碎的杏仁和切碎的苹果。

defsEn: v. go via an indirect route or at no set pace
zh: vi. 游荡, 漫步, 徘徊, 迷路, 离题, 蜿蜒
vt. 在...漫游
examples: I tend to wander off with my mind.
Come wander around the world with me.

defsEn: s. having no protecting or concealing cover
s. (of the eye or ear e.g.) without the aid of an optical or acoustical device or instrument
s. devoid of elaboration or diminution or concealment
bare and pure
s. lacking any cover
zh: a. 裸体的, 无装饰的, 无保护的, 赤贫的
examples: You can see it with the naked eye.
Tom is naked from the waist up.
exampleZh: 用肉眼就能看见。
汤姆赤裸着上身。

defsEn: n. the branch of social science that deals with the production and distribution and consumption of goods and services and their management
zh: n. 经济学
examples: If they admit me to the university, I think I will major in economics.
Excuse me, do you know where the economics department library is?
exampleZh: 不好意思，请问你知道经济学部图书馆在哪里吗？

defsEn: n (law) a gift of personal property by will
zh: n. 祖先传下来之物, 遗赠物
examples: What kind of legacy do you hope to leave behind?
What do you want your legacy to be?

defsEn: n. a mutually agreed delay in the date set for the completion of a job or payment of a debt
n. act of expanding in scope
making more widely available
n. an educational opportunity provided by colleges and universities to people who are not enrolled as regular students
n. act of stretching or straightening out a flexed limb
zh: n. 延长, 扩充, 范围, 扩展名
a. 伸缩的
examples: This extension cord is too short.
I need a new extension cord like this one.
exampleZh: 这条延长线太短了。

defsEn: n. a gesture involving the shoulders
v. raise one's shoulders to indicate indifference or resignation
zh: n. 耸肩
v. 耸肩
examples: She gave a shrug of the shoulders.
With a shrug and some sorrow, Europeans bid 'Adieu' to EU member Britain.

defsEn: n. group of guns or missile launchers operated together at one place
n. a device that produces electricity
may have several primary or secondary cells arranged in parallel or series
n. a collection of related things intended for use together
n. a unit composed of the pitcher and catcher
zh: n. 电池, 殴打
examples: This battery is about to run out of juice.
How many batteries do you have right now?
exampleZh: 这电池快要没电了。
你现在有几块电池呀？

defsEn: n. accomplishment of an objective
n. the act of arriving at a certain place
n. someone who arrives (or has arrived)
zh: n. 到达, 抵达, 到达者
examples: He died previous to my arrival.
With the arrival of winter, the leaves on the trees fall down.
exampleZh: 他在我来到之前就死了。
树上的叶子随着冬天的到来而掉落。

defsEn: v. show or affirm to be just and legitimate
v. make (an illegitimate child) legitimate
declare the legitimacy of (someone)
a. of marriages and offspring
recognized as lawful
s. based on known statements or events or conditions
zh: a. 合法的, 正当的, 婚生的
vt. 认为正当, 立为嫡嗣, 使合法
examples: Do they have a legitimate case?
They can be legitimate, but I wonder how useful they are.

defsEn: n. the act of orienting
n. an integrated set of attitudes and beliefs
n. position or alignment relative to points of the compass or other specific directions
n. a person's awareness of self with regard to position and time and place and personal relationships
zh: n. 定方位, 适应, 向东方
n. 方向
examples: This orientation course will teach you everything you need to know.
Now I'll give you an orientation course.

defsEn: n. a long cloak
worn by a priest or bishop on ceremonial occasions
v. come to terms with
zh: vi. 竞争, 应付
n. 长袍
examples: She is unable to cope with stress.
The problem is how we cope with the present difficulties.
exampleZh: 她无法应付压力。
问题是我们如何应付目前的困难。

defsEn: v. be in flames or aflame
v. criticize harshly, usually via an electronic medium
zh: n. 火焰, 火舌, 热情, 光辉
vt. 焚烧, 用火焰给...灭菌, 用火焰传送(信号), 点燃, 激动
vi. 燃烧, 爆发, 闪耀
examples: The ship went up in flames.
The eternal flame of love burned only half a year.
exampleZh: 船起了火。

defsEn: v. come together as in a cluster or flock
zh: n. 串, 丛, 群, 簇
vi. 成串, 丛生
vt. 使聚集
examples: There was a cluster of large rocks in the area.
The cluster of cells continued to grow in the laboratory.

defsEn: a. relying on or requiring a person or thing for support, supply, or what is needed
s. contingent on something else
a. (of a clause) unable to stand alone syntactically as a complete sentence
zh: n. 依赖他人者
a. 依赖的, 从属的
examples: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
He is very dependent on his family.
exampleZh: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。
他非常依赖他的家人。

defsEn: n. a plumbing fixture that sprays water over you
n. washing yourself by standing upright under water sprayed from a nozzle
n. a brief period of precipitation
n. a sudden downpour (as of tears or sparks etc) likened to a rain shower
zh: n. 阵雨, 淋浴, 一阵, 展出者, 显示者
vi. 淋浴, 下阵雨
vt. 淋湿, 倾注
examples: In summer, I take a shower every morning.
May I take a shower in the morning?
exampleZh: 在夏季，我每天早上都会洗个澡。
我可不可以早上洗澡？

defsEn: v show in, or as in, a picture
v give a description of
v make a portrait of
zh: vt. 描述, 描写
examples: He vividly depicted the confusion following the earthquake.
It is impossible to depict that by means of words.

defsEn: n. an outbuilding (or part of a building) for housing automobiles
n. a repair shop where cars and trucks are serviced and repaired
v. keep or store in a garage
zh: n. 车库, 汽车修理厂, 机库
vt. 把车送入修车场
examples: I rented a house with a garage.
He backed his car into the garage.
exampleZh: 我租了一间有车库的房子。
他倒车入车库。

defsEn: n. the soft tissue of the body of a vertebrate: mainly muscle tissue and fat
v. remove adhering flesh from (hides) when preparing leather manufacture
zh: n. 肉, 肉体, 肉欲, 人性, 亲属, 人类, 众生, 人体
vt. 以肉喂, 激起...的杀戳情绪, 使肥, 赋以血肉
vi. 长胖
examples: I have seen him on TV but not in the flesh.
The flesh of this watermelon is too mushy.
exampleZh: 我在电视上看到过他，不过没有看到过他本人。
这西瓜瓤儿太肉。

defsEn: n. (mathematics) a symbol or function representing a mathematical operation
n. an agent that operates some apparatus or machine
n. someone who owns or operates a business
n. a speculator who trades aggressively on stock or commodity markets
zh: n. 操作员, 行家, 经纪人, 算子, 运算符
examples: The telephone operator asked the caller to hold on until a connection was made.
Mary was a switchboard operator when she was younger.
exampleZh: 电话运营商提示来电人等候接通。
玛丽年轻时是电话接线生。

defsEn: n. a conditional conveyance of property as security for the repayment of a loan
v. put up as security or collateral
zh: n. 抵押, 约束性义务, 抵押借款
vt. 抵押, 以...作担保, 把...许给
examples: How will we pay the mortgage?
He took out a mortgage from the bank in order to buy a house.

defsEn: n. light and humorous drama with a happy ending
zh: n. 喜剧, 有趣的事情
examples: We were all amused with the comedy.
As a rule, I prefer a comedy to a tragedy.
exampleZh: 我们都被这出喜剧逗乐了。

defsEn: n. formal and explicit approval
n. a mechanism of social control for enforcing a society's standards
n. the act of final authorization
v. give authority or permission to
zh: n. 核准, 制裁, 处罚, 约束力
vt. 制定制裁规则, 认可, 核准, 同意
examples: It is necessary to obtain the sanction of the authorities to enter this building.
The President of the Republic sanctioned the new law.
exampleZh: 必须获得有关当局的批准才能进入这座建筑物。

defsEn: n. a periodical that is published every week (or 52 issues per year)
s. of or occurring every seven days
zh: n. 周刊, 周报
a. 每周的, 一周一次的, 周刊的
adv. 每周, 一周一次
examples: When will the new weekly magazine come out?
Let me give you my weekly progress report.

defsEn: n. the type of environment in which an organism or group normally lives or occurs
zh: n. 栖息地, 居留地, 自生地, 聚集处
examples: I live in a space habitat.
I would like to see a giraffe in its habitat.

defsEn: n. an alert cognitive state in which you are aware of yourself and your situation
zh: n. 意识, 知觉, 自觉
examples: The demon lord finally lost consciousness and fell to the floor with a thud.
He lost consciousness under the influence of the anesthetic.
exampleZh: 大魔王终于失去知觉，砰的一声倒在了地上。
在麻醉剂的作用下，他昏了过去。

defsEn: n. the act or process of assigning numbers to phenomena according to a rule
zh: n. 尺寸, 度量, 度量单位
examples: The measurement is far too inaccurate.
The measurements need to be precise.

defsEn: n. the proper sphere or extent of your activities
zh: n. 省, 地方, 职权, 领域
examples: Hangzhou is the provincial capital of Zhejiang Province.
The Netherlands is divided into twelve provinces.
exampleZh: 杭州是浙江省的省会。
荷兰分成十二个省。

defsEn: n. the philosophical study of moral values and rules
zh: n. 道德规范
examples: Since when do you care about ethics?
The paper discusses the problem in terms of ethics.

defsEn: n. approval to do something
zh: n. 许可, 允许
examples: The teacher granted me permission to go home early.
We got permission to park here.
exampleZh: 老师允许我提前回家。
我们有在这里停车的许可。

defsEn: n. a meeting of heads of governments
v. reach the summit (of a mountain)
zh: n. 顶点, 最高阶层, 最高级会议
a. 政府首脑的, 最高级的
examples: The air is thin at the summit.
Who first reached the summit of Mt. Everest?
exampleZh: 山顶上空气稀薄。
最先登上珠穆朗玛峰的人是谁？

defsEn: v give qualities or abilities to
v give as a present
make a gift of
a endowed with talent or talents
zh: a. 有天才的
examples: Science gifted soil, water and air.
Perhaps the Earth is not the only planet gifted with life.

defsEn: n. any of various water-soluble compounds having a sour taste and capable of turning litmus red and reacting with a base to form a salt
n. street name for lysergic acid diethylamide
s. having the characteristics of an acid
zh: n. 酸, 酸类物质, 尖刻, 迷幻药
a. 酸的, 酸性的, 尖刻的, 敏锐的
examples: Acid rain in drinking water affects human health.
Acid rain is not a natural phenomenon.
exampleZh: 饮用水中的酸雨影响人类的健康。
酸雨不是自然现象。

defsEn: n. the likelihood of a thing occurring rather than not occurring
n. the ratio by which one better's wager is greater than that of another
zh: n. 可能性, 几率, 机会, 胜算, 不平等
examples: You have to beat the odds.
With enough effort, anyone can beat the odds to become a winner.

defsEn: n. the feeling that accompanies an experience of being thwarted in attaining your goals
n. an act of hindering someone's plans or efforts
n. a feeling of annoyance at being hindered or criticized
zh: n. 挫折, 顿挫
examples: People who experience frustration tend to react violently.
Try to turn your frustration into an opportunity.

defsEn: r. in accord with physical laws
zh: adv. 按自然规律, 完全地, 实际上, 真正地, 身体上地
examples: Tom was there physically, but not mentally.
Generally speaking, men are physically stronger than women.
exampleZh: 汤姆人在心不在。
一般说来，男生的肌肉比女生发达。

defsEn: n. the land along the edge of a body of water
n. a beam or timber that is propped against a structure to provide support
v. serve as a shore to
zh: n. 海岸, 海滨, 斜撑柱
vt. 把...送上岸, 支撑, 支持
examples: We went walking on the shore of the lake.
We walked along the shore of the lake.
exampleZh: 我们沿着湖岸散步。
我们沿着湖岸散步。

defsEn: v. mark as different
v. be a distinctive feature, attribute, or trait
sometimes in a very positive sense
zh: v. 区别, 辨别
examples: You should distinguish between right and wrong.
It is not easy to distinguish good from evil.
exampleZh: 你需要区分善与恶。
区分善恶不容易。

defsEn: n. either of two saclike respiratory organs in the chest of vertebrates
serves to remove carbon dioxide and provide oxygen to the blood
zh: n. 肺, 肺脏, 空地
examples: That man died of lung cancer a week ago.
My father died of lung cancer.
exampleZh: 那个男人在一周前死于肺癌。
我的父亲死于肺癌。

defsEn: a. relating to or characteristic of art or artists
s. satisfying aesthetic standards and sensibilities
zh: a. 艺术的, 艺术家的, 富有艺术性的
examples: He was raised in an artistic family.
In addition, she has an artistic flair.
exampleZh: 他在艺术世家长大。
此外，她有艺术家天赋。

defsEn: n. extended verbal expression in speech or writing
v. to consider or examine in speech or writing
zh: n. 谈话, 演讲
vi. 谈话, 讲述
examples: Erase to the start of discourse or text; drop the subject or start over.
The subject of their discourse was the same as usual.

defsEn: a. making a strong or vivid impression
s. producing a strong effect
zh: a. 给人深刻印象的, 威严的
examples: You've both been very impressive today. I'm proud of you.
You have a very impressive resume.
exampleZh: 今天你们俩很让人印象深刻。我为你们感到骄傲。

defsEn: n. a solid substance in the form of tiny loose particles
a solid that has been pulverized
n. any of various cosmetic or medical preparations dispensed in the form of a pulverized powder
v. apply powder to
zh: n. 粉, 粉末, 火药
vt. 搽粉于, 搽粉, 撒粉, 使成粉末
vi. 搽粉, 变成粉末
examples: The table is covered with powder.
Dissolve the powder in a bucket of warm water.
exampleZh: 桌上布满了粉末。

defsEn: a. displeasing to the senses
zh: a. 丑陋的, 邪恶的, 险恶的, 不祥的
n. 丑陋的人(或物)
examples: Between you and me, the fat ugly man is on a diet.
An ugly man knocked on my door.
exampleZh: 那个丑男人在节食，这个我们知道就好。
一个丑男人敲了我的门。

defsEn: v. portray in words
v. make a portrait of
v. represent abstractly, for example in a painting, drawing, or sculpture
zh: vt. 描绘, 描写, 描绘...的肖像
examples: In this film they both portray notorious gang leaders.
This German author portrays nature very well.

defsEn: n. the act of preparing something (as food) by the application of heat
zh: n. 烹饪
examples: I hate cooking, so I eat out a lot.
I wonder if I can get better at cooking.

defsEn: n. someone whose employment involves carrying something
n. a self-propelled wheeled vehicle designed specifically to carry something
n. an inactive substance that is a vehicle for a radioactive tracer of the same substance and that assists in its recovery after some chemical reaction
n. a person or firm in the business of transporting people or goods or messages
zh: n. 运送者, 邮递员, 带菌者
examples: Has the letter carrier been by yet?
The mail carrier should come soon.
exampleZh: 邮差来过了吗?

defsEn: v. be a regular or frequent visitor to a certain place
a. coming at short intervals or habitually
s. frequently encountered
zh: a. 时常发生的, 频繁的, 快速的
vt. 时常来访, 常常聚集, 常与...交往
examples: She's a frequent visitor to this country.
The third most frequent letter in Esperanto is "e".
exampleZh: 她经常来这个国家。
在世界语里，第三最常见的字母是“e".

defsEn: s. causing fear or dread or terror
zh: a. 可怕的, 庄严的, 虔敬的
examples: I made an awful mistake in the test.
What an awful lot of books you have!
exampleZh: 考试的时候我犯了很严重的错误。
你的书真是多到可怕啊!

defsEn: v. feel admiration for
v. look at with admiration
zh: vt. 赞美, 钦佩, 爱慕
vi. 称赞, 惊奇
examples: I admire you for your courage.
I admire him for his courage.
exampleZh: 我佩服你的勇气。
我佩服他的勇气。

defsEn: n. a domesticated animal kept for companionship or amusement
n. a fit of petulance or sulkiness (especially at what is felt to be a slight)
v. stroke or caress gently
v. stroke or caress in an erotic manner, as during lovemaking
zh: n. 宠物, 受宠爱的人, 宠坏的孩子, 不悦, 生气
a. 宠爱的, 表示亲昵的, 养着观赏的, 特别珍爱的, 格外的
vt. 宠爱, 溺爱, 抚摸
vi. 拥抱, 爱抚, 生气, 发脾气
examples: Do you have a petting zoo area?
My pet cat can do backflips.
exampleZh: 你们这里有可爱动物区吗？
我家猫会后空翻。

defsEn: n. any amazing or wonderful occurrence
n. a marvellous event manifesting a supernatural act of a divine agent
zh: n. 奇迹, 奇事
examples: It's a pity that you can't buy miracles like you would buy potatoes.
Miracles are called miracles because they never happen!
exampleZh: 可惜我们不能像买土豆一样买奇迹。
神迹称作神迹是因为它们从不发生！

defsEn: n. the basic rhythmic unit in a piece of music
n. recurring at regular intervals
n. the arrangement of spoken words alternating stressed and unstressed elements
zh: n. 旋律, 节奏, 韵律, 匀称, 张弛节律
examples: I find peace in the rhythm of life.
I follow the rhythm of the river.

defsEn: n. estrangement from god
n. an act that is regarded by theologians as a transgression of God's will
n. (Akkadian) god of the Moon
counterpart of Sumerian Nanna
n. the 21st letter of the Hebrew alphabet
zh: n. 罪, 犯罪, 过失, 失礼
v. 犯
examples: Is it always a sin to tell a lie?
We sin a lot, but we enjoy it.
exampleZh: 说谎总是一种罪吗？

defsEn: n. a written version of a play or other dramatic composition
used in preparing for a performance
n. a particular orthography or writing system
v. write a script for
zh: n. 手迹, 手稿, 正本, 手写体
vt. 改编为演出本
examples: The syntax of Python scripts is very simple.
My script should be ready in half an hour.
exampleZh: Python脚本的语法很简单。

defsEn: n. a foundation created to promote the public good (not for assistance to any particular individuals)
n. a kindly and lenient attitude toward people
n. an activity or gift that benefits the public at large
n. an institution set up to provide help to the needy
zh: n. 慈悲, 博爱, 慈善团体, 施舍
examples: It is justice, not charity, that is wanting in the world.
I give charity almost every day.
exampleZh: 世界需要的是公正，不是施舍。

defsEn: n. a plan for attaining a particular goal
zh: n. 一项战术, 一条策略
a. 战术的, 顺序的, 排列的
examples: We need to change our tactics.
Michael used the same tactic with a slightly different variation.

defsEn: n. evidence of identity
something that identifies a person or thing
n. the condition of having the identity (of a person or object) established
n. the attribution to yourself (consciously or unconsciously) of the characteristics of another person (or group of persons)
zh: n. 识别, 身份证明, 认同
examples: She used a fake identification card to get into the bar.
In the U.S., you usually have to show identification in order to buy alcohol.

defsEn: n. a qualitative change
n. (mathematics) a function that changes the position or direction of the axes of a coordinate system
n. a rule describing the conversion of one syntactic structure into another related syntactic structure
zh: n. 变形, 变质, 变化, 改革, 变换
examples: Transformation is birth and death at the same time.
I'm ready for a transformation in my life.
exampleZh: 改变同时蕴含着新生与毁灭。

defsEn: n. any venturesome undertaking especially one with an uncertain outcome
n. a commercial undertaking that risks a loss but promises a profit
v. proceed somewhere despite the risk of possible dangers
v. put at risk
zh: n. 冒险, 风险
vt. 敢于, 冒...的危险
vi. 冒险
examples: I wish my venture would work out.
You may disagree with and venture to question me, but remember, the feeling's mutual.

defsEn: n. the act of invading
the act of an army that invades for conquest or plunder
n. any entry into an area not previously occupied
n. (pathology) the spread of pathogenic microorganisms or malignant cells to new sites in the body
zh: n. 侵犯, 侵入, 侵害
examples: Tatoeba: As if the geek invasion wasn't enough.
I consider that an invasion of my privacy.
exampleZh: Tatoeba:好像怪客入侵还不够似的。

defsEn: n. a keyboard instrument that is played by depressing keys that cause hammers to strike tuned strings and produce sounds
n. (music) low loudness
a. used chiefly as a direction or description in music
r. used as a direction in music
to be played relatively softly
zh: n. 钢琴
examples: Could you teach me how to play the piano?
She can play the piano very well.
exampleZh: 您能教我弹钢琴吗？
她可以把钢琴弹得很好。

defsEn: n. bedding that keeps a person warm in bed
n. anything that covers
n. a layer of lead surrounding the highly reactive core of a nuclear reactor
v. cover as if with a blanket
zh: n. 毛毯, 毯子
vt. 掩盖, 覆盖
a. 总共的
examples: Could I have a pillow and blanket?
How many blankets are there on the bed?
exampleZh: 给我一个枕头和毛毯好吗？
床上有多少张毯子？

defsEn: n. a strong hard building material composed of sand and gravel and cement and water
v. cover with cement
v. form into a solid mass
coalesce
a. capable of being perceived by the senses
not abstract or imaginary
zh: n. 凝结物, 混凝土
a. 具体的, 实在的, 混凝土的
v. (使)凝结, 用混凝土浇筑
examples: When we looked down, we saw a concrete jungle.
Looking down, we saw a concrete jungle.
exampleZh: 我们往下看，是一片水泥丛林。
我们往下看，是一片水泥丛林。

defsEn: n. directions prescribed beforehand
the action of prescribing authoritative rules or directions
n. written instructions for an optician on the lenses for a given person
n. written instructions from a physician or dentist to a druggist concerning the form and dosage of a drug to be issued to a given patient
a. available only with a doctor's written prescription
zh: n. 处方, 命令, 指定
examples: Let me write you a prescription for some medicine.
To get a prescription, go to a doctor.

defsEn: n. a recently enlisted soldier
n. any new member or supporter (as in the armed forces)
v. seek to employ
v. cause to assemble or enlist in the military
zh: n. 新兵, 新手, 新会员, 补给品
vt. 恢复, 补充, 充实, 征募
vi. 征募新兵, 复原, 得到补充
examples: She recruited a young graduate to help her.
To recruit people for Esperanto, you have to speak other languages.

defsEn: n. rectangular block of clay baked by the sun or in a kiln
used as a building or paving material
n. a good fellow
helpful and trustworthy
zh: n. 砖块, 积木
a. 用砖做的
vt. 用砖造, 用砖砌
examples: Take a brick and place it before you.
I live in a brick house.

defsEn: n. a piece of cloth used as decoration or to mend or cover a hole
n. a short set of commands to correct a bug in a computer program
v. to join or unite the pieces of
v. provide with a patch
also used metaphorically
zh: n. 片, 补缀, 碎片, 斑, 傻瓜
vt. 补缀, 掩饰, 拼凑, 平息
examples: He has patched up the hole in the wall.
Patch the call through to my office, will you?
exampleZh: 他把墙壁的洞补好了。

defsEn: n. agreement in the judgment or opinion reached by a group as a whole
zh: n. 合意, 一致, 同感
examples: Can we reach a consensus on this issue?
There can be a lack of consensus on various matters.

defsEn: n. intense and profound fear
n. something that inspires dislike
something horrible
zh: n. 惊骇, 恐怖, 惨状
examples: To my horror, the man took a gun out of his pocket.
I'm going to see a horror film.
exampleZh: 男子从口袋中掏出枪，吓了我一跳。
我要去看恐怖电影。

defsEn: n. a signal that encodes something (e.g., picture or sound) that has been recorded
n. the act of making a record (especially an audio record)
n. a storage device on which information (sounds or images) have been recorded
zh: a. 记录的, 记录用的
n. 录音
examples: We used the transcripts of the recordings of telephone conversations.
I have several recordings of Beethoven's Fifth Symphony.

defsEn: n. a resident of a colony
a. of or relating to or characteristic of or inhabiting a colony
a. of animals who live in colonies, such as ants
s. composed of many distinct individuals united to form a whole or colony
zh: a. 殖民的, 殖民地的
examples: It is a colonial divide-and-conquer strategy to pit religious people against one another.
There was little colonial presence in that country.

defsEn: n. dish baked in pastry-lined pan often with a pastry top
zh: n. 馅饼, 财富, 总额, 贪污受贿, 杂乱, 喜鹊
examples: I want to make a pie.
I want to eat apple pie.
exampleZh: 我想做个派。
我想吃苹果派。

defsEn: n. a reason for wanting something done
n. Japanese alcoholic beverage made from fermented rice
usually served hot
n. the purpose of achieving or obtaining
zh: n. 目的, 缘故, 理由
examples: For the sake of living things, please do not play around with the water.
He quit smoking for the sake of his health.
exampleZh: 关爱生命，请勿嬉水。
他为了健康，戒烟了。

defsEn: n. a long fixed look
v. look at with fixed eyes
zh: n. 注视, 凝视
vi. 注视, 凝视
examples: At night, she gazed at the moon.
I felt her gaze from behind.
exampleZh: 她在夜晚望着月亮。
背后感受到她的目光。

defsEn: v. promise solemnly
take an oath
v. make a deposition
declare under oath
zh: vt. 发誓, 咒骂, 使宣誓
vi. 发誓, 诅咒
n. 诅咒, 誓言
examples: I swear I will never do such a thing.
I swear that I'll never do such a thing.
exampleZh: 我发誓我不会做这种事。
我发誓我不会做这种事。

defsEn: n. evidence that helps to solve a problem
v. roll into a ball
zh: n. 线索, 暗示
vt. 暗示, 提供线索
examples: I haven't got a clue as to why he quit so suddenly.
The authorities have no clue, but everyone else knows.
exampleZh: 我完全不明白他为什么会突然辞职。
旁观者清，当局者迷。

defsEn: n. a share of something
n. a golf shot that curves to the right for a right-handed golfer
n. a thin flat piece cut off of some object
n. a spatula for spreading paint or ink
zh: n. 薄的切片, 一部分, 菜刀
vt. 切成薄片, 切下
vi. 切
examples: Give me a slice of cake too!
Do you want a slice of cake?
exampleZh: 也给我一块蛋糕！
你想要一块蛋糕吗?

defsEn: n. the principal activity in your life that you do to earn money
n. the control of a country by military forces of a foreign power
n. any activity that occupies a person's attention
n. the act of occupying or taking possession of a building
zh: n. 职业, 占有, 占有期, 占领, 占领军
examples: Sahrawis remain under occupation without the right to self-determination.
What is your occupation? What do you do here?

defsEn: n. disorder resulting from a failure to behave predictably
n. a mental state characterized by a lack of clear and orderly thought and behavior
n. a feeling of embarrassment that leaves you confused
n. an act causing a disorderly combination of elements with identities lost and distinctions blended
zh: n. 混乱, 混淆, 无秩序
examples: There is a lot of chaos and confusion at the site.
What he said caused a lot of confusion.

defsEn: a. concerned with religion or religious purposes
s. worthy of respect or dedication
s. (often followed by `to') devoted exclusively to a single use or purpose or person
zh: a. 神圣的, 献给上帝的, 庄严的, 祭祀的
examples: In India, the cow is a sacred animal.
Every day is a sacred day.
exampleZh: 在印度，牛是一种神圣的动物。
每天都是神圣的一天。

defsEn: n. members of a cooperative enterprise
a. forming a whole or aggregate
s. set up on the principle of collectivism or ownership and production by the workers involved usually under the supervision of a government
zh: a. 集体的, 聚集的, 共同的
examples: He is making use of the collective's name for his own profit.
I work on a collective farm.
exampleZh: 他在利用集体的名义，为自己谋利。

defsEn: a. of or being or relating to or involving cognition
zh: a. 认知的, 认识的
examples: I plan to major in cognitive science in college.
I want to major in cognitive science.

defsEn: n. an utterance made by exhaling audibly
n. a sound like a person sighing
v. heave or utter a sigh
breathe deeply and heavily
v. utter with a sigh
zh: n. 叹息
vi. 叹息, 渴望
vt. 叹息着说
examples: I sighed with relief to hear it.
Tom let out a big sigh.
exampleZh: 我听到消息松了一口气。
汤姆大声叹了口气。

defsEn: n. spectators at a golf or tennis match
n. a room or series of rooms where works of art are exhibited
n. a long usually narrow room used for some specific purpose
n. a covered corridor (especially one extending along the wall of a building and supported with arches or columns)
zh: n. 走廊, 最高楼座, 画廊, 收集, 图库
examples: Better drop by his gallery if you have time.
You should drop by his gallery if you have time.

defsEn: n. a passageway through or under something, usually underground (especially one for trains or cars)
v. force a way through
zh: n. 隧道, 地下道
vi. 挖隧道
vt. 掘隧道于
examples: On entering a dark tunnel, we could see nothing.
The new tunnel is twice as long as the old one.
exampleZh: 走进了漆黑的隧道后，我们什么也看不见。
新建的隧道比以前的那一条长两倍。

defsEn: n. a person or institution against whom an action is brought in a court of law
the person being sued or accused
zh: n. 被告
examples: The defendant will appeal to a higher court.
The court declared the defendant innocent.
exampleZh: 被告会向上级法院上诉。
法庭宣判被告无罪。

defsEn: n. the quality of being suitable
n. good physical condition
being in shape or in condition
n. the quality of being qualified
zh: n. 适合, 合宜, 合理, 恰当, 健康
examples: There will be a fitness bikini competition in the city.
His daily fitness training is very important to him.

defsEn: n. death of a person
n. a place for the burial of a corpse (especially beneath the ground and marked by a tombstone)
s. dignified and somber in manner or character and committed to keeping promises
s. of great gravity or crucial import
requiring serious thought
zh: n. 墓穴, 坟墓, 终结, 死亡
a. 庄重的, 严肃的, 重大的, 低沉的
vt. 雕刻
examples: She carried that habit to her grave.
They were buried in a mass grave.
exampleZh: 她到死都改不了那个习惯。
他们被埋在一座大坟墓里。

defsEn: n. the upper side of the thighs of a seated person
n. an area of control or responsibility
n. the part of a piece of clothing that covers the thighs
n. a flap that lies over another part
zh: n. 膝盖, 舔, 一圈, 下摆, 衣兜, 山坳
vi. 重叠, 围住, 轻拍, 舔
vt. 包围, 抱...在膝上, 使重叠, 舔, 拍打, 泼溅
examples: You could sit on my lap if you want.
I do a lap around the lake every morning.

defsEn: n. one of the digits of the foot
n. the part of footwear that provides a covering for the toes
n. forepart of a hoof
n. (golf) the part of a clubhead farthest from the shaft
zh: n. 足趾, 趾部, 脚趾
vt. 以趾踏触, 用脚尖走
vi. 动脚尖
examples: She stood on tip-toe and whispered something in his ear, and then went away.
Tom struggled to touch his toes.
exampleZh: 她踮起脚向他耳语，然后走了
汤姆吃力地去碰脚趾。

defsEn: n. the quality of doing what is right and avoiding what is wrong
n. morality with respect to sexual relations
n. a particular moral excellence
zh: n. 德行, 美德, 优点, 功效, 效力
examples: She became rich by virtue of hard work and good business sense.
You have to make a virtue of necessity.
exampleZh: 她凭着努力和生意头脑成了富翁。

defsEn: s. in a foreign country
r. to or in a foreign country
zh: adv. 往国外, 到室外, 到处
a. 往国外的, 在室外的, 广泛四散的
examples: I want to go abroad next year.
I want to study abroad next year.
exampleZh: 我明年想去国外。
我明年想出国留学。

defsEn: r. in a very impressive manner
r. in a dramatic manner
r. with respect to dramatic value
zh: adv. 戏剧地, 引人注目地, 突然地
examples: Reusable rockets will dramatically cut the cost of sending equipment to space.
How is it possible that you've changed so dramatically?

defsEn: n. someone who creates plans to be used in making something (such as buildings)
zh: n. 建筑师, 设计者, 缔造者
examples: A famous architect built this house.
You can see that the architect paid scrupulous attention to detail.
exampleZh: 一个有名的建筑师造了这个房子。
这位建筑师显然是一位无微不至的建筑师。

defsEn: n. cosmetics applied to the face to improve or change your appearance
n. an event that is substituted for a previously cancelled event
zh: n. 组成, 性格, 化妆品, 化装(术), 虚构, 补考
examples: The actress' skin has makeup on it.
She wears a lot of makeup.
exampleZh: 演员的皮肤是化过妆的。
她化着浓妆。

defsEn: n. a search for knowledge
n. a systematic investigation of a matter of public interest
zh: n. 质询, 探索, 调查, 询盘
examples: For media inquiries, please contact your local communications or marketing representative.
We made inquiries into his past.
exampleZh: 如需媒体联络，请与当地客服中心或行销团队联系。
我们对他的过去进行了调查。

defsEn: n. short for railway
n. a horizontal bar (usually of wood or metal)
n. any of numerous widely distributed small wading birds of the family Rallidae having short wings and very long toes for running on soft mud
v. complain bitterly
zh: n. 横杆, 围栏, 栏杆, 铁轨, 扶手, 秧鸡
vt. 以横木围栏, 给...铺铁轨
vi. 责骂, 抱怨
examples: His bike ran into a guard-rail.
Get hold of the rail just in case.
exampleZh: 他的单车撞上了栏杆。

defsEn: n. a flat coat of paint or varnish used by artists as a primer
n. a narrow bed on which a patient lies during psychiatric or psychoanalytic treatment
zh: n. 长沙发, 睡椅, 卧榻
vt. 横躺, 表达
vi. 躺下, 蹲伏
examples: Tom is asleep on the couch.
Tom passed out on the couch.
exampleZh: 汤姆在长沙发上睡着了。
汤姆在沙发上昏睡过去了。

defsEn: n. the state of being allied or confederated
n. a connection based on kinship or marriage or common interest
n. an organization of people (or countries) involved in a pact or treaty
n. a formal agreement establishing an association or alliance between nations or other groups to achieve a particular aim
zh: n. 联盟, 联合
examples: I hope they form an alliance that will endure.
I mean the NATO alliance with powerful member the United States.

defsEn: v. form the substance of
v. write music
v. put together out of existing material
v. calm (someone, especially oneself)
make quiet
zh: vt. 组成, 写作, 作曲, 使平静
vi. 创作, 排字
examples: Shizuko composed a poem about the change of the seasons.
The committee is composed of three men and seven women.
exampleZh: 志津子写了一首关于季节变化的诗。
委员会是由三男七女组成的。

defsEn: n. a state of confusion and disorderliness
n. soft semiliquid food
n. a meal eaten in a mess hall by service personnel
n. a (large) military dining room where service personnel eat or relax
zh: n. 食堂, 伙食, 用膳, 一份食品, 混乱, 乱七八糟, 困境
vt. 将...弄糟, 妨碍, 使紊乱, 使就餐
vi. 陷入困境, 搞乱, 用膳
examples: How do I get out of this mess?
If you make a mess, clean it up.
exampleZh: 我怎么才能摆脱这种困境？
如果你弄乱了，你来打扫。

defsEn: n. a story about mythical or supernatural beings or events
zh: n. 传说, 传奇文学, 图例
examples: Myths and legends should be handed down from generation to generation.
President Kennedy was killed, but his legend will live on forever.
exampleZh: 神话和传说应该一代一代的传承下去。
肯尼迪总统被刺杀了，但是他的传奇会永久长存。

defsEn: n. a juvenile between the onset of puberty and maturity
a. relating to or peculiar to or suggestive of an adolescent
s. being of the age 13 through 19
s. displaying or suggesting a lack of maturity
zh: a. 青春期的, 青少年的
n. 青少年
examples: It is said that adolescent friendships do not often last.
The brain of an adolescent is still forming.

defsEn: n. the act of disturbing the mind or body
n. a tool used to thicken or spread metal (the end of a bar or a rivet etc.) by forging or hammering or swaging
n. the act of upsetting something
v. disturb the balance or stability of
zh: a. 弄翻的, 混乱的, 心烦的
vt. 弄翻, 颠覆, 推翻, 打乱, 使不适, 使心烦
vi. 翻倒
examples: Because my stomach was upset, I took a day off school.
The boy was not upset, even after being laughed at by his classmates.
exampleZh: 因为肚子不舒服， 我请了一天假不去学校。
即便是被同学嘲笑，那个男孩也不会感到失落。

defsEn: n. a statement that expresses a personal opinion or belief or adds information
n. explicit notice
zh: n. 评论, 注意
vt. 评论, 注意
vi. 评论, 谈论
examples: Her remarks caused dissatisfaction in the public.
The remark you made at the party about Lisa's weight was totally uncalled for.
exampleZh: 她的言论引起了舆论的不满。
你在聚会中针对Lisa体重作出的评论是完全不适当的。

defsEn: a. being connected either logically or causally or by shared characteristics
a. connected by kinship, common origin, or marriage
zh: a. 讲述的, 叙述的；有关系的, 有关联的
examples: My quality of work is directly related to the quality of the coffee available.
If it's a thing related to chemistry, leave it to me!

defsEn: n. payment made in return for a service rendered
n. an act performed to strengthen approved behavior
n. the offer of money for helping to find a criminal or for returning lost property
v. act or give recompense in recognition of someone's behavior or actions
zh: n. 报酬, 酬谢, 赏金
vt. 奖赏, 酬谢, 给...应有报应
examples: Do you have a rewards card?
He was given a gold watch as a reward.
exampleZh: 您有会员卡吗？
他被奖励了一块金表。

defsEn: v be relevant to
v be on the mind of
zh: prep. 关于
examples: Have you ever put forward any hypotheses concerning this strange phenomenon?
Concerning this word, each expert has a different point of view.
exampleZh: 对这个词，专家们各有不同的看法。

defsEn: n something that provides direction or advice as to a decision or course of action
v give advice to
zh: n. 咨询服务
examples: Sami put his daughter on counseling.
This is my second counseling session.

defsEn: n. set that receives radio or tv signals
n. the tennis player who receives the serve
n. a football player who catches (or is supposed to catch) a forward pass
zh: n. 接收器；接受者；收信机；收款员, 接待者
examples: I put the receiver to my ear.
What does the receiver need to know?
exampleZh: 我把听筒放到了耳边。

defsEn: n. any customary observance or practice
n. the prescribed procedure for conducting religious ceremonies
n. stereotyped behavior
a. of or relating to or characteristic of religious rituals
zh: n. 仪式, 典礼, 宗教仪式
a. 仪式的, 依仪式进行的
examples: A sacred ritual took place in the magnificent temple.
It's time to perform the ritual.
exampleZh: 一个神圣的仪式在庄严的庙宇中举行。

defsEn: n. any of various large food and game fishes of northern waters
usually migrate from salt to fresh water to spawn
n. a tributary of the Snake River in Idaho
n. flesh of any of various marine or freshwater fish of the family Salmonidae
n. a pale pinkish orange color
zh: n. 鲑鱼, 大麻哈鱼
examples: I want half of a salmon.
Salmon lay their eggs in fresh water.
exampleZh: 我要半条鲑鱼。
鲑鱼在淡水中产卵。

defsEn: n. a signal that temporarily stops the execution of a program so that another procedure can be carried out
v. make a break in
v. destroy the peace or tranquility of
v. interfere in someone else's activity
zh: vt. 中断, 妨碍, 插嘴
vi. 打断
n. 中断
examples: Excuse me for interrupting you, but would you mind opening the window?
I will try not to interrupt you while you are studying.
exampleZh: 对不起，打扰一下，能帮忙开下窗子吗？
我会尽量不打扰你复习。

defsEn: n. one of greater rank or station or quality
n. the head of a religious community
n. a town in northwest Wisconsin on Lake Superior across from Duluth
a. of high or superior quality or performance
zh: n. 长者, 占优势的人, 上级
a. 上级的, 出众的, 高傲的
examples: This carpet is superior to that one in quality.
Father has now got a superior position in his office.
exampleZh: 这地毯在质量上比那个好得多。
现在父亲在他的办公室已经得到了一个上级的地位。

defsEn: n. any art that invokes supernatural powers
zh: n. 魔术, 魔法
a. 魔术的, 有魔力的, 不可思议的
examples: Magic plays an important part in primitive society.
My magic can turn water into wine.
exampleZh: 巫术在原始社会扮演重要角色。

defsEn: n. an engagement fought between two military forces
zh: n. 争斗, 战斗
vi. 战斗, 争斗
vt. 与...战斗, 与...斗争
examples: In real combat, you must not forget that hesitation is a very dangerous thing.
I would like a trial by combat.
exampleZh: 在实战中，你要知道三心二意是很危险的。

defsEn: n. a physician who specializes in surgery
zh: n. 外科医生, 军医, 船医
examples: My father is an expert surgeon.
This surgeon can literally open your heart.
exampleZh: 我父亲是一名外科专家。

defsEn: n. the tube of a tobacco pipe
v. grow out of, have roots in, originate in
v. cause to point inward
v. stop the flow of a liquid
zh: n. 茎, 干, 柄, 船首, 血统, 堵塞物
vt. 摘掉茎, 装柄于, 阻止, 堵住, 逆行
vi. 堵住, 逆行
examples: Their trouble stems from a trifling matter.
The plant, we call it asphodel and its stem, the flower stalk.
exampleZh: 他们的烦恼是由一件琐碎的事而起的。

defsEn: n a lawyer who pleads cases in court
n something that provides direction or advice as to a decision or course of action
v give advice to
zh: n. 商议, 忠告, 法律顾问
v. 商议, 劝告
examples: Take counsel with a man who is wise and of a good conscience.
The lawyer counseled the negotiation team on the contents of the contract.

Why does Tom take those pills?

为啥汤姆要吃这些药片？

Mix the flour with two eggs.

n. the office and function of president

rend的过去式和过去分词

I would like to rent a car.

我想租一辆车。

The slope of the ground made it difficult to construct the road.

Subtle differences in tone discriminate the original from the copy.

Too much drinking can be harmful to your health.

You ought to get a medal.

entreat

Tom begged his father to buy him a new bicycle.
exampleZh: 求你了，给我一个瓶子吧！
汤姆求他父亲给他买新自行车。

v. assume responsibility for or leadership of

defsEn: n. a society in an advanced state of social development (e.g., with complex legal and political and religious organizations)
n. the social process whereby societies achieve an advanced stage of development and organization

He gave me a ring at midnight.
exampleZh: 我们叫那个颜色“午夜蓝”。
他半夜打电话给我。

v. give a title to

examples: I know I'm right, but you're entitled to your opinion.
He is entitled to receive the reward.
exampleZh: 我知道我是对的，不过你有权有你自己的看法。
他有权得到奖励。

defsEn: n. a large area of land preserved in its natural state as public property
n. a piece of open land for recreational use in an urban area
