n. a gear position that acts as a parking brake

We used to play in the park.
exampleZh: 我每天早上在公园写作。
我们过去常在公园玩。

s. disagreeable to the senses

你们俩真扫我的雅兴。

rooms usually open onto it

v. inscribe or address by way of compliment
v. set apart to sacred uses with solemn rites, of a church
zh: vt. 献出, 贡献
examples: Her father dedicated his life to science.
His father dedicated his life to science.
exampleZh: 她父亲把一生都贡献给科学事业了。
他的父亲把一生奉献给了科学。

defsEn: n. the force by which one object attracts another
n. an entertainment that is offered to the public
n. the quality of arousing interest
being attractive or something that attracts
n. a characteristic that provides pleasure and attracts
zh: n. 吸引, 吸引人的事物, 吸引力
examples: The tickets for this attraction can only be bought online.
Describe a tourist attraction you would like to visit.
exampleZh: 这个景点只能网上购票。

defsEn: v. form by carving
v. engrave or cut by chipping away at a surface
v. cut to pieces
zh: v. 雕刻, 切开
examples: The boy carved his name on the tree.
The boy carved his name into the tree.
exampleZh: 男孩把他的名字刻在树上。
男孩把他的名字刻在树上。

defsEn: n. a slender pointer for indicating the reading on the scale of a measuring instrument
n. a sharp pointed implement (usually steel)
v. goad or provoke,as by constant criticism
v. prick with a needle
zh: n. 针, 尖
vt. 用针缝
vi. 缝纫
examples: Compass needles point to the north.
Even a small needle can stab through a heart.
exampleZh: 指南针的指针指向北边。

defsEn: n. a protruding abdomen
n. a part that bulges deeply
n. the hollow inside of something
n. the underpart of the body of certain vertebrates such as snakes or fish
zh: n. 腹部, 食欲
vt. 使鼓起
vi. 鼓起, 匍匐前进
examples: I hit him in the belly.
The child is wearing a belly-slip made of silk.
exampleZh: 我打了他的肚子。
这个小孩穿着一件丝绸织成的肚兜.

defsEn: n. a sudden attack of fear
zh: n. 惊吓, 恐慌
vt. 惊吓, 使恐慌
vi. 受惊
examples: I didn't mean to scare you.
I didn't mean to scare Tom.
exampleZh: 我没想要吓你。
我没想吓唬汤姆的。

defsEn: n. a large, flat, thin case for carrying loose papers or drawings or maps
usually leather
n. a set of pieces of creative work collected to be shown to potential customers or employers
n. a list of the financial assets held by an individual or a bank or other financial institution
n. the role of the head of a government department
zh: n. 皮包, 公文包, 部长职务, 有价证券财产目录, 艺术代表作选辑
examples: How much of my portfolio should I invest in stocks?
He is working on his art portfolio.

defsEn: n. public transport that consists of a bus or train or airplane that plies back and forth between two points
n. bobbin that passes the weft thread between the warp threads
v. travel back and forth between two points
zh: n. 穿梭, 梭子, 往返移动之物
v. (使)穿梭移动, 往返运送
examples: Where can I get a shuttle bus at the airport?
Our shuttle bus will pick you up at the airport.

defsEn: a. impossible or nearly impossible to see
imperceptible by the eye
zh: a. 看不见的, 无形的
examples: The moon is invisible behind the clouds.
If I were invisible, I wouldn't have to wear anything.
exampleZh: 在云的遮蔽下无法见到月亮。
若我是隐形的，就不用穿衣服了。

defsEn: n. employment for performers or performing groups that lasts for a limited period of time
n. contact by fitting together
n. the act of sharing in the activities of a group
zh: n. 诺言, 约会, 婚约, 交战
examples: He announced his engagement to her.
The engagement of Mr Rogers and Miss Smith was announced yesterday.
exampleZh: 他宣布与她订婚。
罗杰斯先生和史密斯小姐昨天宣布订婚。

defsEn: n. the act of transacting within or between groups (as carrying on commercial activities)
zh: n. 交易, 办理, 学报, 和解协议
examples: I have to close this transaction within a week.
I have to conclude this transaction within a week.

defsEn: n. a gliding joint between the distal ends of the tibia and fibula and the proximal end of the talus
zh: n. 踝
examples: A sprained ankle disabled him from walking for a month.
You can't see your ankle with that one.
exampleZh: 他把足踝扭伤了，整整一个月不能走路。

defsEn: n. a person or thing having the same function or characteristics as another
n. a duplicate copy
zh: n. 副本, 复本, 配对物, 相应物
examples: Tebboune spoke on the phone with his Tunisian counterpart.
African elephants are bigger than their Asian counterparts.

defsEn: a. moderate in type or degree or effect or force
far from extreme
zh: a. 温和的, 温柔的, 淡味的, 适度的, 轻微的, (肥皂等)软性的
examples: It's fairly mild for this time of year.
We had a mild winter last year.
exampleZh: 就现在这个节气来说天气是相当温和了。
去年冬天很暖和。

defsEn: n. a small replica of a person
used as a toy
zh: n. 洋娃娃, 无头脑的美丽女人
examples: She will lay the doll on her bed.
I'd like a doll, a new bicycle..... and peace on earth!
exampleZh: 她会把娃娃放到她的床上。
我想要一个洋娃娃，一辆新自行车……以及世界和平。

defsEn: n. a traveler who actively rides an animal (as a horse or camel)
n. a clause that is appended to a legislative bill
n. a traveler who actively rides a vehicle (as a bicycle or motorcycle)
zh: n. 骑手, (文件后的)附件, 扶手
examples: Riders can form a close bond with their horse.
The rider stopped at an inn during his travels.

defsEn: prep. See Amidst.
prep. In the midst or middle of
surrounded or encompassed by
among.
zh: prep. 在其间, 在其中
examples: The curtain fell amid the wild applause of the audience.
Their house lay amid a small stand of trees.

defsEn: s. eagerly desirous
s. causing or fraught with or showing anxiety
zh: a. 忧虑的, 发愁的, 渴望的
examples: He is anxious to know the result.
I am anxious about his health.
exampleZh: 他迫不及待地想要知道结果。
我很担心他的健康。

defsEn: a. used or designed for residence or limited to residences
a. of or relating to or connected with residence
zh: a. 住宅的, 与居住有关的
examples: Please write down your residential address and home number.
I would prefer to live in a residential area, not downtown.
exampleZh: 请写下住址和家庭电话。

defsEn: a. relating to or caused by structure, especially political or economic structure
a. relating to or having or characterized by structure
s. affecting or involved in structure or construction
not ornamental elements"
s. concerned with systematic structure in a particular field of study
zh: a. 结构的, 建筑的
examples: Only a structural engineer can tell you whether the bridge is sound.
There's no sign of structural damage.

defsEn: n. an essential structural component of living cells and source of energy for animals
includes simple sugars with small molecules as well as macromolecular substances
are classified according to the number of monosaccharide groups they contain
zh: n. 碳水化合物, 糖类
examples: They call it suicide by carbohydrates, but I call it pizza.
Avocados are low in carbohydrates and high in fiber.

defsEn: v. determine or distinguish the nature of a problem or an illness through a diagnostic analysis
v. subject to a medical analysis
zh: v. 诊断
examples: The doctor diagnosed the patient with the flu.
How was your health prior to being diagnosed with cancer?

defsEn: n. a sign posted in a public place as an advertisement
zh: n. 海报, 招贴, 驿马
examples: He paused to look at the poster.
You can help us by translating this poster into every language you know.
exampleZh: 他停下脚步看起海报。

defsEn: n. freedom of choice
n. personal freedom from servitude or confinement or oppression
zh: n. 自由, 特权, 许可, 冒失
examples: The essence of liberty is mathematics.
The prisoner was set at liberty.
exampleZh: 自由的本质就是数学。
囚犯重获自由。

defsEn: n. a very slow movement
n. a swimming stroke
arms are moved alternately overhead accompanied by a flutter kick
n. a slow mode of locomotion on hands and knees or dragging the body
v. move slowly
in the case of people or animals with the body near the ground
zh: n. 爬行, 匍匐而行, 养鱼池
v. 爬行
examples: She knows how to do the crawl.
I just want to crawl into a hole and hide.
exampleZh: 她知道怎么游自由式。
